function purchaseOrderToForm(order: PurchaseOrder): PurchaseOrderForm {
  return {
    status: order.status || "Draft",
    order_date: order.order_date || todayISO(),
    acknowledgement_number: order.acknowledgement_number || "",
    acknowledgement_date: order.acknowledgement_date || "",
    estimated_ship_date: order.estimated_ship_date || "",
    actual_ship_date: order.actual_ship_date || "",
    carrier: order.carrier || "",
    tracking_number: order.tracking_number || "",
    freight_amount: String(numberOrZero(order.freight_amount)),
    notes: order.notes || "",
  };
}

function localDateRange(dateString: string) {
  const start = new Date(`${dateString}T00:00:00`);
  const end = new Date(start);
  end.setDate(end.getDate() + 1);

  return {
    start: start.toISOString(),
    end: end.toISOString(),
  };
}

function vendorInvoiceToForm(
  invoice: VendorInvoice
): VendorInvoiceForm {
  return {
    vendor_invoice_number:
      invoice.vendor_invoice_number || "",
    manufacturer_id: invoice.manufacturer_id || "",
    purchase_order_id:
      invoice.purchase_order_id || "",
    invoice_date: invoice.invoice_date || todayISO(),
    due_date: invoice.due_date || "",
    status: invoice.status || "Open",
    freight_amount: String(
      numberOrZero(invoice.freight_amount)
    ),
    tax_amount: String(numberOrZero(invoice.tax_amount)),
    other_amount: String(
      numberOrZero(invoice.other_amount)
    ),
    notes: invoice.notes || "",
  };
}

function expenseToForm(expense: Expense): ExpenseForm {
  return {
    expense_date: expense.expense_date || todayISO(),
    payee: expense.payee || "",
    category: expense.category || "",
    description: expense.description || "",
    amount: String(numberOrZero(expense.amount)),
    payment_method: expense.payment_method || "",
    reference: expense.reference || "",
    manufacturer_id: expense.manufacturer_id || "",
    purchase_order_id: expense.purchase_order_id || "",
    sales_order_id: expense.sales_order_id || "",
    notes: expense.notes || "",
  };
}

  assigned_user_id: string | null;
  client_name: string | null;
  first_name: string | null;
  last_name: string | null;
  company_name: string | null;
  business_type: string | null;
  email: string | null;
  phone: string | null;
  city: string | null;
  state: string | null;
  zip_code: string | null;
  street_address: string | null;
  lead_status: string | null;
  notes: string | null;
  tax_exempt: boolean | null;
  active: boolean | null;
};

type ClientForm = {
  client_name: string;
  phone: string;
  email: string;
  street_address: string;
  city: string;
  state: string;
  zip_code: string;
  assigned_user_id: string;
  notes: string;
  tax_exempt: boolean;
};

const clientColumns =
  "id,assigned_user_id,client_name,first_name,last_name,company_name,business_type,email,phone,city,state,zip_code,street_address,lead_status,notes,tax_exempt,active";

const blankForm: ClientForm = {
  client_name: "",
  phone: "",
  email: "",
  street_address: "",
  city: "",
  state: "",
  zip_code: "",
  assigned_user_id: "",
  notes: "",
  tax_exempt: false,
};

function getClientName(client: Client) {
  if (client.client_name) return client.client_name;
  if (client.company_name) return client.company_name;

  const personalName = [client.first_name, client.last_name]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" ");

  return personalName || "Unnamed client";
}

function getLocation(client: Client) {
  const cityState = [client.city, client.state]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(", ");

  return [cityState, client.zip_code].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}

function clientToForm(client: Client): ClientForm {
  return {
    client_name: getClientName(client),
    phone: client.phone || "",
    email: client.email || "",
    street_address: client.street_address || "",
    city: client.city || "",
    state: client.state || "",
    zip_code: client.zip_code || "",
    assigned_user_id: client.assigned_user_id || "",
    notes: client.notes || "",
    tax_exempt: Boolean(client.tax_exempt),
  };
}

function manufacturerToForm(
  manufacturer: Manufacturer
): ManufacturerForm {
  return {
    name: manufacturer.name || "",
    account_number: manufacturer.account_number || "",
    orders_email: manufacturer.orders_email || "",
    phone: manufacturer.phone || "",
    terms: manufacturer.terms || "",
    purchasing_factor:
      manufacturer.purchasing_factor?.toString() || "",
    default_discount_pct:
      manufacturer.default_discount_pct?.toString() || "",
    tariff_pct: manufacturer.tariff_pct?.toString() || "",
    surcharge_pct: manufacturer.surcharge_pct?.toString() || "",
    notes: manufacturer.notes || "",
    active: manufacturer.active !== false,
  };
}

function money(value: number) {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "USD",
  }).format(value);
}

function todayISO() {
  return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function plusDaysISO(days: number) {
  const date = new Date();
  date.setDate(date.getDate() + days);
  return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function numberOrZero(value: unknown) {
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
}


function inventoryItemToForm(
  item: InventoryItem
): InventoryItemForm {
  return {
    sku: item.sku || "",
    name: item.name || "",
    manufacturer_id: item.manufacturer_id || "",
    description: item.description || "",
    location: item.location || "",
    quantity_on_hand: String(
      numberOrZero(item.quantity_on_hand)
    ),
    unit_cost: String(numberOrZero(item.unit_cost)),
    msrp: String(numberOrZero(item.msrp)),
    active: item.active !== false,
  };
}

function csvEscape(value: unknown) {
  const valueText = String(value ?? "");
  return `"${valueText.replaceAll('"', '""')}"`;
}

function parseCsvLine(line: string) {
  const values: string[] = [];
  let current = "";
  let quoted = false;

  for (let index = 0; index < line.length; index += 1) {
    const char = line[index];

    if (char === '"') {
      if (quoted && line[index + 1] === '"') {
        current += '"';
        index += 1;
      } else {
        quoted = !quoted;
      }
    } else if (char === "," && !quoted) {
      values.push(current);
      current = "";
    } else {
      current += char;
    }
  }

  values.push(current);
  return values.map((value) => value.trim());
}

function saleOrderTotal(
  order: SalesOrder,
  items: SalesOrderItem[]
) {
  const merchandise = items.reduce(
    (sum, item) =>
      sum +
      numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
        numberOrZero(item.unit_price),
    0
  );

  return (
    merchandise +
    numberOrZero(order.freight_amount) +
    numberOrZero(order.adjustment_amount) +
    numberOrZero(order.tax_amount)
  );
}

function paymentNetTotal(payments: Payment[]) {
  return payments.reduce(
    (sum, payment) => sum + numberOrZero(payment.amount),
    0
  );
}

function vendorFreightTotal(rows: Array<{ amount: number | string }>) {
  return rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + numberOrZero(row.amount), 0);
}

function buildVendorFreightDrafts(
  items: Array<{ manufacturer_id: string | null }>,
  existing: VendorFreight[],
  legacyFreight = 0
): VendorFreightDraft[] {
  const ids = Array.from(
    new Set(items.map((item) => item.manufacturer_id || "").filter(Boolean))
  );

  const hasExistingAmount = existing.some((row) => numberOrZero(row.amount) !== 0);

  return ids.map((manufacturerId, index) => {
    const match = existing.find((row) => row.manufacturer_id === manufacturerId);
    const carryLegacy = !hasExistingAmount && legacyFreight > 0 && index === 0;
    return {
      manufacturer_id: manufacturerId,
      amount: String(match ? numberOrZero(match.amount) : carryLegacy ? legacyFreight : 0),
      notes: match?.notes || (carryLegacy && ids.length > 1 ? "Carried from quote total. Reallocate freight by vendor before finalizing." : ""),
    };
  });
}

function newLocalId() {
  return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
}

function blankQuoteItem(sortOrder = 0): QuoteItem {
  return {
    local_id: newLocalId(),
    manufacturer_id: "",
    sort_order: sortOrder,
    quantity: "1",
    image_url: "",
    sku: "",
    description: "",
    finish: "",
    fabric_name: "",
    grade: "",
    additional_details: "",
    msrp_at_grade: 0,
    discount_pct: 0,
    unit_price: 0,
    purchasing_factor_snapshot: null,
    tariff_pct_snapshot: 0,
    surcharge_pct_snapshot: 0,
    expected_unit_cost: null,
    commissionable: true,
  };
}

function calculateQuoteItem(
  item: QuoteItem,
  manufacturer?: Manufacturer
): QuoteItem {
  const msrp = numberOrZero(item.msrp_at_grade);
  const discount = numberOrZero(item.discount_pct);
  const factor =
    item.purchasing_factor_snapshot ??
    manufacturer?.purchasing_factor ??
    null;
  const tariff = numberOrZero(
    item.tariff_pct_snapshot ??
      manufacturer?.tariff_pct ??
      0
  );
  const surcharge = numberOrZero(
    item.surcharge_pct_snapshot ??
      manufacturer?.surcharge_pct ??
      0
  );

  const unitPrice = msrp * (1 - discount / 100);
  const expectedCost =
    factor == null
      ? null
      : msrp *
        Number(factor) *
        (1 + tariff / 100 + surcharge / 100);

  return {
    ...item,
    unit_price: Math.max(0, unitPrice),
    expected_unit_cost:
      expectedCost == null ? null : Math.max(0, expectedCost),
  };
}

}

function saleItemToDraft(
  item: SalesOrderItem
): SalesOrderItemDraft {
  return {
    id: item.id,
    local_id: item.id || newLocalId(),
    source_quote_item_id: item.source_quote_item_id,
    manufacturer_id: item.manufacturer_id || "",
    sort_order: item.sort_order,
    quantity: String(item.quantity || 1),
    image_url: item.image_url || "",
    sku: item.sku || "",
    description: item.description || "",
    finish: item.finish || "",
    fabric_name: item.fabric_name || "",
    grade: item.grade || "",
    additional_details: item.additional_details || "",
    msrp_at_grade: numberOrZero(item.msrp_at_grade),
    discount_pct: numberOrZero(item.discount_pct),
    unit_price: numberOrZero(item.unit_price),
    purchasing_factor_snapshot:
      item.purchasing_factor_snapshot == null
        ? null
        : Number(item.purchasing_factor_snapshot),
    tariff_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
      item.tariff_pct_snapshot
    ),
    surcharge_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
      item.surcharge_pct_snapshot
    ),
    expected_unit_cost:
      item.expected_unit_cost == null
        ? null
        : Number(item.expected_unit_cost),
    acknowledged_unit_cost:
      item.acknowledged_unit_cost == null
        ? null
        : Number(item.acknowledged_unit_cost),
    commissionable: item.commissionable !== false,
    fulfillment_method: item.fulfillment_method,
  };
}

function calculateSaleItem(
  item: SalesOrderItemDraft,
  manufacturer?: Manufacturer

  const msrp = numberOrZero(item.msrp_at_grade);
  const discount = numberOrZero(item.discount_pct);

    item.purchasing_factor_snapshot ??
    manufacturer?.purchasing_factor ??
    null;
  const tariff = numberOrZero(
    item.tariff_pct_snapshot ?? manufacturer?.tariff_pct ?? 0
  );
  const surcharge = numberOrZero(
    item.surcharge_pct_snapshot ??
      manufacturer?.surcharge_pct ??
      0
  );

  const unitPrice = msrp * (1 - discount / 100);
  const expectedCost =
    factor == null
      ? null
      : msrp *
        Number(factor) *
        (1 + tariff / 100 + surcharge / 100);

  return {
    ...item,
    unit_price: Math.max(0, unitPrice),
    expected_unit_cost:
      expectedCost == null ? null : Math.max(0, expectedCost),
  };
}

      return;
    }

    setManufacturersLoading(true);

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("manufacturers")
      .select(manufacturerColumns)
      .order("name", { ascending: true });

    if (error) {
      setMessage(`Manufacturer error: ${error.message}`);
      setManufacturersLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    setManufacturers((data || []) as Manufacturer[]);
    setManufacturersLoading(false);
  }, [supabase, session?.user?.id]);

  const loadQuotes = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!supabase || !session?.user?.id) {
      setQuotes([]);
      setQuoteItemsSummary({});
      return;
    }

    setQuotesLoading(true);

    const { data: quoteData, error: quoteError } = await supabase
      .from("quotes")
      .select(quoteColumns)
      .order("quote_number", { ascending: false });

    if (quoteError) {
      setMessage(`Quote error: ${quoteError.message}`);
      setQuotesLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const loadedQuotes = (quoteData || []) as Quote[];
    setQuotes(loadedQuotes);

    if (loadedQuotes.length === 0) {
      setQuoteItemsSummary({});
      setQuotesLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const { data: itemData, error: itemError } = await supabase
      .from("quote_items")
      .select(quoteItemColumns)
      .in(
        "quote_id",
        loadedQuotes.map((quote) => quote.id)
      )
      .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

    if (itemError) {
      setMessage(`Quote item error: ${itemError.message}`);
      setQuotesLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const grouped: Record<string, QuoteItem[]> = {};

    for (const rawItem of itemData || []) {
      const item = rawItem as Omit<QuoteItem, "local_id"> & {
        local_id?: string;
      };
      const quoteId = item.quote_id || "";
      if (!grouped[quoteId]) grouped[quoteId] = [];
      grouped[quoteId].push({
        ...item,
        local_id: item.id || newLocalId(),
        manufacturer_id: item.manufacturer_id || "",
        image_url: item.image_url || "",
        sku: item.sku || "",
        description: item.description || "",
        finish: item.finish || "",
        fabric_name: item.fabric_name || "",
        grade: item.grade || "",
        additional_details: item.additional_details || "",
        msrp_at_grade: numberOrZero(item.msrp_at_grade),
        discount_pct: numberOrZero(item.discount_pct),
        unit_price: numberOrZero(item.unit_price),
        purchasing_factor_snapshot:
          item.purchasing_factor_snapshot == null
            ? null
            : Number(item.purchasing_factor_snapshot),
        tariff_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
          item.tariff_pct_snapshot
        ),
        surcharge_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
          item.surcharge_pct_snapshot
        ),
        expected_unit_cost:
          item.expected_unit_cost == null
            ? null
            : Number(item.expected_unit_cost),
        quantity: String(numberOrZero(item.quantity) || 1),
        sort_order: numberOrZero(item.sort_order),
        commissionable: item.commissionable !== false,
      });
    }

    setQuoteItemsSummary(grouped);
    setQuotesLoading(false);
  }, [supabase, session?.user?.id]);

  const loadSalesOrders = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!supabase || !session?.user?.id) {
      setSalesOrders([]);
      setSalesItemsSummary({});
      return;
    }

    setSalesLoading(true);

    const { data: orderData, error: orderError } = await supabase
      .from("sales_orders")

      .order("sale_number", { ascending: false });

    if (orderError) {
      setMessage(`Sales order error: ${orderError.message}`);
      setSalesLoading(false);

    }

    const loadedOrders = (orderData || []) as SalesOrder[];
    setSalesOrders(loadedOrders);

    if (loadedOrders.length === 0) {
      setSalesItemsSummary({});
      setSalesLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const { data: itemData, error: itemError } = await supabase
      .from("sales_order_items")
      .select(salesOrderItemColumns)
      .in(
        "sales_order_id",
        loadedOrders.map((order) => order.id)
      )
      .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

    if (itemError) {
      setMessage(`Sales item error: ${itemError.message}`);
      setSalesLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const grouped: Record<string, SalesOrderItem[]> = {};
    ((itemData || []) as SalesOrderItem[]).forEach((item) => {
      if (!grouped[item.sales_order_id]) {
        grouped[item.sales_order_id] = [];
      }
      grouped[item.sales_order_id].push(item);
    });

    setSalesItemsSummary(grouped);
    setSalesLoading(false);
  }, [supabase, session?.user?.id]);


  const loadPurchaseOrders = useCallback(async () => {

    if (itemError) {
      setMessage(`PO item error: ${itemError.message}`);

  const loadInventoryItems = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!supabase || !session?.user?.id) {
      setInventoryItems([]);

    }

    setInventoryLoading(true);

    const { data, error } = await supabase

      setMessage(`Inventory error: ${error.message}`);

    setInventoryItems((data || []) as InventoryItem[]);

  }, [supabase, session?.user?.id]);

  const loadInventoryTags = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!supabase || !session?.user?.id) {
      setInventoryTags([]);
      return;
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("inventory_tags")
      .select(inventoryTagColumns)
      .order("name", { ascending: true });

    if (error) {
      setMessage(`Inventory tag error: ${error.message}`);
      return;
    }

    setInventoryTags((data || []) as InventoryTag[]);
  }, [supabase, session?.user?.id]);

  const loadInventoryItemDetails = useCallback(
    async (inventoryItemId: string) => {
      if (!supabase || !inventoryItemId) return;

      const [scanResult, itemTagResult, movementResult] =
        await Promise.all([
          supabase
            .from("inventory_scan_codes")
            .select(inventoryScanCodeColumns)
            .eq("inventory_item_id", inventoryItemId)
            .order("created_at", { ascending: true }),
          supabase
            .from("inventory_item_tags")
            .select("tag_id")
            .eq("inventory_item_id", inventoryItemId),
          supabase
            .from("inventory_movements")
            .select(inventoryMovementColumns)
            .eq("inventory_item_id", inventoryItemId)
            .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
            .limit(100),
        ]);

      if (scanResult.error) {
        setMessage(
          `Could not load scan codes: ${scanResult.error.message}`
        );
        return;
      }

      if (itemTagResult.error) {
        setMessage(
          `Could not load item tags: ${itemTagResult.error.message}`
        );
        return;
      }

      if (movementResult.error) {
        setMessage(
          `Could not load inventory history: ${movementResult.error.message}`
        );
        return;
      }

      const tagIds = new Set(
        ((itemTagResult.data || []) as Array<{ tag_id: string }>).map(
          (entry) => entry.tag_id
        )
      );

      setInventoryScanCodes(
        (scanResult.data || []) as InventoryScanCode[]
      );
      setInventoryItemTags(
        inventoryTags.filter((tag) => tagIds.has(tag.id))
      );
      setInventoryMovements(
        (movementResult.data || []) as InventoryMovement[]
      );
    },
    [supabase, inventoryTags]
  );

  const loadAccounting = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!supabase || !session?.user?.id) {
      setVendorInvoices([]);
      setExpenses([]);
      return;
    }

    setAccountingLoading(true);

    const [invoiceResult, expenseResult] =
      await Promise.all([
        supabase
          .from("vendor_invoices")
          .select(vendorInvoiceColumns)
          .order("invoice_date", { ascending: false })
          .order("invoice_number", { ascending: false }),
        supabase
          .from("expenses")
          .select(expenseColumns)
          .order("expense_date", { ascending: false })
          .order("expense_number", { ascending: false }),
      ]);

    if (invoiceResult.error) {
      setMessage(
        `Accounting invoice error: ${invoiceResult.error.message}`
      );
      setAccountingLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    if (expenseResult.error) {
      setMessage(
        `Accounting expense error: ${expenseResult.error.message}`
      );
      setAccountingLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    setVendorInvoices(
      (invoiceResult.data || []) as VendorInvoice[]
    );
    setExpenses((expenseResult.data || []) as Expense[]);
    setAccountingLoading(false);
  }, [supabase, session?.user?.id]);

  const loadVendorInvoiceItems = useCallback(
    async (invoiceId: string) => {

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("vendor_invoice_items")

        .eq("vendor_invoice_id", invoiceId)
        .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

      if (error) {

          `Could not load invoice lines: ${error.message}`
        );

      }

      const items =
        (data || []) as VendorInvoiceItem[];
      setVendorInvoiceItems(items);

  );

        .from("purchase_order_items")
        .select(purchaseOrderItemColumns)
        .eq("purchase_order_id", purchaseOrderId)
        .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

      if (error) {
        setMessage(
          `Could not load PO items: ${error.message}`
        );

      }

      const items =
        (data || []) as PurchaseOrderItem[];
      setAccountingPoItems(items);
      return items;

    [supabase]
  );

  const loadDailyCashBatches = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!supabase || !session?.user?.id) {
      setDailyCashBatches([]);
      setDailyCashBatchSummaries({});
      return;
    }

    setDailyCashLoading(true);

    const [batchResult, tenderResult, linkResult] =
      await Promise.all([
        supabase
          .from("daily_cash_batches")
          .select(dailyCashBatchColumns)
          .order("business_date", { ascending: false })
          .order("batch_number", { ascending: false }),
        supabase
          .from("daily_cash_tender_totals")
          .select(dailyCashTenderTotalColumns),
        supabase
          .from("daily_cash_batch_payments")
          .select(dailyCashBatchPaymentColumns),
      ]);

    if (batchResult.error) {
      setMessage(
        `Daily Cash error: ${batchResult.error.message}`
      );
      setDailyCashLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    if (tenderResult.error) {
      setMessage(
        `Daily Cash totals error: ${tenderResult.error.message}`
      );
      setDailyCashLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    if (linkResult.error) {
      setMessage(
        `Daily Cash payment-link error: ${linkResult.error.message}`
      );
      setDailyCashLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const batches =
      (batchResult.data || []) as DailyCashBatch[];
    const tenders =
      (tenderResult.data || []) as DailyCashTenderTotal[];
    const links =
      (linkResult.data || []) as DailyCashBatchPayment[];

    const summaries: Record<
      string,
      { total: number; paymentCount: number }
    > = {};

    batches.forEach((batch) => {
      summaries[batch.id] = {
        total: tenders
          .filter(
            (tender) =>
              tender.daily_cash_batch_id === batch.id
          )
          .reduce(
            (sum, tender) =>
              sum + numberOrZero(tender.system_amount),
            0
          ),
        paymentCount: links.filter(
          (link) =>
            link.daily_cash_batch_id === batch.id
        ).length,
      };
    });

    setDailyCashBatches(batches);
    setDailyCashBatchSummaries(summaries);
    setDailyCashLoading(false);
  }, [supabase, session?.user?.id]);

  const loadDailyCashBatchDetails = useCallback(
    async (batch: DailyCashBatch) => {
      if (!supabase) return;

      setDailyCashDetailLoading(true);

      const [linkResult, tenderResult] = await Promise.all([
        supabase
          .from("daily_cash_batch_payments")
          .select(dailyCashBatchPaymentColumns)
          .eq("daily_cash_batch_id", batch.id)
          .order("created_at", { ascending: true }),
        supabase
          .from("daily_cash_tender_totals")
          .select(dailyCashTenderTotalColumns)
          .eq("daily_cash_batch_id", batch.id)
          .order("payment_method", { ascending: true }),
      ]);

      if (linkResult.error) {
        setMessage(
          `Could not load Daily Cash payments: ${linkResult.error.message}`
        );
        setDailyCashDetailLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      if (tenderResult.error) {
        setMessage(
          `Could not load Daily Cash totals: ${tenderResult.error.message}`
        );
        setDailyCashDetailLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const links =
        (linkResult.data || []) as DailyCashBatchPayment[];
      const paymentIds = links.map((link) => link.payment_id);

      let loadedPayments: Payment[] = [];

      if (paymentIds.length > 0) {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from("payments")
          .select(paymentColumns)
          .in("id", paymentIds)
          .order("posted_at", { ascending: true });

        if (error) {
          setMessage(
            `Could not load Daily Cash payment details: ${error.message}`
          );
          setDailyCashDetailLoading(false);
          return;
        }

        loadedPayments = (data || []) as Payment[];
      }

      const tenders =
        (tenderResult.data || []) as DailyCashTenderTotal[];

      const drafts: Record<string, DailyCashTenderDraft> = {};
      paymentMethods.forEach((method) => {
        const tender = tenders.find(
          (entry) => entry.payment_method === method
        );

        const systemAmount = loadedPayments
          .filter(
            (payment) =>
              payment.payment_method === method
          )
          .reduce(
            (sum, payment) =>
              sum + numberOrZero(payment.amount),
            0
          );

        drafts[method] = {
          actual_amount: String(
            tender
              ? numberOrZero(tender.actual_amount)
              : systemAmount
          ),
          notes: tender?.notes || "",
        };
      });

      setDailyCashBatchPayments(loadedPayments);
      setDailyCashTenderTotals(tenders);
      setDailyCashTenderDrafts(drafts);
      setDailyCashNotes(batch.notes || "");
      setDailyCashDetailLoading(false);
    },
    [supabase]
  );

  const loadSalePayments = useCallback(
    async (salesOrderId: string) => {
      if (!supabase || !salesOrderId) {
        setPayments([]);
        return;
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("payments")
        .select(paymentColumns)
        .eq("sales_order_id", salesOrderId)
        .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

      if (error) {
        setMessage(`Payment error: ${error.message}`);
        return;
      }

      setPayments((data || []) as Payment[]);
    },
    [supabase]
  );


  useEffect(() => {
    loadProfile();
    loadTeam();
    loadClients();
    loadManufacturers();
    loadQuotes();
    loadSalesOrders();
    loadPurchaseOrders();
    loadInventoryItems();
    loadInventoryTags();
    loadDailyCashBatches();
    loadAccounting();
  }, [
    loadProfile,
    loadTeam,
    loadClients,
    loadManufacturers,
    loadQuotes,
    loadSalesOrders,
    loadPurchaseOrders,
    loadInventoryItems,
    loadInventoryTags,
    loadDailyCashBatches,
    loadAccounting,
  ]);

  const filteredClients = useMemo(() => {
    const term = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!term) return clients;

    return clients.filter((client) => {
      const salesperson =
        team.find((person) => person.id === client.assigned_user_id)
          ?.display_name || "";

      const searchable = [
        getClientName(client),
        client.email,
        client.phone,
        client.city,
        client.state,
        client.zip_code,
        client.street_address,
        salesperson,
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase();

      return searchable.includes(term);
    });
  }, [clients, search, team]);

  const clientStats = useMemo(() => {
    const withEmail = clients.filter((client) => client.email).length;
    const withPhone = clients.filter((client) => client.phone).length;

    const states = new Set(
      clients
        .map((client) => client.state)
        .filter((state): state is string => Boolean(state))
    );

    return {
      total: clients.length,
      withEmail,
      withPhone,
      states: states.size,
    };
  }, [clients]);

  const filteredManufacturers = useMemo(() => {
    const term = manufacturerSearch.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!term) return manufacturers;

    return manufacturers.filter((manufacturer) =>
      [
        manufacturer.name,
        manufacturer.account_number,
        manufacturer.orders_email,
        manufacturer.phone,
        manufacturer.terms,
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(term)
    );
  }, [manufacturers, manufacturerSearch]);

  const manufacturerStats = useMemo(() => {
    const active = manufacturers.filter(
      (manufacturer) => manufacturer.active !== false
    ).length;

    const withTariff = manufacturers.filter(
      (manufacturer) => Number(manufacturer.tariff_pct || 0) > 0
    ).length;

    return {
      total: manufacturers.length,
      active,
      withTariff,
    };
  }, [manufacturers]);

  const filteredQuotes = useMemo(() => {
    const term = quoteSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    const visibleQuotes = quotes.filter((quote) =>
      showArchivedQuotes
        ? quote.status === "Archived"
        : quote.status !== "Archived"
    );

    if (!term) return visibleQuotes;

    return visibleQuotes.filter((quote) => {
      const client = clients.find(
        (client) => client.id === quote.client_id
      );
      const salesperson = team.find(
        (person) => person.id === quote.salesperson_user_id
      );

      return [
        quote.quote_number.toString(),
        quote.status,
        quote.customer_po,
        client ? getClientName(client) : "",
        salesperson?.display_name || "",
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(term);
    });
  }, [
    quotes,
    quoteSearch,
    clients,
    team,
    showArchivedQuotes,
  ]);

  const quoteStats = useMemo(() => {
    const activeQuotes = quotes.filter(
      (quote) => quote.status !== "Archived"
    );
    const archived = quotes.filter(
      (quote) => quote.status === "Archived"
    ).length;
    const drafts = activeQuotes.filter(
      (quote) => quote.status === "Draft"
    ).length;

    const totalValue = activeQuotes.reduce((sum, quote) => {
      const items = quoteItemsSummary[quote.id] || [];
      const merchandise = items.reduce(
        (itemSum, item) =>
          itemSum +
          numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
            numberOrZero(item.unit_price),
        0
      );

      return (
        sum +
        merchandise +
        numberOrZero(quote.freight_amount) +
        numberOrZero(quote.adjustment_amount)
      );
    }, 0);

    return {
      total: activeQuotes.length,
      drafts,
      archived,
      totalValue,
    };
  }, [quotes, quoteItemsSummary]);

  const filteredSalesOrders = useMemo(() => {
    const term = salesSearch.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!term) return salesOrders;

    return salesOrders.filter((order) => {
      const salesperson = team.find(
        (person) => person.id === order.salesperson_user_id
      );

      return [
        order.sale_number.toString(),
        order.status,
        order.customer_po,
        clientNameById(order.client_id),
        salesperson?.display_name || "",
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(term);
    });
  }, [salesOrders, salesSearch, clients, team]);

  const salesStats = useMemo(() => {
    const open = salesOrders.filter(
      (order) => order.status !== "Closed"
    ).length;

    const totalValue = salesOrders.reduce((sum, order) => {
      const items = salesItemsSummary[order.id] || [];
      const merchandise = items.reduce(
        (itemSum, item) =>
          itemSum +
          numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
            numberOrZero(item.unit_price),
        0
      );

      return (
        sum +
        merchandise +
        numberOrZero(order.freight_amount) +
        numberOrZero(order.adjustment_amount) +
        numberOrZero(order.tax_amount)
      );
    }, 0);

    return {
      total: salesOrders.length,
      open,
      totalValue,
    };
  }, [salesOrders, salesItemsSummary]);

  const filteredPurchaseOrders = useMemo(() => {
    const term = purchaseOrderSearch.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!term) return purchaseOrders;

    return purchaseOrders.filter((order) => {
      const maker = manufacturers.find(
        (manufacturer) => manufacturer.id === order.manufacturer_id
      );
      const sale = salesOrders.find(
        (entry) => entry.id === order.sales_order_id
      );

      return [
        order.po_number.toString(),
        order.status,
        order.acknowledgement_number,
        order.carrier,
        order.tracking_number,
        maker?.name || "",
        sale?.sale_number?.toString() || "",
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(term);
    });
  }, [
    purchaseOrders,
    purchaseOrderSearch,
    manufacturers,
    salesOrders,
  ]);

  const purchaseOrderStats = useMemo(() => {
    const open = purchaseOrders.filter(
      (order) => order.status !== "Closed"
    ).length;

    const inProcess = purchaseOrders.filter(
      (order) =>
        order.status !== "Draft" &&
        order.status !== "Closed"
    ).length;

    const expectedCost = purchaseOrders.reduce((sum, order) => {
      const items = purchaseOrderItemsSummary[order.id] || [];
      const merchandise = items.reduce(
        (itemSum, item) =>
          itemSum +
          numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
            numberOrZero(
              item.acknowledged_unit_cost ?? item.unit_cost
            ),
        0
      );

      return sum + merchandise + numberOrZero(order.freight_amount);
    }, 0);

    return {
      total: purchaseOrders.length,
      open,
      inProcess,
      expectedCost,
    };
  }, [purchaseOrders, purchaseOrderItemsSummary]);

  const filteredVendorInvoices = useMemo(() => {
    const term = accountingSearch.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!term) return vendorInvoices;

    return vendorInvoices.filter((invoice) => {
      const po = purchaseOrders.find(
        (order) => order.id === invoice.purchase_order_id
      );

      return [
        invoice.invoice_number,
        invoice.vendor_invoice_number,
        invoice.status,
        manufacturerName(invoice.manufacturer_id),
        po ? `PO ${po.po_number}` : "",
      ]
        .filter((value) => value != null)
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(term);
    });
  }, [
    vendorInvoices,
    accountingSearch,
    purchaseOrders,
    manufacturers,
  ]);

  const filteredExpenses = useMemo(() => {
    const term = accountingSearch.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!term) return expenses;

    return expenses.filter((expense) =>
      [
        expense.expense_number,
        expense.payee,
        expense.category,
        expense.description,
        expense.reference,
        manufacturerName(expense.manufacturer_id),
      ]
        .filter((value) => value != null)
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(term)
    );
  }, [expenses, accountingSearch, manufacturers]);

  const accountingStats = useMemo(() => {
    const openInvoices = vendorInvoices.filter(
      (invoice) =>
        invoice.status === "Open" ||
        invoice.status === "Approved"
    );

    const outstanding = openInvoices.reduce(
      (sum, invoice) =>
        sum + numberOrZero(invoice.total_amount),
      0
    );

    const paid = vendorInvoices
      .filter((invoice) => invoice.status === "Paid")
      .reduce(
        (sum, invoice) =>
          sum + numberOrZero(invoice.total_amount),
        0
      );

    const expenseTotal = expenses.reduce(
      (sum, expense) =>
        sum + numberOrZero(expense.amount),
      0
    );

    return {
      invoices: vendorInvoices.length,
      openInvoices: openInvoices.length,
      outstanding,
      paid,
      expenses: expenses.length,
      expenseTotal,
    };
  }, [vendorInvoices, expenses]);

  const selectedInvoiceMerchandise = useMemo(
    () =>
      vendorInvoiceItems.reduce(
        (sum, item) =>
          sum +
          numberOrZero(
            item.extended_cost ||
              numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
                numberOrZero(item.invoiced_unit_cost)
          ),
        0
      ),
    [vendorInvoiceItems]
  );

  const selectedInvoiceExpectedPoCost = useMemo(
    () =>
      accountingPoItems.reduce(
        (sum, item) =>
          sum +
          numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
            numberOrZero(item.unit_cost),
        0
      ),
    [accountingPoItems]
  );

  const selectedInvoiceAcknowledgedPoCost = useMemo(
    () =>
      accountingPoItems.reduce(
        (sum, item) =>
          sum +
          numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
            numberOrZero(
              item.acknowledged_unit_cost ?? item.unit_cost
            ),

      ),
    [accountingPoItems]
  );

  const selectedInvoiceTotal = useMemo(
    () =>
      selectedInvoiceMerchandise +

      numberOrZero(vendorInvoiceForm.other_amount),
    [

      vendorInvoiceForm.tax_amount,
      vendorInvoiceForm.other_amount,
    ]

  function manufacturerName(id: string | null | undefined) {
    if (!id) return "No manufacturer";
    return (
      manufacturers.find((manufacturer) => manufacturer.id === id)
        ?.name || "Manufacturer"
    );
  }

  function saleNumberForId(id: string | null | undefined) {
    if (!id) return "";
    const sale = salesOrders.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
    return sale ? `#${sale.sale_number}` : "";
  }

  const filteredInventoryItems = useMemo(() => {
    const term = inventorySearch.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!term) return inventoryItems;

    return inventoryItems.filter((item) => {
      const manufacturer = manufacturers.find(
        (entry) => entry.id === item.manufacturer_id
      );

      return [
        item.sku,
        item.name,
        item.description,
        item.location,
        manufacturer?.name || "",
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(term);
    });
  }, [inventoryItems, inventorySearch, manufacturers]);

  const inventoryStats = useMemo(() => {
    const active = inventoryItems.filter(
      (item) => item.active !== false
    ).length;

    const units = inventoryItems.reduce(
      (sum, item) =>
        sum + numberOrZero(item.quantity_on_hand),
      0
    );

    const costValue = inventoryItems.reduce(
      (sum, item) =>
        sum +
        numberOrZero(item.quantity_on_hand) *
          numberOrZero(item.unit_cost),
      0
    );

    const retailValue = inventoryItems.reduce(
      (sum, item) =>
        sum +
        numberOrZero(item.quantity_on_hand) *
          numberOrZero(item.msrp),
      0
    );

    return {
      total: inventoryItems.length,
      active,
      units,
      costValue,
      retailValue,
    };
  }, [inventoryItems]);

  function inventoryManufacturerName(
    manufacturerId: string | null | undefined
  ) {

    return (

  const dailyCashStats = useMemo(() => {

      (batch) => batch.status === "Posted"
    ).length;
    const open = dailyCashBatches.filter(
      (batch) => batch.status === "Open"
    ).length;

      .filter((batch) => batch.status === "Posted")
      .reduce(
        (sum, batch) =>
          sum +
          numberOrZero(

  async function signIn() {
    if (!supabase) return;

    if (!email || !password) {
      setMessage("Enter your email and password.");
      return;
    }

    setMessage("Signing in...");

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email,
      password,
    });

    if (error) {
      setMessage(error.message);
      return;
    }

    setPassword("");
    setMessage("");
  }

  async function sendMagicLink() {
    if (!supabase) return;

    if (!email) {
      setMessage("Enter your work email first.");
      return;
    }

    setMessage("Sending sign-in link...");

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({
      email,
      options: {
        emailRedirectTo: window.location.origin,
        shouldCreateUser: false,
      },
    });

    setMessage(
      error
        ? error.message
        : "Check your email for the newest sign-in link."
    );
  }

  async function saveClient() {
    if (!supabase) return;

    const cleanName = clientForm.client_name.trim();

    if (!cleanName) {
      setMessage("Client name is required.");
      return;
    }

    setSavingClient(true);
    setMessage("");

    const payload = {
      client_name: cleanName,
      phone: clientForm.phone.trim() || null,
      email: clientForm.email.trim() || null,
      street_address: clientForm.street_address.trim() || null,
      city: clientForm.city.trim() || null,
      state: clientForm.state.trim().toUpperCase() || null,
      zip_code: clientForm.zip_code.trim() || null,
      assigned_user_id: clientForm.assigned_user_id || null,
      notes: clientForm.notes.trim() || null,
      tax_exempt: clientForm.tax_exempt,
      active: true,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    if (clientMode === "new") {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("clients")
        .insert(payload)
        .select(clientColumns)
        .single();

      if (error) {
        setMessage(`Could not create client: ${error.message}`);
        setSavingClient(false);
        return;
      }

      setSelectedClient(data as Client);
      setClientMode("view");
      setClientForm(clientToForm(data as Client));
      setMessage(`${cleanName} was added.`);
    } else if (clientMode === "edit" && selectedClient) {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("clients")
        .update(payload)
        .eq("id", selectedClient.id)
        .select(clientColumns)
        .single();

      if (error) {
        setMessage(`Could not save client: ${error.message}`);
        setSavingClient(false);
        return;
      }

      setSelectedClient(data as Client);
      setClientMode("view");
      setClientForm(clientToForm(data as Client));
      setMessage(`${cleanName} was updated.`);
    }

    await loadClients();
    setSavingClient(false);
  }

  async function deleteClient() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedClient) return;

    const name = getClientName(selectedClient);
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Delete ${name}? This cannot be undone.`
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    setSavingClient(true);
    setMessage("");

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from("clients")
      .delete()
      .eq("id", selectedClient.id);

    if (error) {
      setMessage(`Could not delete client: ${error.message}`);
      setSavingClient(false);
      return;
    }

    setClientModalOpen(false);
    setSelectedClient(null);
    await loadClients();
    setSavingClient(false);
    setMessage(`${name} was deleted.`);
  }

  async function saveManufacturer() {
    if (!supabase) return;

    const name = manufacturerForm.name.trim();

    if (!name) {
      setMessage("Manufacturer name is required.");
      return;
    }

    setSavingManufacturer(true);
    setMessage("");

    const numericOrNull = (value: string) => {
      if (!value.trim()) return null;
      const parsed = Number(value);
      return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
    };

    const payload = {
      name,
      account_number:
        manufacturerForm.account_number.trim() || null,
      orders_email:
        manufacturerForm.orders_email.trim() || null,
      phone: manufacturerForm.phone.trim() || null,
      terms: manufacturerForm.terms.trim() || null,
      purchasing_factor: numericOrNull(
        manufacturerForm.purchasing_factor
      ),
      default_discount_pct: numericOrNull(
        manufacturerForm.default_discount_pct
      ),
      tariff_pct: numericOrNull(
        manufacturerForm.tariff_pct
      ),
      surcharge_pct: numericOrNull(
        manufacturerForm.surcharge_pct
      ),
      notes: manufacturerForm.notes.trim() || null,
      active: manufacturerForm.active,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    if (manufacturerMode === "new") {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("manufacturers")
        .insert(payload)
        .select(manufacturerColumns)
        .single();

      if (error) {
        setMessage(
          `Could not create manufacturer: ${error.message}`
        );
        setSavingManufacturer(false);
        return;
      }

      setSelectedManufacturer(data as Manufacturer);
      setManufacturerForm(
        manufacturerToForm(data as Manufacturer)
      );
      setManufacturerMode("view");
      setMessage(`${name} was added.`);
    } else if (
      manufacturerMode === "edit" &&
      selectedManufacturer
    ) {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("manufacturers")
        .update(payload)
        .eq("id", selectedManufacturer.id)
        .select(manufacturerColumns)
        .single();

      if (error) {
        setMessage(
          `Could not save manufacturer: ${error.message}`
        );
        setSavingManufacturer(false);
        return;
      }

      setSelectedManufacturer(data as Manufacturer);
      setManufacturerForm(
        manufacturerToForm(data as Manufacturer)
      );
      setManufacturerMode("view");
      setMessage(`${name} was updated.`);
    }

    await loadManufacturers();
    setSavingManufacturer(false);
  }

  async function openQuote(quote: Quote) {
    if (!supabase) return;

    setSelectedQuote(quote);
    setQuoteForm({
      client_id: quote.client_id,
      salesperson_user_id: quote.salesperson_user_id || "",
      status: quote.status || "Draft",
      quote_date: quote.quote_date || todayISO(),
      expiration_date: quote.expiration_date || "",
      customer_po: quote.customer_po || "",
      ship_to_name: quote.ship_to_name || "",
      ship_to_contact: quote.ship_to_contact || "",
      ship_to_phone: quote.ship_to_phone || "",
      ship_to_address: quote.ship_to_address || "",
      ship_to_city: quote.ship_to_city || "",
      ship_to_state: quote.ship_to_state || "",
      ship_to_zip: quote.ship_to_zip || "",
      delivery_notes: quote.delivery_notes || "",
      notes: quote.notes || "",
      freight_amount: numberOrZero(
        quote.freight_amount
      ).toString(),
      adjustment_amount: numberOrZero(
        quote.adjustment_amount
      ).toString(),
    });

    setQuoteEditorOpen(true);
    setMessage("");

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("quote_items")
      .select(quoteItemColumns)
      .eq("quote_id", quote.id)
      .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

    if (error) {
      setMessage(`Could not load quote items: ${error.message}`);
      return;
    }

    const loadedItems = (data || []).map((rawItem) => {
      const item = rawItem as Omit<QuoteItem, "local_id">;
      return {
        ...item,
        local_id: item.id || newLocalId(),
        manufacturer_id: item.manufacturer_id || "",
        image_url: item.image_url || "",
        sku: item.sku || "",
        description: item.description || "",
        finish: item.finish || "",
        fabric_name: item.fabric_name || "",
        grade: item.grade || "",
        additional_details: item.additional_details || "",
        quantity: String(numberOrZero(item.quantity) || 1),
        sort_order: numberOrZero(item.sort_order),
        msrp_at_grade: numberOrZero(item.msrp_at_grade),
        discount_pct: numberOrZero(item.discount_pct),
        unit_price: numberOrZero(item.unit_price),
        purchasing_factor_snapshot:
          item.purchasing_factor_snapshot == null
            ? null
            : Number(item.purchasing_factor_snapshot),
        tariff_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
          item.tariff_pct_snapshot
        ),
        surcharge_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
          item.surcharge_pct_snapshot
        ),
        expected_unit_cost:
          item.expected_unit_cost == null
            ? null
            : Number(item.expected_unit_cost),
        commissionable: item.commissionable !== false,
      } as QuoteItem;
    });

    setQuoteItems(
      loadedItems.length > 0
        ? loadedItems
        : [blankQuoteItem(0)]
    );
  }
