  function removeQuoteItem(localId: string) {
    setQuoteItems((current) => {
      const next = current.filter(
        (item) => item.local_id !== localId
      );
      return next.length > 0 ? next : [blankQuoteItem(0)];
    });
  }

  function updateQuoteItem(
    localId: string,
    field: keyof QuoteItem,
    value: string | number | boolean | null
  ) {
    setQuoteItems((current) =>
      current.map((existing) => {
        if (existing.local_id !== localId) return existing;

        let next = {
          ...existing,
          [field]: value,
        } as QuoteItem;

        if (field === "manufacturer_id") {
          const manufacturer = manufacturers.find(
            (manufacturer) => manufacturer.id === value
          );

          next = {
            ...next,
            manufacturer_id: String(value || ""),
            discount_pct: numberOrZero(
              manufacturer?.default_discount_pct
            ),
            purchasing_factor_snapshot:
              manufacturer?.purchasing_factor == null
                ? null
                : Number(manufacturer.purchasing_factor),
            tariff_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
              manufacturer?.tariff_pct
            ),
            surcharge_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
              manufacturer?.surcharge_pct
            ),
          };

          return calculateQuoteItem(next, manufacturer);
        }

        if (
          field === "msrp_at_grade" ||
          field === "discount_pct" ||
          field === "purchasing_factor_snapshot" ||
          field === "tariff_pct_snapshot" ||
          field === "surcharge_pct_snapshot"
        ) {
          const manufacturer = manufacturers.find(
            (manufacturer) =>
              manufacturer.id === next.manufacturer_id
          );
          return calculateQuoteItem(next, manufacturer);
        }

        return next;
      })
    );
  }

  const quoteEditorTotals = useMemo(() => {
    const merchandise = quoteItems.reduce(
      (sum, item) =>
        sum +
        numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
          numberOrZero(item.unit_price),
      0
    );

    const expectedCost = quoteItems.reduce(
      (sum, item) =>
        sum +
        numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
          numberOrZero(item.expected_unit_cost),
      0
    );

    const freight = numberOrZero(quoteForm.freight_amount);
    const adjustment = numberOrZero(
      quoteForm.adjustment_amount
    );
    const total = merchandise + freight + adjustment;
    const marginDollar = merchandise - expectedCost;
    const marginPct =
      merchandise > 0
        ? (marginDollar / merchandise) * 100
        : 0;

    return {
      merchandise,
      expectedCost,
      freight,
      adjustment,
      total,
      marginDollar,
      marginPct,
    };
  }, [quoteItems, quoteForm.freight_amount, quoteForm.adjustment_amount]);

  function pdfEscape(value: string) {
    return value
      .normalize("NFKD")
      .replace(/[^\x20-\x7E]/g, "")
      .replace(/\\/g, "\\\\")
      .replace(/\(/g, "\\(")
      .replace(/\)/g, "\\)");
  }

  function pdfSafe(value: string | null | undefined) {
    return (value || "")
      .normalize("NFKD")
      .replace(/[^\x20-\x7E]/g, "")
      .trim();
  }

  function pdfTextWidth(value: string, size: number, bold = false) {
    return pdfSafe(value).length * size * (bold ? 0.56 : 0.51);
  }

  function wrapPdfWidth(
    value: string,
    maxWidth: number,
    size: number,
    bold = false
  ) {
    const words = pdfSafe(value).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (words.length === 0) return [""];

    const lines: string[] = [];
    let current = words[0];

    for (const word of words.slice(1)) {
      const candidate = `${current} ${word}`;
      if (pdfTextWidth(candidate, size, bold) <= maxWidth) {
        current = candidate;
      } else {
        lines.push(current);
        current = word;
      }
    }

    lines.push(current);
    return lines;
  }

  function base64ToBinary(value: string) {
    return atob(value);
  }

  async function imageUrlToPdfJpeg(url: string) {
    if (!url) return null;

    try {
      const response = await fetch(url, { mode: "cors" });
      if (!response.ok) return null;
      const blob = await response.blob();
      const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

      const image = await new Promise<HTMLImageElement>((resolve, reject) => {
        const element = new Image();
        element.onload = () => resolve(element);
        element.onerror = reject;
        element.src = objectUrl;
      });

      const maxDimension = 700;
      const scale = Math.min(
        1,
        maxDimension / Math.max(image.naturalWidth, image.naturalHeight)
      );
      const width = Math.max(1, Math.round(image.naturalWidth * scale));
      const height = Math.max(1, Math.round(image.naturalHeight * scale));

      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = width;
      canvas.height = height;
      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      if (!context) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
        return null;
      }

      context.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
      context.drawImage(image, 0, 0, width, height);
      const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL("image/jpeg", 0.9);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);

      const base64 = dataUrl.split(",")[1];
      if (!base64) return null;

      return {
        binary: base64ToBinary(base64),
        width,
        height,
      };
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  function buildBrandedQuotePdf({
    client,
    salesperson,
    productImages,
  }: {
    client: Client | undefined;
    salesperson: Profile | undefined;
    productImages: Record<
      string,
      { binary: string; width: number; height: number } | null
    >;
  }) {
    if (!selectedQuote) return new Uint8Array();

    const PAGE_W = 612;
    const PAGE_H = 792;
    const MARGIN = 32;
    const FOOTER_TOP = 741;
    const NAVY = [0.035, 0.18, 0.33] as const;
    const BLUE = [0.07, 0.31, 0.5] as const;
    const DARK = [0.10, 0.13, 0.16] as const;
    const MID = [0.38, 0.43, 0.47] as const;
    const LIGHT = [0.91, 0.94, 0.96] as const;

    type PdfImage = {
      name: string;
      binary: string;
      width: number;
      height: number;
    };

    const images: PdfImage[] = [
      {
        name: "Logo",
        binary: base64ToBinary(DP_LOGO_JPEG_BASE64),
        width: DP_LOGO_PIXEL_WIDTH,
        height: DP_LOGO_PIXEL_HEIGHT,
      },
    ];

    const itemImageNames: Record<string, string> = {};
    quoteItems.forEach((item, index) => {
      const image = productImages[item.local_id];
      if (!image) return;
      const name = `P${index + 1}`;
      itemImageNames[item.local_id] = name;
      images.push({ name, ...image });
    });

    const pages: string[][] = [[]];
    let pageIndex = 0;

    const commands = () => pages[pageIndex];
    const topY = (top: number) => PAGE_H - top;

    const color = (rgb: readonly [number, number, number]) =>
      `${rgb[0]} ${rgb[1]} ${rgb[2]}`;

    const textAt = (
      x: number,
      top: number,
      value: string,
      size = 9,
      bold = false,
      rgb: readonly [number, number, number] = DARK,
      align: "left" | "right" = "left"
    ) => {
      const safe = pdfSafe(value);
      const width = pdfTextWidth(safe, size, bold);
      const drawX = align === "right" ? x - width : x;
      commands().push(
        `${color(rgb)} rg BT /${bold ? "F2" : "F1"} ${size} Tf ${drawX.toFixed(
          2
        )} ${(topY(top) - size).toFixed(2)} Td (${pdfEscape(safe)}) Tj ET`
      );
    };

    const lineAt = (
      x1: number,
      top1: number,
      x2: number,
      top2: number,
      width = 0.5,
      rgb: readonly [number, number, number] = MID
    ) => {
      commands().push(
        `${color(rgb)} RG ${width} w ${x1} ${topY(top1)} m ${x2} ${topY(
          top2
        )} l S`
      );
    };

    const fillRect = (
      x: number,
      top: number,
      width: number,
      height: number,
      rgb: readonly [number, number, number]
    ) => {
      commands().push(
        `${color(rgb)} rg ${x} ${(PAGE_H - top - height).toFixed(
          2
        )} ${width} ${height} re f`
      );
    };

    const strokeRect = (
      x: number,
      top: number,
      width: number,
      height: number,
      rgb: readonly [number, number, number] = LIGHT,
      lineWidth = 0.5
    ) => {
      commands().push(
        `${color(rgb)} RG ${lineWidth} w ${x} ${(PAGE_H - top - height).toFixed(
          2
        )} ${width} ${height} re S`
      );
    };

    const drawImage = (
      imageName: string,
      x: number,
      top: number,
      boxW: number,
      boxH: number
    ) => {
      const image = images.find((entry) => entry.name === imageName);
      if (!image) return;
      const scale = Math.min(boxW / image.width, boxH / image.height);
      const width = image.width * scale;
      const height = image.height * scale;
      const drawX = x + (boxW - width) / 2;
      const drawY = PAGE_H - top - boxH + (boxH - height) / 2;
      commands().push(
        `q ${width.toFixed(2)} 0 0 ${height.toFixed(2)} ${drawX.toFixed(
          2
        )} ${drawY.toFixed(2)} cm /Im${imageName} Do Q`
      );
    };

    const drawFooter = () => {
      fillRect(0, FOOTER_TOP, PAGE_W, PAGE_H - FOOTER_TOP, NAVY);

      const salesName = salesperson?.display_name || "Designer’s Patio";
      const salesEmail =
        salesperson?.email || "info@designerspatio.com";
      const salesPhone = salesperson?.phone || "214.217.9997";

      textAt(40, FOOTER_TOP + 10, "SALESPERSON", 6.8, true, [1, 1, 1]);
      textAt(40, FOOTER_TOP + 21, salesName, 7.2, true, [1, 1, 1]);
      textAt(40, FOOTER_TOP + 31, salesEmail, 6.6, false, [1, 1, 1]);
      textAt(40, FOOTER_TOP + 41, salesPhone, 6.6, false, [1, 1, 1]);

      lineAt(222, FOOTER_TOP + 7, 222, 782, 0.5, [0.6, 0.72, 0.8]);
      textAt(242, FOOTER_TOP + 10, "SHOWROOM", 6.8, true, [1, 1, 1]);
      textAt(
        242,
        FOOTER_TOP + 22,
        "2000 N Stemmons Fwy Ste 1D110",
        6.6,
        false,
        [1, 1, 1]
      );
      textAt(242, FOOTER_TOP + 33, "Dallas, TX 75207", 6.6, false, [1, 1, 1]);

      lineAt(430, FOOTER_TOP + 7, 430, 782, 0.5, [0.6, 0.72, 0.8]);
      textAt(450, FOOTER_TOP + 10, "WEBSITE", 6.8, true, [1, 1, 1]);
      textAt(450, FOOTER_TOP + 24, "designerspatio.com", 7, false, [1, 1, 1]);
      textAt(450, FOOTER_TOP + 38, "TO THE TRADE", 6.5, true, [0.8, 0.9, 0.96]);
    };

    const newPage = (continuation = true) => {
      drawFooter();
      pages.push([]);
      pageIndex += 1;
      if (continuation) {
        textAt(MARGIN, 24, "DESIGNER'S PATIO", 10, true, NAVY);
        textAt(
          PAGE_W - MARGIN,
          24,
          `Quote #${selectedQuote.quote_number}`,
          9,
          true,
          NAVY,
          "right"
        );
        lineAt(MARGIN, 43, PAGE_W - MARGIN, 43, 1.1, NAVY);
      }
    };

    const fieldLine = (
      x: number,
      top: number,
      label: string,
      value: string,
      valueX: number,
      maxWidth: number
    ) => {
      textAt(x, top, label.toUpperCase(), 6.7, true, NAVY);
      const wrapped = wrapPdfWidth(value || "-", maxWidth, 7.4);
      wrapped.slice(0, 2).forEach((entry, index) => {
        textAt(valueX, top + index * 9, entry, 7.4, index === 0, DARK);
      });
    };

    const salespersonPhone = salesperson?.phone || "214.217.9997";
    const salespersonEmail =
      salesperson?.email || "info@designerspatio.com";
    const clientName = client ? getClientName(client) : "Unknown client";
    const clientContact = client
      ? [client.first_name, client.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(" ")
      : "";
    const clientCityLine = client
      ? [client.city, client.state, client.zip_code].filter(Boolean).join(" ")
      : "";

    // FIRST PAGE HEADER
    drawImage("Logo", 34, 20, 238, 177);
    textAt(330, 34, "QUOTE", 22, true, NAVY);
    textAt(
      PAGE_W - 34,
      39,
      `Q-${selectedQuote.quote_number}`,
      12,
      true,
      DARK,
      "right"
    );

    fieldLine(330, 77, "Quote number", `Q-${selectedQuote.quote_number}`, 415, 160);
    fieldLine(330, 96, "Quote date", quoteForm.quote_date || "", 415, 160);
    fieldLine(330, 115, "Valid through", quoteForm.expiration_date || "", 415, 160);
    fieldLine(
      330,
      134,
      "Salesperson",
      salesperson?.display_name || "Unassigned",
      415,
      160
    );
    fieldLine(330, 153, "Email", salespersonEmail, 415, 160);
    fieldLine(330, 172, "Phone", salespersonPhone, 415, 160);

    lineAt(MARGIN, 205, PAGE_W - MARGIN, 205, 1.4, NAVY);

    textAt(36, 224, "CLIENT / CONTACT", 10, true, NAVY);
    textAt(326, 224, "SHIP TO", 10, true, NAVY);
    lineAt(306, 218, 306, 360, 0.5, [0.75, 0.79, 0.82]);

    fieldLine(36, 247, "Client", clientName, 112, 175);
    fieldLine(36, 266, "Contact", clientContact || "-", 112, 175);
    fieldLine(36, 285, "Email", client?.email || "-", 112, 175);
    fieldLine(36, 304, "Phone", client?.phone || "-", 112, 175);
    fieldLine(36, 323, "Address", client?.street_address || "-", 112, 175);
    if (clientCityLine) textAt(112, 342, clientCityLine, 7.4, false, DARK);

    fieldLine(326, 247, "Recipient", quoteForm.ship_to_name || "-", 404, 172);
    fieldLine(326, 266, "Contact", quoteForm.ship_to_contact || "-", 404, 172);
    fieldLine(326, 285, "Phone", quoteForm.ship_to_phone || "-", 404, 172);
    fieldLine(326, 304, "Address", quoteForm.ship_to_address || "-", 404, 172);
    const shipCity = [
      quoteForm.ship_to_city,
      quoteForm.ship_to_state,
      quoteForm.ship_to_zip,
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(" ");
    if (shipCity) textAt(404, 323, shipCity, 7.4, false, DARK);
    fieldLine(326, 342, "Delivery notes", quoteForm.delivery_notes || "-", 404, 172);

    let cursorTop = 375;

    const col = {
      x: 32,
      image: 62,
      item: 34,
      sku: 64,
      description: 201,
      qty: 40,
      unit: 73,
      total: 74,
    };
    const tableWidth =
      col.image + col.item + col.sku + col.description + col.qty + col.unit + col.total;

    const drawTableHeader = (top: number) => {
      fillRect(col.x, top, tableWidth, 22, NAVY);
      let x = col.x;
      const headers: Array<[string, number]> = [
        ["IMAGE", col.image],
        ["ITEM", col.item],
        ["SKU", col.sku],
        ["DESCRIPTION", col.description],
        ["QTY", col.qty],
        ["UNIT PRICE", col.unit],
        ["TOTAL", col.total],
      ];

      headers.forEach(([label, width]) => {
        const labelWidth = pdfTextWidth(label, 6.7, true);
        textAt(
          x + (width - labelWidth) / 2,
          top + 7,
          label,
          6.7,
          true,
          [1, 1, 1]
        );
        x += width;
      });
    };

    drawTableHeader(cursorTop);
    cursorTop += 22;

    quoteItems.forEach((item, index) => {
      const manufacturer = manufacturers.find(
        (entry) => entry.id === item.manufacturer_id
      );
      const qty = Math.max(1, numberOrZero(item.quantity));
      const extended = qty * numberOrZero(item.unit_price);
      const details = [
        item.description || "No description",
        manufacturer?.name ? `Manufacturer: ${manufacturer.name}` : "",
        item.finish ? `Finish: ${item.finish}` : "",
        item.fabric_name ? `Fabric: ${item.fabric_name}` : "",
        item.grade ? `Grade: ${item.grade}` : "",
        item.additional_details ? item.additional_details : "",
      ].filter(Boolean);

      const descLines = details.flatMap((entry) =>
        wrapPdfWidth(entry, col.description - 12, 7.1)
      );
      const shownDescLines = descLines.slice(0, 9);
      const rowHeight = Math.max(55, 14 + shownDescLines.length * 9);

      if (cursorTop + rowHeight > 716) {
        newPage(true);
        cursorTop = 58;
        drawTableHeader(cursorTop);
        cursorTop += 22;
      }

      strokeRect(col.x, cursorTop, tableWidth, rowHeight, [0.82, 0.85, 0.87], 0.45);

      let x = col.x;
      const widths = [col.image, col.item, col.sku, col.description, col.qty, col.unit];
      widths.forEach((width) => {
        x += width;
        lineAt(x, cursorTop, x, cursorTop + rowHeight, 0.35, [0.84, 0.87, 0.89]);
      });

      const imageName = itemImageNames[item.local_id];
      if (imageName) {
        drawImage(imageName, col.x + 5, cursorTop + 5, col.image - 10, rowHeight - 10);
      } else {
        fillRect(col.x + 6, cursorTop + 7, col.image - 12, rowHeight - 14, [0.96, 0.97, 0.98]);
        textAt(col.x + 13, cursorTop + rowHeight / 2 - 3, "IMAGE", 5.8, true, MID);
      }

      let cx = col.x + col.image;
      textAt(cx + col.item / 2 - 2, cursorTop + 20, String(index + 1), 8, true, DARK);
      cx += col.item;
      textAt(cx + 5, cursorTop + 18, item.sku || "-", 7.2, false, DARK);
      cx += col.sku;

      shownDescLines.forEach((entry, lineIndex) => {
        textAt(
          cx + 6,
          cursorTop + 8 + lineIndex * 9,
          entry,
          7.1,
          lineIndex === 0,
          DARK
        );
      });
      cx += col.description;
      textAt(cx + col.qty / 2 - 2, cursorTop + 20, String(qty), 7.5, true, DARK);
      cx += col.qty;
      textAt(cx + col.unit - 7, cursorTop + 20, money(numberOrZero(item.unit_price)), 7.2, true, DARK, "right");
      cx += col.unit;
      textAt(cx + col.total - 7, cursorTop + 20, money(extended), 7.2, true, DARK, "right");

      cursorTop += rowHeight;
    });

    // FINAL SUMMARY PAGE / AREA
    if (cursorTop > 470) {
      newPage(true);
      cursorTop = 66;
    } else {
      cursorTop += 18;
    }

    if (quoteForm.notes.trim()) {
      textAt(MARGIN, cursorTop, "QUOTE NOTES", 8.2, true, NAVY);
      const noteLines = wrapPdfWidth(quoteForm.notes, 300, 7.1);
      noteLines.slice(0, 5).forEach((entry, index) =>
        textAt(MARGIN, cursorTop + 14 + index * 9, entry, 7.1, false, DARK)
      );
      cursorTop += 22 + Math.min(5, noteLines.length) * 9;
    }

    const summaryTop = cursorTop;
    const termsX = MARGIN;
    const termsW = 315;
    const totalsX = 365;
    const totalsW = 215;

    textAt(termsX, summaryTop, "TERMS & CONDITIONS", 8.8, true, NAVY);
    let termsTop = summaryTop + 17;
    DP_TERMS.forEach((term, index) => {
      const wrapped = wrapPdfWidth(`${index + 1}. ${term}`, termsW, 6.3);
      wrapped.forEach((entry, lineIndex) => {
        textAt(termsX, termsTop, entry, 6.3, lineIndex === 0, DARK);
        termsTop += 8;
      });
      termsTop += 2;
    });

    strokeRect(totalsX, summaryTop, totalsW, 112, [0.73, 0.77, 0.8], 0.55);
    const rowText = (
      label: string,
      value: string,
      top: number,
      bold = false
    ) => {
      textAt(totalsX + 12, top, label, 7.3, bold, bold ? NAVY : DARK);
      textAt(totalsX + totalsW - 12, top, value, 7.3, bold, bold ? NAVY : DARK, "right");
    };

    rowText("SUBTOTAL", money(quoteEditorTotals.merchandise), summaryTop + 14);
    rowText(
      "FREIGHT",
      quoteEditorTotals.freight > 0 ? money(quoteEditorTotals.freight) : "To Be Determined",
      summaryTop + 35
    );
    if (quoteEditorTotals.adjustment !== 0) {
      rowText("ADJUSTMENT", money(quoteEditorTotals.adjustment), summaryTop + 56);
      rowText("SALES TAX", "To Be Determined", summaryTop + 75);
    } else {
      rowText("SALES TAX", "To Be Determined", summaryTop + 56);
    }
    lineAt(totalsX + 10, summaryTop + 82, totalsX + totalsW - 10, summaryTop + 82, 0.6, [0.65, 0.7, 0.74]);
    rowText("GRAND TOTAL*", money(quoteEditorTotals.total), summaryTop + 92, true);
    textAt(totalsX + 12, summaryTop + 107, "*Freight and applicable tax may be added.", 5.6, false, MID);

    const sigTop = summaryTop + 138;
    textAt(totalsX, sigTop, "SIGNATURE / ACCEPTANCE", 8.8, true, NAVY);
    const sigText = wrapPdfWidth(
      "By signing below, I acknowledge that I have read, understand, and accept the terms and conditions listed on this quote.",
      totalsW,
      6.4
    );
    sigText.forEach((entry, index) =>
      textAt(totalsX, sigTop + 16 + index * 8, entry, 6.4, false, DARK)
    );
    const lineTop = sigTop + 54;
    lineAt(totalsX, lineTop, totalsX + 125, lineTop, 0.6, DARK);
    lineAt(totalsX + 145, lineTop, totalsX + totalsW, lineTop, 0.6, DARK);
    textAt(totalsX, lineTop + 5, "CLIENT SIGNATURE", 5.8, true, MID);
    textAt(totalsX + 145, lineTop + 5, "DATE", 5.8, true, MID);

    drawFooter();

    // BUILD PDF OBJECTS
    const objects: string[] = [];
    objects[1] = "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>";
    objects[3] = "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>";
    objects[4] = "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>";

    const imageObjectIds: Record<string, number> = {};
    let nextId = 5;
    images.forEach((image) => {
      const objectId = nextId++;
      imageObjectIds[image.name] = objectId;
      objects[objectId] =
        `<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width ${image.width} /Height ${image.height} ` +
        `/ColorSpace /DeviceRGB /BitsPerComponent 8 /Filter /DCTDecode /Length ${image.binary.length} >>\n` +
        `stream\n${image.binary}\nendstream`;
    });

    const pageIds: number[] = [];
    pages.forEach((pageCommands) => {
      const pageId = nextId++;
      const contentId = nextId++;
      pageIds.push(pageId);

      const stream = pageCommands.join("\n");
      objects[contentId] = `<< /Length ${stream.length} >>\nstream\n${stream}\nendstream`;

      const xObjectEntries = images
        .map((image) => `/Im${image.name} ${imageObjectIds[image.name]} 0 R`)
        .join(" ");

      objects[pageId] =
        `<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 ${PAGE_W} ${PAGE_H}] ` +
        `/Resources << /Font << /F1 3 0 R /F2 4 0 R >> /XObject << ${xObjectEntries} >> >> ` +
        `/Contents ${contentId} 0 R >>`;
    });

    objects[2] =
      `<< /Type /Pages /Count ${pageIds.length} /Kids [` +
      pageIds.map((id) => `${id} 0 R`).join(" ") +
      "] >>";

    let pdf = "%PDF-1.4\n%DPHUB\n";
    const offsets: number[] = [0];

    for (let id = 1; id < objects.length; id += 1) {
      offsets[id] = pdf.length;
      pdf += `${id} 0 obj\n${objects[id]}\nendobj\n`;
    }

    const xrefOffset = pdf.length;
    pdf += `xref\n0 ${objects.length}\n`;
    pdf += "0000000000 65535 f \n";

    for (let id = 1; id < objects.length; id += 1) {
      pdf += `${String(offsets[id]).padStart(10, "0")} 00000 n \n`;
    }

    pdf +=
      `trailer\n<< /Size ${objects.length} /Root 1 0 R >>\n` +
      `startxref\n${xrefOffset}\n%%EOF`;

    const bytes = new Uint8Array(pdf.length);
    for (let index = 0; index < pdf.length; index += 1) {
      bytes[index] = pdf.charCodeAt(index) & 0xff;
    }
    return bytes;
  }

  function buildBrandedSalesOrderPdf({
    client,
    salesperson,
    productImages,
  }: {
    client: Client | undefined;
    salesperson: Profile | undefined;
    productImages: Record<
      string,
      { binary: string; width: number; height: number } | null
    >;
  }) {
    if (!selectedSale) return new Uint8Array();

    const salesPdfForm = {
      quote_date: selectedSale.order_date || "",
      expiration_date: "",
      ship_to_name: selectedSale.ship_to_name || "",
      ship_to_contact: selectedSale.ship_to_contact || "",
      ship_to_phone: selectedSale.ship_to_phone || "",
      ship_to_address: selectedSale.ship_to_address || "",
      ship_to_city: selectedSale.ship_to_city || "",
      ship_to_state: selectedSale.ship_to_state || "",
      ship_to_zip: selectedSale.ship_to_zip || "",
      delivery_notes: selectedSale.delivery_notes || "",
      notes: selectedSale.notes || "",
    };
    const merchandise = saleItems.reduce(
      (sum, item) => sum + numberOrZero(item.quantity) * numberOrZero(item.unit_price),
      0
    );
    const freight = vendorFreight.length > 0
      ? vendorFreightTotal(vendorFreight)
      : numberOrZero(selectedSale.freight_amount);
    const adjustment = numberOrZero(selectedSale.adjustment_amount);
    const tax = numberOrZero(selectedSale.tax_amount);
    const received = paymentNetTotal(payments);
    const salesPdfTotals = {
      merchandise,
      freight,
      adjustment,
      tax,
      received,
      total: merchandise + freight + adjustment + tax,
    };

    const PAGE_W = 612;
    const PAGE_H = 792;
    const MARGIN = 32;
    const FOOTER_TOP = 741;
    const NAVY = [0.035, 0.18, 0.33] as const;
    const BLUE = [0.07, 0.31, 0.5] as const;
    const DARK = [0.10, 0.13, 0.16] as const;
    const MID = [0.38, 0.43, 0.47] as const;
    const LIGHT = [0.91, 0.94, 0.96] as const;

    type PdfImage = {
      name: string;
      binary: string;
      width: number;
      height: number;
    };

    const images: PdfImage[] = [
      {
        name: "Logo",
        binary: base64ToBinary(DP_LOGO_JPEG_BASE64),
        width: DP_LOGO_PIXEL_WIDTH,
        height: DP_LOGO_PIXEL_HEIGHT,
      },
    ];

    const itemImageNames: Record<string, string> = {};
    saleItems.forEach((item, index) => {
      const image = productImages[item.id];
      if (!image) return;
      const name = `P${index + 1}`;
      itemImageNames[item.id] = name;
      images.push({ name, ...image });
    });

    const pages: string[][] = [[]];
    let pageIndex = 0;

    const commands = () => pages[pageIndex];
    const topY = (top: number) => PAGE_H - top;

    const color = (rgb: readonly [number, number, number]) =>
      `${rgb[0]} ${rgb[1]} ${rgb[2]}`;

    const textAt = (
      x: number,
      top: number,
      value: string,
      size = 9,
      bold = false,
      rgb: readonly [number, number, number] = DARK,
      align: "left" | "right" = "left"
    ) => {
      const safe = pdfSafe(value);
      const width = pdfTextWidth(safe, size, bold);
      const drawX = align === "right" ? x - width : x;
      commands().push(
        `${color(rgb)} rg BT /${bold ? "F2" : "F1"} ${size} Tf ${drawX.toFixed(
          2
        )} ${(topY(top) - size).toFixed(2)} Td (${pdfEscape(safe)}) Tj ET`
      );
    };

    const lineAt = (
      x1: number,
      top1: number,
      x2: number,
      top2: number,
      width = 0.5,
      rgb: readonly [number, number, number] = MID
    ) => {
      commands().push(
        `${color(rgb)} RG ${width} w ${x1} ${topY(top1)} m ${x2} ${topY(
          top2
        )} l S`
      );
    };

    const fillRect = (
      x: number,
      top: number,
      width: number,
      height: number,
      rgb: readonly [number, number, number]
    ) => {
      commands().push(
        `${color(rgb)} rg ${x} ${(PAGE_H - top - height).toFixed(
          2
        )} ${width} ${height} re f`
      );
    };

    const strokeRect = (
      x: number,
      top: number,
      width: number,
      height: number,
      rgb: readonly [number, number, number] = LIGHT,
      lineWidth = 0.5
    ) => {
      commands().push(
        `${color(rgb)} RG ${lineWidth} w ${x} ${(PAGE_H - top - height).toFixed(
          2
        )} ${width} ${height} re S`
      );
    };

    const drawImage = (
      imageName: string,
      x: number,
      top: number,
      boxW: number,
      boxH: number
    ) => {
      const image = images.find((entry) => entry.name === imageName);
      if (!image) return;
      const scale = Math.min(boxW / image.width, boxH / image.height);
      const width = image.width * scale;
      const height = image.height * scale;
      const drawX = x + (boxW - width) / 2;
      const drawY = PAGE_H - top - boxH + (boxH - height) / 2;
      commands().push(
        `q ${width.toFixed(2)} 0 0 ${height.toFixed(2)} ${drawX.toFixed(
          2
        )} ${drawY.toFixed(2)} cm /Im${imageName} Do Q`
      );
    };

    const drawFooter = () => {
      fillRect(0, FOOTER_TOP, PAGE_W, PAGE_H - FOOTER_TOP, NAVY);

      const salesName = salesperson?.display_name || "Designer’s Patio";
      const salesEmail =
        salesperson?.email || "info@designerspatio.com";
      const salesPhone = salesperson?.phone || "214.217.9997";

      textAt(40, FOOTER_TOP + 10, "SALESPERSON", 6.8, true, [1, 1, 1]);
      textAt(40, FOOTER_TOP + 21, salesName, 7.2, true, [1, 1, 1]);
      textAt(40, FOOTER_TOP + 31, salesEmail, 6.6, false, [1, 1, 1]);
      textAt(40, FOOTER_TOP + 41, salesPhone, 6.6, false, [1, 1, 1]);

      lineAt(222, FOOTER_TOP + 7, 222, 782, 0.5, [0.6, 0.72, 0.8]);
      textAt(242, FOOTER_TOP + 10, "SHOWROOM", 6.8, true, [1, 1, 1]);
      textAt(
        242,
        FOOTER_TOP + 22,
        "2000 N Stemmons Fwy Ste 1D110",
        6.6,
        false,
        [1, 1, 1]
      );
      textAt(242, FOOTER_TOP + 33, "Dallas, TX 75207", 6.6, false, [1, 1, 1]);

      lineAt(430, FOOTER_TOP + 7, 430, 782, 0.5, [0.6, 0.72, 0.8]);
      textAt(450, FOOTER_TOP + 10, "WEBSITE", 6.8, true, [1, 1, 1]);
      textAt(450, FOOTER_TOP + 24, "designerspatio.com", 7, false, [1, 1, 1]);
      textAt(450, FOOTER_TOP + 38, "TO THE TRADE", 6.5, true, [0.8, 0.9, 0.96]);
    };

    const newPage = (continuation = true) => {
      drawFooter();
      pages.push([]);
      pageIndex += 1;
      if (continuation) {
        textAt(MARGIN, 24, "DESIGNER'S PATIO", 10, true, NAVY);
        textAt(
          PAGE_W - MARGIN,
          24,
          `Sales Order #${selectedSale.sale_number}`,
          9,
          true,
          NAVY,
          "right"
        );
        lineAt(MARGIN, 43, PAGE_W - MARGIN, 43, 1.1, NAVY);
      }
    };

    const fieldLine = (
      x: number,
      top: number,
      label: string,
      value: string,
      valueX: number,
      maxWidth: number
    ) => {
      textAt(x, top, label.toUpperCase(), 6.7, true, NAVY);
      const wrapped = wrapPdfWidth(value || "-", maxWidth, 7.4);
      wrapped.slice(0, 2).forEach((entry, index) => {
        textAt(valueX, top + index * 9, entry, 7.4, index === 0, DARK);
      });
    };

    const salespersonPhone = salesperson?.phone || "214.217.9997";
    const salespersonEmail =
      salesperson?.email || "info@designerspatio.com";
    const clientName = client ? getClientName(client) : "Unknown client";
    const clientContact = client
      ? [client.first_name, client.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(" ")
      : "";
    const clientCityLine = client
      ? [client.city, client.state, client.zip_code].filter(Boolean).join(" ")
      : "";

    // FIRST PAGE HEADER
    drawImage("Logo", 34, 20, 238, 177);
    textAt(330, 34, "SALES ORDER", 22, true, NAVY);
    textAt(
      PAGE_W - 34,
      39,
      `SO-${selectedSale.sale_number}`,
      12,
      true,
      DARK,
      "right"
    );

    fieldLine(330, 77, "Sales order", `SO-${selectedSale.sale_number}`, 415, 160);
    fieldLine(330, 96, "Order date", salesPdfForm.quote_date || "", 415, 160);
    fieldLine(330, 115, "Status", selectedSale.status || "Open", 415, 160);
    fieldLine(
      330,
      134,
      "Salesperson",
      salesperson?.display_name || "Unassigned",
      415,
      160
    );
    fieldLine(330, 153, "Email", salespersonEmail, 415, 160);
    fieldLine(330, 172, "Phone", salespersonPhone, 415, 160);

    lineAt(MARGIN, 205, PAGE_W - MARGIN, 205, 1.4, NAVY);

    textAt(36, 224, "CLIENT / CONTACT", 10, true, NAVY);
    textAt(326, 224, "SHIP TO", 10, true, NAVY);
    lineAt(306, 218, 306, 360, 0.5, [0.75, 0.79, 0.82]);

    fieldLine(36, 247, "Client", clientName, 112, 175);
    fieldLine(36, 266, "Contact", clientContact || "-", 112, 175);
    fieldLine(36, 285, "Email", client?.email || "-", 112, 175);
    fieldLine(36, 304, "Phone", client?.phone || "-", 112, 175);
    fieldLine(36, 323, "Address", client?.street_address || "-", 112, 175);
    if (clientCityLine) textAt(112, 342, clientCityLine, 7.4, false, DARK);

    fieldLine(326, 247, "Recipient", salesPdfForm.ship_to_name || "-", 404, 172);
    fieldLine(326, 266, "Contact", salesPdfForm.ship_to_contact || "-", 404, 172);
    fieldLine(326, 285, "Phone", salesPdfForm.ship_to_phone || "-", 404, 172);
    fieldLine(326, 304, "Address", salesPdfForm.ship_to_address || "-", 404, 172);
    const shipCity = [
      salesPdfForm.ship_to_city,
      salesPdfForm.ship_to_state,
      salesPdfForm.ship_to_zip,
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(" ");
    if (shipCity) textAt(404, 323, shipCity, 7.4, false, DARK);
    fieldLine(326, 342, "Delivery notes", salesPdfForm.delivery_notes || "-", 404, 172);

    let cursorTop = 375;

    const col = {
      x: 32,
      image: 62,
      item: 34,
      sku: 64,
      description: 201,
      qty: 40,
      unit: 73,
      total: 74,
    };
    const tableWidth =
      col.image + col.item + col.sku + col.description + col.qty + col.unit + col.total;

    const drawTableHeader = (top: number) => {
      fillRect(col.x, top, tableWidth, 22, NAVY);
      let x = col.x;
      const headers: Array<[string, number]> = [
        ["IMAGE", col.image],
        ["ITEM", col.item],
        ["SKU", col.sku],
        ["DESCRIPTION", col.description],
        ["QTY", col.qty],
        ["UNIT PRICE", col.unit],
        ["TOTAL", col.total],
      ];

      headers.forEach(([label, width]) => {
        const labelWidth = pdfTextWidth(label, 6.7, true);
        textAt(
          x + (width - labelWidth) / 2,
          top + 7,
          label,
          6.7,
          true,
          [1, 1, 1]
        );
        x += width;
      });
    };

    drawTableHeader(cursorTop);
    cursorTop += 22;

    saleItems.forEach((item, index) => {
      const manufacturer = manufacturers.find(
        (entry) => entry.id === item.manufacturer_id
      );
      const qty = Math.max(1, numberOrZero(item.quantity));
      const extended = qty * numberOrZero(item.unit_price);
      const details = [
        item.description || "No description",
        manufacturer?.name ? `Manufacturer: ${manufacturer.name}` : "",
        item.finish ? `Finish: ${item.finish}` : "",
        item.fabric_name ? `Fabric: ${item.fabric_name}` : "",
        item.grade ? `Grade: ${item.grade}` : "",
        item.additional_details ? item.additional_details : "",
      ].filter(Boolean);

      const descLines = details.flatMap((entry) =>
        wrapPdfWidth(entry, col.description - 12, 7.1)
      );
      const shownDescLines = descLines.slice(0, 9);
      const rowHeight = Math.max(55, 14 + shownDescLines.length * 9);

      if (cursorTop + rowHeight > 716) {
        newPage(true);
        cursorTop = 58;
        drawTableHeader(cursorTop);
        cursorTop += 22;
      }

      strokeRect(col.x, cursorTop, tableWidth, rowHeight, [0.82, 0.85, 0.87], 0.45);

      let x = col.x;
      const widths = [col.image, col.item, col.sku, col.description, col.qty, col.unit];
      widths.forEach((width) => {
        x += width;
        lineAt(x, cursorTop, x, cursorTop + rowHeight, 0.35, [0.84, 0.87, 0.89]);
      });

      const imageName = itemImageNames[item.id];
      if (imageName) {
        drawImage(imageName, col.x + 5, cursorTop + 5, col.image - 10, rowHeight - 10);
      } else {
        fillRect(col.x + 6, cursorTop + 7, col.image - 12, rowHeight - 14, [0.96, 0.97, 0.98]);
        textAt(col.x + 13, cursorTop + rowHeight / 2 - 3, "IMAGE", 5.8, true, MID);
      }

      let cx = col.x + col.image;
      textAt(cx + col.item / 2 - 2, cursorTop + 20, String(index + 1), 8, true, DARK);
      cx += col.item;
      textAt(cx + 5, cursorTop + 18, item.sku || "-", 7.2, false, DARK);
      cx += col.sku;

      shownDescLines.forEach((entry, lineIndex) => {
        textAt(
          cx + 6,
          cursorTop + 8 + lineIndex * 9,
          entry,
          7.1,
          lineIndex === 0,
          DARK
        );
      });
      cx += col.description;
      textAt(cx + col.qty / 2 - 2, cursorTop + 20, String(qty), 7.5, true, DARK);
      cx += col.qty;
      textAt(cx + col.unit - 7, cursorTop + 20, money(numberOrZero(item.unit_price)), 7.2, true, DARK, "right");
      cx += col.unit;
      textAt(cx + col.total - 7, cursorTop + 20, money(extended), 7.2, true, DARK, "right");

      cursorTop += rowHeight;
    });

    // FINAL SUMMARY PAGE / AREA
    if (cursorTop > 470) {
      newPage(true);
      cursorTop = 66;
    } else {
      cursorTop += 18;
    }

    if (salesPdfForm.notes.trim()) {
      textAt(MARGIN, cursorTop, "ORDER NOTES", 8.2, true, NAVY);
      const noteLines = wrapPdfWidth(salesPdfForm.notes, 300, 7.1);
      noteLines.slice(0, 5).forEach((entry, index) =>
        textAt(MARGIN, cursorTop + 14 + index * 9, entry, 7.1, false, DARK)
      );
      cursorTop += 22 + Math.min(5, noteLines.length) * 9;
    }

    const summaryTop = cursorTop;
    const termsX = MARGIN;
    const termsW = 315;
    const totalsX = 365;
    const totalsW = 215;

    textAt(termsX, summaryTop, "TERMS & CONDITIONS", 8.8, true, NAVY);
    let termsTop = summaryTop + 17;
    DP_SALES_TERMS.forEach((term, index) => {
      const wrapped = wrapPdfWidth(`${index + 1}. ${term}`, termsW, 6.3);
      wrapped.forEach((entry, lineIndex) => {
        textAt(termsX, termsTop, entry, 6.3, lineIndex === 0, DARK);
        termsTop += 8;
      });
      termsTop += 2;
    });

    strokeRect(totalsX, summaryTop, totalsW, 166, [0.73, 0.77, 0.8], 0.55);
    const rowText = (
      label: string,
      value: string,
      top: number,
      bold = false
    ) => {
      textAt(totalsX + 12, top, label, 7.3, bold, bold ? NAVY : DARK);
      textAt(totalsX + totalsW - 12, top, value, 7.3, bold, bold ? NAVY : DARK, "right");
    };

    rowText("MERCHANDISE", money(salesPdfTotals.merchandise), summaryTop + 14);
    rowText("FREIGHT", money(salesPdfTotals.freight), summaryTop + 34);
    rowText("ADJUSTMENT", money(salesPdfTotals.adjustment), summaryTop + 54);
    rowText("SALES TAX", money(salesPdfTotals.tax), summaryTop + 74);
    lineAt(totalsX + 10, summaryTop + 91, totalsX + totalsW - 10, summaryTop + 91, 0.6, [0.65, 0.7, 0.74]);
    rowText("ORDER TOTAL", money(salesPdfTotals.total), summaryTop + 102, true);
    rowText("PAYMENTS", money(salesPdfTotals.received), summaryTop + 122);
    lineAt(totalsX + 10, summaryTop + 139, totalsX + totalsW - 10, summaryTop + 139, 0.6, [0.65, 0.7, 0.74]);
    rowText("BALANCE DUE", money(Math.max(0, salesPdfTotals.total - salesPdfTotals.received)), summaryTop + 150, true);

    const sigTop = summaryTop + 190;
    textAt(totalsX, sigTop, "SIGNATURE / ACCEPTANCE", 8.8, true, NAVY);
    const sigText = wrapPdfWidth(
      "By signing below, I acknowledge that I have read, understand, and accept the terms and conditions listed on this sales order.",
      totalsW,
      6.4
    );
    sigText.forEach((entry, index) =>
      textAt(totalsX, sigTop + 16 + index * 8, entry, 6.4, false, DARK)
    );
    const lineTop = sigTop + 54;
    lineAt(totalsX, lineTop, totalsX + 125, lineTop, 0.6, DARK);
    lineAt(totalsX + 145, lineTop, totalsX + totalsW, lineTop, 0.6, DARK);
    textAt(totalsX, lineTop + 5, "CLIENT SIGNATURE", 5.8, true, MID);
    textAt(totalsX + 145, lineTop + 5, "DATE", 5.8, true, MID);

    drawFooter();

    // BUILD PDF OBJECTS
    const objects: string[] = [];
    objects[1] = "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>";
    objects[3] = "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>";
    objects[4] = "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>";

    const imageObjectIds: Record<string, number> = {};
    let nextId = 5;
    images.forEach((image) => {
      const objectId = nextId++;
      imageObjectIds[image.name] = objectId;
      objects[objectId] =
        `<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width ${image.width} /Height ${image.height} ` +
        `/ColorSpace /DeviceRGB /BitsPerComponent 8 /Filter /DCTDecode /Length ${image.binary.length} >>\n` +
        `stream\n${image.binary}\nendstream`;
    });

    const pageIds: number[] = [];
    pages.forEach((pageCommands) => {
      const pageId = nextId++;
      const contentId = nextId++;
      pageIds.push(pageId);

      const stream = pageCommands.join("\n");
      objects[contentId] = `<< /Length ${stream.length} >>\nstream\n${stream}\nendstream`;

      const xObjectEntries = images
        .map((image) => `/Im${image.name} ${imageObjectIds[image.name]} 0 R`)
        .join(" ");

      objects[pageId] =
        `<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 ${PAGE_W} ${PAGE_H}] ` +
        `/Resources << /Font << /F1 3 0 R /F2 4 0 R >> /XObject << ${xObjectEntries} >> >> ` +
        `/Contents ${contentId} 0 R >>`;
    });

    objects[2] =
      `<< /Type /Pages /Count ${pageIds.length} /Kids [` +
      pageIds.map((id) => `${id} 0 R`).join(" ") +
      "] >>";

    let pdf = "%PDF-1.4\n%DPHUB\n";
    const offsets: number[] = [0];

    for (let id = 1; id < objects.length; id += 1) {
      offsets[id] = pdf.length;
      pdf += `${id} 0 obj\n${objects[id]}\nendobj\n`;
    }

    const xrefOffset = pdf.length;
    pdf += `xref\n0 ${objects.length}\n`;
    pdf += "0000000000 65535 f \n";

    for (let id = 1; id < objects.length; id += 1) {
      pdf += `${String(offsets[id]).padStart(10, "0")} 00000 n \n`;
    }

    pdf +=
      `trailer\n<< /Size ${objects.length} /Root 1 0 R >>\n` +
      `startxref\n${xrefOffset}\n%%EOF`;

    const bytes = new Uint8Array(pdf.length);
    for (let index = 0; index < pdf.length; index += 1) {
      bytes[index] = pdf.charCodeAt(index) & 0xff;
    }
    return bytes;
  }


  async function downloadQuotePdf() {
    if (!selectedQuote) {
      setMessage("Save the quote before downloading its PDF.");
      return;
    }

    setMessage("Building branded quote PDF...");

    const client = clients.find(
      (entry) => entry.id === quoteForm.client_id
    );
    const salesperson = team.find(
      (entry) => entry.id === quoteForm.salesperson_user_id
    );

    const productImageEntries = await Promise.all(
      quoteItems.map(async (item) => [
        item.local_id,
        item.image_url ? await imageUrlToPdfJpeg(item.image_url) : null,
      ] as const)
    );
    const productImages = Object.fromEntries(productImageEntries);

    const bytes = buildBrandedQuotePdf({
      client,
      salesperson,
      productImages,
    });
    const blob = new Blob([bytes], { type: "application/pdf" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `Designers-Patio-Quote-${selectedQuote.quote_number}.pdf`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
    setMessage("Branded quote PDF downloaded.");
  }

  async function downloadSalesOrderPdf() {
    if (!selectedSale) {
      setMessage("Open a sales order before downloading its PDF.");
      return;
    }

    setMessage("Building sales order PDF...");

    const client = clients.find((entry) => entry.id === selectedSale.client_id);
    const salesperson = team.find(
      (entry) => entry.id === selectedSale.salesperson_user_id

    const productImageEntries = await Promise.all(

        item.id,
        item.image_url ? await imageUrlToPdfJpeg(item.image_url) : null,
      ] as const)
    );
    const productImages = Object.fromEntries(productImageEntries);

    const bytes = buildBrandedSalesOrderPdf({
      client,

    });
    const blob = new Blob([bytes], { type: "application/pdf" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");

    link.download = `Designers-Patio-Sales-Order-${selectedSale.sale_number}.pdf`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);

    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
    setMessage("Sales order PDF downloaded.");
  }


  async function toggleQuoteArchive() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedQuote) return;

    const isArchived = selectedQuote.status === "Archived";
    const nextStatus = isArchived
      ? selectedQuote.approved
        ? "Approved"
        : "Draft"
      : "Archived";

    setSavingQuote(true);
    setMessage("");

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("quotes")
      .update({
        status: nextStatus,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq("id", selectedQuote.id)
      .select(quoteColumns)
      .single();

    if (error) {
      setMessage(`Could not update quote archive: ${error.message}`);
      setSavingQuote(false);
      return;
    }

    setSelectedQuote(data as Quote);
    setQuoteForm((current) => ({
      ...current,
      status: nextStatus,
    }));
    setShowArchivedQuotes(!isArchived);
    await loadQuotes();
    setSavingQuote(false);
    setMessage(
      isArchived
        ? `Quote #${selectedQuote.quote_number} was restored to Draft.`
        : `Quote #${selectedQuote.quote_number} was archived.`
    );
  }

  async function saveQuote() {
    if (!supabase) return;

    if (!quoteForm.client_id) {
      setMessage("Choose a client before saving the quote.");
      return;
    }

    setSavingQuote(true);
    setMessage("");

    const headerPayload = {
      client_id: quoteForm.client_id,
      salesperson_user_id:
        quoteForm.salesperson_user_id || profile?.id || null,
      status: quoteForm.status || "Draft",
      quote_date: quoteForm.quote_date || todayISO(),
      expiration_date: quoteForm.expiration_date || null,
      customer_po: quoteForm.customer_po.trim() || null,
      ship_to_name: quoteForm.ship_to_name.trim() || null,
      ship_to_contact: quoteForm.ship_to_contact.trim() || null,
      ship_to_phone: quoteForm.ship_to_phone.trim() || null,
      ship_to_address: quoteForm.ship_to_address.trim() || null,
      ship_to_city: quoteForm.ship_to_city.trim() || null,
      ship_to_state: quoteForm.ship_to_state.trim().toUpperCase() || null,
      ship_to_zip: quoteForm.ship_to_zip.trim() || null,
      delivery_notes: quoteForm.delivery_notes.trim() || null,
      notes: quoteForm.notes.trim() || null,
      freight_amount: numberOrZero(
        quoteForm.freight_amount
      ),
      adjustment_amount: numberOrZero(
        quoteForm.adjustment_amount
      ),
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    let quoteId = selectedQuote?.id || "";
    let savedQuote: Quote | null = selectedQuote;

    if (!selectedQuote) {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("quotes")
        .insert(headerPayload)
        .select(quoteColumns)
        .single();

      if (error) {
        setMessage(`Could not create quote: ${error.message}`);
        setSavingQuote(false);
        return;
      }

      savedQuote = data as Quote;
      quoteId = savedQuote.id;
      setSelectedQuote(savedQuote);
    } else {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("quotes")
        .update(headerPayload)
        .eq("id", selectedQuote.id)
        .select(quoteColumns)
        .single();

      if (error) {
        setMessage(`Could not save quote: ${error.message}`);
        setSavingQuote(false);
        return;
      }

      savedQuote = data as Quote;
      setSelectedQuote(savedQuote);
    }

    const { error: deleteError } = await supabase
      .from("quote_items")
      .delete()
      .eq("quote_id", quoteId);

    if (deleteError) {
      setMessage(
        `Quote saved, but line items could not refresh: ${deleteError.message}`
      );
      setSavingQuote(false);
      return;
    }

    const itemPayloads = quoteItems
      .filter(
        (item) =>
          item.manufacturer_id ||
          item.sku.trim() ||
          item.description.trim() ||
          numberOrZero(item.msrp_at_grade) > 0
      )
      .map((item, index) => ({
        quote_id: quoteId,
        manufacturer_id: item.manufacturer_id || null,
        sort_order: index,
        quantity: Math.max(1, numberOrZero(item.quantity)),
        image_url: item.image_url.trim() || null,
        sku: item.sku.trim() || null,
        description: item.description.trim() || null,
        finish: item.finish.trim() || null,
        fabric_name: item.fabric_name.trim() || null,
        grade: item.grade.trim() || null,
        additional_details:
          item.additional_details.trim() || null,
        msrp_at_grade: numberOrZero(item.msrp_at_grade),
        discount_pct: numberOrZero(item.discount_pct),
        unit_price: numberOrZero(item.unit_price),
        purchasing_factor_snapshot:
          item.purchasing_factor_snapshot,
        tariff_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
          item.tariff_pct_snapshot
        ),
        surcharge_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
          item.surcharge_pct_snapshot
        ),
        expected_unit_cost: item.expected_unit_cost,
        commissionable: item.commissionable,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      }));

    if (itemPayloads.length > 0) {
      const { error: itemError } = await supabase
        .from("quote_items")
        .insert(itemPayloads);

      if (itemError) {
        setMessage(
          `Quote header saved, but line items failed: ${itemError.message}`
        );
        setSavingQuote(false);
        return;
      }
    }

    await loadQuotes();
    setSavingQuote(false);
    setMessage(
      `Quote #${savedQuote?.quote_number || ""} saved as ${
        savedQuote?.status || "Draft"
      }.`
    );
  }

  async function deleteQuote() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedQuote) return;

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Delete Quote #${selectedQuote.quote_number}? This cannot be undone.`
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    setSavingQuote(true);

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from("quotes")
      .delete()
      .eq("id", selectedQuote.id);

    if (error) {
      setMessage(`Could not delete quote: ${error.message}`);
      setSavingQuote(false);
      return;
    }

    setQuoteEditorOpen(false);
    setSelectedQuote(null);
    setSavingQuote(false);
    await loadQuotes();
    setMessage(`Quote #${selectedQuote.quote_number} was deleted.`);
  }


  async function openSale(order: SalesOrder) {
    if (!supabase) return;

    setSelectedSale(order);
    setSaleEditForm(saleOrderToEditForm(order));
    setSaleEditMode(false);
    setSaleModalOpen(true);
    setPaymentFormOpen(false);
    setSelectedPayment(null);
    setMessage("");

    if (!clients.some((client) => client.id === order.client_id)) {
      const { data: missingClient } = await supabase
        .from("clients")
        .select(clientColumns)
        .eq("id", order.client_id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (missingClient) {
        setClients((current) =>
          current.some((client) => client.id === missingClient.id)
            ? current
            : [...current, missingClient as Client]
        );
      }
    }

    const [itemResult, _paymentResult, freightResult] = await Promise.all([
      supabase
        .from("sales_order_items")
        .select(salesOrderItemColumns)
        .eq("sales_order_id", order.id)
        .order("sort_order", { ascending: true }),
      loadSalePayments(order.id),
      supabase
        .from("sales_order_vendor_freight")
        .select(vendorFreightColumns)
        .eq("sales_order_id", order.id)
        .order("created_at", { ascending: true }),
    ]);

    if (itemResult.error) {
      setMessage(`Could not load sale items: ${itemResult.error.message}`);
      return;
    }

    if (freightResult.error) {
      setMessage(`Could not load vendor freight: ${freightResult.error.message}`);
      return;
    }

    const loadedItems = (itemResult.data || []) as SalesOrderItem[];
    const loadedFreight = (freightResult.data || []) as VendorFreight[];
    setSaleItems(loadedItems);
    setVendorFreight(loadedFreight);
    setSaleEditItems(loadedItems.map((item) => saleItemToDraft(item)));
    setSaleEditVendorFreight(
      buildVendorFreightDrafts(loadedItems, loadedFreight, numberOrZero(order.freight_amount))
    );
  }

  async function convertQuoteToSale() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedQuote) {
      setMessage("Save the quote before converting it to a sale.");
      return;
    }

    if (quoteItems.length === 0) {
      setMessage("Add at least one line item before converting.");
      return;
    }

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Convert Quote #${selectedQuote.quote_number} to a sales order?`
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;

    setConvertingQuote(true);
    setMessage("");

    const { data: existingSale } = await supabase
      .from("sales_orders")
      .select(salesOrderColumns)
      .eq("source_quote_id", selectedQuote.id)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (existingSale) {
      setConvertingQuote(false);
      setQuoteEditorOpen(false);
      setView("sales");
      await openSale(existingSale as SalesOrder);
      setMessage(
        `Quote #${selectedQuote.quote_number} was already converted to Sale #${(existingSale as SalesOrder).sale_number}.`
      );
      return;
    }

    const { data: saleData, error: saleError } = await supabase
      .from("sales_orders")
      .insert({
        source_quote_id: selectedQuote.id,
        client_id: quoteForm.client_id,
        salesperson_user_id:
          quoteForm.salesperson_user_id || profile?.id || null,
        status: "Open",
        order_date: todayISO(),
        customer_po: quoteForm.customer_po.trim() || null,
        notes: quoteForm.notes.trim() || null,
        ship_to_name: quoteForm.ship_to_name.trim() || null,
        ship_to_contact: quoteForm.ship_to_contact.trim() || null,
        ship_to_phone: quoteForm.ship_to_phone.trim() || null,
        ship_to_address: quoteForm.ship_to_address.trim() || null,
        ship_to_city: quoteForm.ship_to_city.trim() || null,
        ship_to_state:
          quoteForm.ship_to_state.trim().toUpperCase() || null,
        ship_to_zip: quoteForm.ship_to_zip.trim() || null,
        delivery_notes: quoteForm.delivery_notes.trim() || null,
        freight_amount: numberOrZero(quoteForm.freight_amount),
        adjustment_amount: numberOrZero(
          quoteForm.adjustment_amount
        ),
        tax_amount: 0,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .select(salesOrderColumns)
      .single();

    if (saleError || !saleData) {
      setMessage(
        `Could not convert quote: ${
          saleError?.message || "Unknown sales order error"
        }`
      );
      setConvertingQuote(false);
      return;
    }

    const sale = saleData as SalesOrder;

    const saleItemPayloads = quoteItems
      .filter(
        (item) =>
          item.manufacturer_id ||
          item.sku.trim() ||
          item.description.trim() ||
          numberOrZero(item.msrp_at_grade) > 0
      )
      .map((item, index) => ({
        sales_order_id: sale.id,
        source_quote_item_id: item.id || null,
        manufacturer_id: item.manufacturer_id || null,
        sort_order: index,
        quantity: Math.max(1, numberOrZero(item.quantity)),
        image_url: item.image_url.trim() || null,
        sku: item.sku.trim() || null,
        description: item.description.trim() || null,
        finish: item.finish.trim() || null,
        fabric_name: item.fabric_name.trim() || null,
        grade: item.grade.trim() || null,
        additional_details:
          item.additional_details.trim() || null,
        msrp_at_grade: numberOrZero(item.msrp_at_grade),
        discount_pct: numberOrZero(item.discount_pct),
        unit_price: numberOrZero(item.unit_price),
        purchasing_factor_snapshot:
          item.purchasing_factor_snapshot,
        tariff_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
          item.tariff_pct_snapshot
        ),
        surcharge_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
          item.surcharge_pct_snapshot
        ),
        expected_unit_cost: item.expected_unit_cost,
        acknowledged_unit_cost: null,
        commissionable: item.commissionable,
        fulfillment_method: "Special Order",
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      }));

    const { data: insertedItems, error: itemError } = await supabase
      .from("sales_order_items")
      .insert(saleItemPayloads)
      .select(salesOrderItemColumns);

    if (itemError) {
      await supabase
        .from("sales_orders")
        .delete()
        .eq("id", sale.id);

      setMessage(
        `Sale header was created, but line items failed: ${itemError.message}`
      );
      setConvertingQuote(false);
      return;
    }

    const quoteManufacturerIds = Array.from(
      new Set(
        saleItemPayloads
          .map((item) => item.manufacturer_id || "")
          .filter(Boolean)
      )
    );

    if (quoteManufacturerIds.length > 0) {
      const quoteFreight = numberOrZero(quoteForm.freight_amount);
      const freightPayload = quoteManufacturerIds.map((manufacturerId, index) => ({
        sales_order_id: sale.id,
        manufacturer_id: manufacturerId,
        amount: index === 0 ? quoteFreight : 0,
        notes:
          quoteManufacturerIds.length > 1 && index === 0 && quoteFreight > 0
            ? "Carried from quote total. Reallocate freight by vendor before finalizing."
            : null,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      }));

      await supabase
        .from("sales_order_vendor_freight")
        .insert(freightPayload);
    }

    await supabase
      .from("quotes")
      .update({
        status: "Archived",
        approved: true,
        approved_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        converted_sales_order_id: sale.id,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq("id", selectedQuote.id);

    setSelectedSale(sale);
    setSaleItems((insertedItems || []) as SalesOrderItem[]);
    setSaleModalOpen(true);
    setQuoteEditorOpen(false);
    setView("sales");

    await Promise.all([loadQuotes(), loadSalesOrders()]);
    setConvertingQuote(false);
    setMessage(
      `Quote #${selectedQuote.quote_number} converted to Sale #${sale.sale_number}.`
    );
  }

  function beginSaleEdit() {
    if (!selectedSale) return;

    setSaleEditForm(saleOrderToEditForm(selectedSale));
    setSaleEditItems(
      saleItems.length > 0
        ? saleItems.map((item) => saleItemToDraft(item))
        : [blankSaleItem(0)]
    );
    setSaleEditVendorFreight(
      buildVendorFreightDrafts(
        saleItems,
        vendorFreight,
        numberOrZero(selectedSale.freight_amount)
      )
    );
    setSaleEditMode(true);
    setPaymentFormOpen(false);
    setMessage("");
  }

  function cancelSaleEdit() {
    if (!selectedSale || savingSale) return;

    setSaleEditForm(saleOrderToEditForm(selectedSale));
    setSaleEditItems(
      saleItems.map((item) => saleItemToDraft(item))
    );
    setSaleEditVendorFreight(
      buildVendorFreightDrafts(
        saleItems,
        vendorFreight,
        numberOrZero(selectedSale.freight_amount)
      )
    );
    setSaleEditMode(false);
  }

  function updateSaleEditForm(
    field: keyof SalesOrderEditForm,
    value: string
  ) {
    setSaleEditForm((current) =>
      current ? { ...current, [field]: value } : current
    );
  }

  function copySaleClientToShipTo() {
    if (!saleEditForm) return;

    const client = clients.find(
      (entry) => entry.id === saleEditForm.client_id
    );

    if (!client) {
      setMessage("Choose a client first.");
      return;
    }

    const contact = [client.first_name, client.last_name]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(" ");

    setSaleEditForm((current) =>
      current
        ? {
            ...current,
            ship_to_name: getClientName(client),
            ship_to_contact: contact,
            ship_to_phone: client.phone || "",
            ship_to_address: client.street_address || "",
            ship_to_city: client.city || "",
            ship_to_state: client.state || "",
            ship_to_zip: client.zip_code || "",
          }
        : current
    );
  }

  function addSaleEditItem() {
    setSaleEditItems((current) => [
      ...current,
      blankSaleItem(current.length),
    ]);
  }

  function removeSaleEditItem(localId: string) {
    setSaleEditItems((current) =>
      current.filter((item) => item.local_id !== localId)
    );
  }

  function updateSaleEditItem(
    localId: string,
    field: keyof SalesOrderItemDraft,
    value: string | number | boolean | null
  ) {
    setSaleEditItems((current) =>
      current.map((existing) => {
        if (existing.local_id !== localId) return existing;

        let next = {
          ...existing,
          [field]: value,
        } as SalesOrderItemDraft;

        if (field === "manufacturer_id") {
          const manufacturer = manufacturers.find(
            (entry) => entry.id === value
          );

          next = {
            ...next,
            manufacturer_id: String(value || ""),
            discount_pct: numberOrZero(
              manufacturer?.default_discount_pct
            ),
            purchasing_factor_snapshot:
              manufacturer?.purchasing_factor == null
                ? null
                : Number(manufacturer.purchasing_factor),
            tariff_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
              manufacturer?.tariff_pct
            ),
            surcharge_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
              manufacturer?.surcharge_pct
            ),
          };

          return calculateSaleItem(next, manufacturer);
        }

        if (
          field === "msrp_at_grade" ||
          field === "discount_pct" ||
          field === "purchasing_factor_snapshot" ||
          field === "tariff_pct_snapshot" ||
          field === "surcharge_pct_snapshot"
        ) {
          const manufacturer = manufacturers.find(
            (entry) => entry.id === next.manufacturer_id
          );
          return calculateSaleItem(next, manufacturer);
        }

        return next;
      })
    );
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!saleEditMode) return;

    const ids = Array.from(
      new Set(saleEditItems.map((item) => item.manufacturer_id).filter(Boolean))
    );

    setSaleEditVendorFreight((current) =>
      ids.map((manufacturerId) => {
        const currentRow = current.find((row) => row.manufacturer_id === manufacturerId);
        const savedRow = vendorFreight.find((row) => row.manufacturer_id === manufacturerId);
        return currentRow || {
          manufacturer_id: manufacturerId,
          amount: String(numberOrZero(savedRow?.amount)),
          notes: savedRow?.notes || "",
        };
      })
    );
  }, [saleEditMode, saleEditItems, vendorFreight]);

  function updateSaleVendorFreight(
    manufacturerId: string,
    field: "amount" | "notes",
    value: string
  ) {
    setSaleEditVendorFreight((current) =>
      current.map((row) =>
        row.manufacturer_id === manufacturerId
          ? { ...row, [field]: value }
          : row
      )
    );
  }

  async function saveSaleEdits() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedSale || !saleEditForm) return;

    if (!saleEditForm.client_id) {
      setMessage("A sales order needs a client.");
      return;
    }

    setSavingSale(true);
    setMessage("");

    const { data: updatedOrder, error: orderError } = await supabase
      .from("sales_orders")
      .update({
        client_id: saleEditForm.client_id,
        salesperson_user_id:
          saleEditForm.salesperson_user_id || null,
        status: saleEditForm.status || "Open",
        order_date: saleEditForm.order_date || todayISO(),
        customer_po: saleEditForm.customer_po.trim() || null,
        notes: saleEditForm.notes.trim() || null,
        ship_to_name: saleEditForm.ship_to_name.trim() || null,
        ship_to_contact:
          saleEditForm.ship_to_contact.trim() || null,
        ship_to_phone:
          saleEditForm.ship_to_phone.trim() || null,
        ship_to_address:
          saleEditForm.ship_to_address.trim() || null,
        ship_to_city: saleEditForm.ship_to_city.trim() || null,
        ship_to_state:
          saleEditForm.ship_to_state.trim().toUpperCase() || null,
        ship_to_zip: saleEditForm.ship_to_zip.trim() || null,
        delivery_notes:
          saleEditForm.delivery_notes.trim() || null,
        freight_amount: vendorFreightTotal(
          saleEditVendorFreight
        ),
        adjustment_amount: numberOrZero(
          saleEditForm.adjustment_amount
        ),
        tax_amount: numberOrZero(saleEditForm.tax_amount),
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq("id", selectedSale.id)
      .select(salesOrderColumns)
      .single();

    if (orderError || !updatedOrder) {
      setMessage(
        `Could not save sales order: ${
          orderError?.message || "Unknown sales order error"
        }`
      );
      setSavingSale(false);
      return;
    }

    const keptIds = new Set(
      saleEditItems
        .map((item) => item.id)
        .filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id))
    );
    const removedIds = saleItems
      .map((item) => item.id)
      .filter((id) => !keptIds.has(id));

    if (removedIds.length > 0) {
      const { error: removeError } = await supabase
        .from("sales_order_items")
        .delete()
        .in("id", removedIds);

      if (removeError) {
        setMessage(
          `Sales order saved, but an item could not be removed: ${removeError.message}`
        );
        setSavingSale(false);
        return;
      }
    }

    const validItems = saleEditItems.filter(
      (item) =>
        item.manufacturer_id ||
        item.sku.trim() ||
        item.description.trim() ||
        numberOrZero(item.msrp_at_grade) > 0
    );

    for (let index = 0; index < validItems.length; index += 1) {
      const item = validItems[index];
      const payload = {
        sales_order_id: selectedSale.id,
        source_quote_item_id: item.source_quote_item_id,
        manufacturer_id: item.manufacturer_id || null,
        sort_order: index,
        quantity: Math.max(1, numberOrZero(item.quantity)),
        image_url: item.image_url.trim() || null,
        sku: item.sku.trim() || null,
        description: item.description.trim() || null,
        finish: item.finish.trim() || null,
        fabric_name: item.fabric_name.trim() || null,
        grade: item.grade.trim() || null,
        additional_details:
          item.additional_details.trim() || null,
        msrp_at_grade: numberOrZero(item.msrp_at_grade),
        discount_pct: numberOrZero(item.discount_pct),
        unit_price: numberOrZero(item.unit_price),
        purchasing_factor_snapshot:
          item.purchasing_factor_snapshot,
        tariff_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
          item.tariff_pct_snapshot
        ),
        surcharge_pct_snapshot: numberOrZero(
          item.surcharge_pct_snapshot
        ),
        expected_unit_cost: item.expected_unit_cost,
        acknowledged_unit_cost: item.acknowledged_unit_cost,
        commissionable: item.commissionable,
        fulfillment_method: item.fulfillment_method,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      };

      if (item.id) {
        const { error: itemError } = await supabase
          .from("sales_order_items")
          .update(payload)
          .eq("id", item.id);

        if (itemError) {
          setMessage(
            `Sales order header saved, but item ${index + 1} failed: ${itemError.message}`
          );
          setSavingSale(false);
          return;
        }
      } else {
        const { error: itemError } = await supabase
          .from("sales_order_items")
          .insert(payload);

        if (itemError) {
          setMessage(
            `Sales order header saved, but new item ${index + 1} failed: ${itemError.message}`
          );
          setSavingSale(false);
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    const { error: clearFreightError } = await supabase
      .from("sales_order_vendor_freight")
      .delete()
      .eq("sales_order_id", selectedSale.id);

    if (clearFreightError) {
      setMessage(`Sales order saved, but vendor freight could not be refreshed: ${clearFreightError.message}`);
      setSavingSale(false);
      return;
    }

    if (saleEditVendorFreight.length > 0) {
      const freightPayload = saleEditVendorFreight.map((row) => ({
        sales_order_id: selectedSale.id,
        manufacturer_id: row.manufacturer_id,
        amount: numberOrZero(row.amount),
        notes: row.notes.trim() || null,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      }));

      const { error: freightError } = await supabase
        .from("sales_order_vendor_freight")
        .insert(freightPayload);

      if (freightError) {
        setMessage(`Sales order saved, but vendor freight failed: ${freightError.message}`);
        setSavingSale(false);
        return;
      }
    }

    const { data: refreshedFreight, error: refreshedFreightError } = await supabase
      .from("sales_order_vendor_freight")
      .select(vendorFreightColumns)
      .eq("sales_order_id", selectedSale.id)
      .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

    if (refreshedFreightError) {
      setMessage(`Sales order saved, but vendor freight could not be refreshed: ${refreshedFreightError.message}`);
      setSavingSale(false);
      return;
    }

    const { data: refreshedItems, error: refreshError } =
      await supabase
        .from("sales_order_items")
        .select(salesOrderItemColumns)
        .eq("sales_order_id", selectedSale.id)
        .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

    if (refreshError) {
      setMessage(
        `Sales order saved, but items could not be refreshed: ${refreshError.message}`
      );
      setSavingSale(false);
      return;
    }

    const nextOrder = updatedOrder as SalesOrder;
    const nextItems = (refreshedItems || []) as SalesOrderItem[];

    setSelectedSale(nextOrder);
    setSaleItems(nextItems);
    setVendorFreight((refreshedFreight || []) as VendorFreight[]);
    setSaleEditForm(saleOrderToEditForm(nextOrder));
    setSaleEditItems(
      nextItems.map((item) => saleItemToDraft(item))
    );
    setSaleEditMode(false);
    await loadSalesOrders();
    setSavingSale(false);
    setMessage(`Sale #${nextOrder.sale_number} was updated.`);
  }

  async function changeFulfillmentMethod(
    item: SalesOrderItem,
    method: "Special Order" | "Inventory"
  ) {
    if (!supabase) return;

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("sales_order_items")
      .update({
        fulfillment_method: method,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq("id", item.id)
      .select(salesOrderItemColumns)
      .single();

    if (error) {
      setMessage(
        `Could not change fulfillment method: ${error.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    setSaleItems((current) =>
      current.map((entry) =>
        entry.id === item.id ? (data as SalesOrderItem) : entry
      )
    );

    await loadSalesOrders();
  }

  function openAddPayment() {
    if (!selectedSale) return;

    const total = saleOrderTotal(selectedSale, saleItems);
    const received = paymentNetTotal(payments);
    const depositTarget = total * 0.5;

    let suggested = total - received;

    if (received < depositTarget) {
      suggested = depositTarget - received;
    }

    setSelectedPayment(null);
    setPaymentMode("new");
    setCorrectionReason("");
    setPaymentForm({
      payment_date: todayISO(),
      amount:
        suggested > 0
          ? suggested.toFixed(2)
          : "",
      payment_method: "Visa",
      reference: "",
      notes: "",
    });
    setPaymentFormOpen(true);
  }

  function editPayment(payment: Payment) {
    if (payment.posted) return;

    setSelectedPayment(payment);
    setPaymentMode("edit");
    setCorrectionReason("");
    setPaymentForm({
      payment_date: payment.payment_date,
      amount: Math.abs(numberOrZero(payment.amount)).toFixed(2),
      payment_method: payment.payment_method,
      reference: payment.reference || "",
      notes: payment.notes || "",
    });
    setPaymentFormOpen(true);
  }

  function correctPayment(payment: Payment) {
    if (!payment.posted) return;

    setSelectedPayment(payment);
    setPaymentMode("correct");
    setCorrectionReason("");
    setPaymentForm({
      payment_date: payment.payment_date,
      amount: Math.abs(numberOrZero(payment.amount)).toFixed(2),
      payment_method: payment.payment_method,
      reference: payment.reference || "",
      notes: payment.notes || "",
    });
    setPaymentFormOpen(true);
  }

  function updatePaymentForm<K extends keyof PaymentForm>(
    field: K,
    value: PaymentForm[K]
  ) {
    setPaymentForm((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [field]: value,
    }));
  }

  async function savePayment() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedSale) return;

    const amount = numberOrZero(paymentForm.amount);

    if (amount <= 0) {
      setMessage("Payment amount must be greater than zero.");
      return;
    }

    if (!paymentMethods.includes(
      paymentForm.payment_method as
        (typeof paymentMethods)[number]
    )) {
      setMessage("Choose a valid payment method.");
      return;
    }

    setSavingPayment(true);
    setMessage("");

    const common = {
      payment_date: paymentForm.payment_date || todayISO(),
      amount,
      payment_method: paymentForm.payment_method,
      reference: paymentForm.reference.trim() || null,
      notes: paymentForm.notes.trim() || null,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    if (paymentMode === "new") {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("payments")
        .insert({
          sales_order_id: selectedSale.id,
          ...common,
          posted: false,
          created_by: profile?.id || null,
        });

      if (error) {
        setMessage(`Could not add payment: ${error.message}`);
        setSavingPayment(false);
        return;
      }

      setMessage("Payment added as unposted.");
    } else if (
      paymentMode === "edit" &&
      selectedPayment &&
      !selectedPayment.posted
    ) {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("payments")
        .update(common)
        .eq("id", selectedPayment.id)
        .eq("posted", false);

      if (error) {
        setMessage(`Could not edit payment: ${error.message}`);
        setSavingPayment(false);
        return;
      }

      setMessage("Payment updated.");
    } else if (
      paymentMode === "correct" &&
      selectedPayment &&
      selectedPayment.posted
    ) {
      if (!correctionReason.trim()) {
        setMessage("Enter a reason for the correction.");
        setSavingPayment(false);
        return;
      }

      const { error } = await supabase.rpc(
        "correct_posted_payment",
        {
          p_payment_id: selectedPayment.id,
          p_payment_date:
            paymentForm.payment_date || todayISO(),
          p_amount: amount,
          p_payment_method: paymentForm.payment_method,
          p_reference: paymentForm.reference.trim() || null,
          p_notes: paymentForm.notes.trim() || null,
          p_reason: correctionReason.trim(),
        }
      );

      if (error) {
        setMessage(
          `Could not correct payment: ${error.message}`
        );
        setSavingPayment(false);
        return;
      }

      setMessage(
        "Posted payment corrected. The original remains in history with a reversal and replacement."
      );
    }

    await loadSalePayments(selectedSale.id);
    setPaymentFormOpen(false);
    setSelectedPayment(null);
    setCorrectionReason("");
    setSavingPayment(false);
  }

  async function postPayment(payment: Payment) {
    if (!supabase || payment.posted) return;

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Post ${money(numberOrZero(payment.amount))} ${payment.payment_method} payment? Posted payments stay in history; corrections are recorded with reversal entries.`
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from("payments")
      .update({
        posted: true,
        posted_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        posted_by: profile?.id || null,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq("id", payment.id)
      .eq("posted", false);

    if (error) {
      setMessage(`Could not post payment: ${error.message}`);
      return;
    }

    await loadSalePayments(payment.sales_order_id);
    setMessage("Payment posted.");
  }

  async function deleteUnpostedPayment(payment: Payment) {
    if (!supabase || payment.posted) return;

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Delete this unposted ${money(numberOrZero(payment.amount))} payment?`
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from("payments")
      .delete()
      .eq("id", payment.id)
      .eq("posted", false);

    if (error) {
      setMessage(`Could not delete payment: ${error.message}`);
      return;
    }

    await loadSalePayments(payment.sales_order_id);
    setMessage("Unposted payment deleted.");
  }

    setPurchaseOrderModalOpen(true);
    setPurchaseOrderAcknowledgements([]);
    setMessage("");

    const [itemResult, acknowledgementResult] =

          .from("purchase_order_items")

          .eq("purchase_order_id", order.id)
          .order("sort_order", { ascending: true }),

          .from("purchase_order_acknowledgements")
          .select(purchaseOrderAcknowledgementColumns)
          .eq("purchase_order_id", order.id)

    if (itemResult.error) {

      (itemResult.data || []) as PurchaseOrderItem[]
