  async function uploadPurchaseOrderAcknowledgement(
    file: File
  ) {
    if (
      !supabase ||
      !selectedPurchaseOrder ||
      !purchaseOrderForm
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const isPdf =
      file.type === "application/pdf" ||
      file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf");

    if (!isPdf) {
      window.alert(
        "Please choose a PDF acknowledgement file."
      );
      return;
    }

    const maxBytes = 25 * 1024 * 1024;
    if (file.size > maxBytes) {
      window.alert(
        "That PDF is larger than 25 MB. Please use a smaller file."
      );
      return;
    }

    setUploadingAcknowledgement(true);
    setMessage("");

    const safeName = file.name
      .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g, "-")
      .replace(/-+/g, "-");

    const storagePath =
      `${selectedPurchaseOrder.id}/` +
      `${Date.now()}-${safeName}`;

    const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
      .from("po-acknowledgements")
      .upload(storagePath, file, {
        cacheControl: "3600",
        upsert: false,
        contentType: "application/pdf",
      });

    if (uploadError) {
      setUploadingAcknowledgement(false);
      window.alert(
        `Could not upload acknowledgement: ${uploadError.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    const { error: recordError } = await supabase
      .from("purchase_order_acknowledgements")
      .insert({
        purchase_order_id: selectedPurchaseOrder.id,
        file_name: file.name,
        file_path: storagePath,
        comparison_status: "Pending",
        created_by: profile?.id || null,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      });

    if (recordError) {
      await supabase.storage
        .from("po-acknowledgements")
        .remove([storagePath]);

      setUploadingAcknowledgement(false);
      window.alert(
        `The PDF uploaded, but its PO record could not be saved: ${recordError.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    // Receiving the vendor acknowledgement is enough to move a
    // Draft/Submitted PO into Acknowledged. Keep any later status intact.
    const shouldAdvanceStatus =
      selectedPurchaseOrder.status === "Draft" ||
      selectedPurchaseOrder.status === "Submitted";

    if (shouldAdvanceStatus) {
      const nextAcknowledgementDate =
        purchaseOrderForm.acknowledgement_date ||
        todayISO();

      const { data: updatedOrder, error: orderUpdateError } =
        await supabase
          .from("purchase_orders")
          .update({
            status: "Acknowledged",
            acknowledgement_date: nextAcknowledgementDate,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          })
          .eq("id", selectedPurchaseOrder.id)
          .select(purchaseOrderColumns)
          .single();

      if (!orderUpdateError && updatedOrder) {
        const nextOrder = updatedOrder as PurchaseOrder;
        setSelectedPurchaseOrder(nextOrder);
        setPurchaseOrderForm(
          purchaseOrderToForm(nextOrder)
        );
      }
    }

    await Promise.all([
      loadPurchaseOrderAcknowledgements(
        selectedPurchaseOrder.id
      ),
      loadPurchaseOrders(),
    ]);

    setUploadingAcknowledgement(false);
    setMessage(
      `Acknowledgement uploaded to PO #${selectedPurchaseOrder.po_number}.`
    );
  }

  async function viewPurchaseOrderAcknowledgement(
    acknowledgement: PurchaseOrderAcknowledgement
  ) {
    if (!supabase || !acknowledgement.file_path) return;

    const { data, error } = await supabase.storage
      .from("po-acknowledgements")
      .createSignedUrl(acknowledgement.file_path, 300);

    if (error || !data?.signedUrl) {
      window.alert(
        `Could not open acknowledgement: ${
          error?.message || "No signed URL was returned."
        }`
      );
      return;
    }

    window.open(
      data.signedUrl,
      "_blank",
      "noopener,noreferrer"
    );
  }

  async function deletePurchaseOrderAcknowledgement(
    acknowledgement: PurchaseOrderAcknowledgement
  ) {
    if (!supabase || !selectedPurchaseOrder) return;

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Delete ${acknowledgement.file_name || "this acknowledgement"} from PO #${selectedPurchaseOrder.po_number}?`
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    setDeletingAcknowledgementId(acknowledgement.id);

    if (acknowledgement.file_path) {
      const { error: storageError } = await supabase.storage
        .from("po-acknowledgements")
        .remove([acknowledgement.file_path]);

      if (storageError) {
        setDeletingAcknowledgementId(null);
        window.alert(
          `Could not remove the PDF: ${storageError.message}`
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    const { error: recordError } = await supabase
      .from("purchase_order_acknowledgements")
      .delete()
      .eq("id", acknowledgement.id);

    if (recordError) {
      setDeletingAcknowledgementId(null);
      window.alert(
        `The PDF was removed, but its database record could not be deleted: ${recordError.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    await loadPurchaseOrderAcknowledgements(
      selectedPurchaseOrder.id
    );

    setDeletingAcknowledgementId(null);
    setMessage("Acknowledgement deleted.");
  }

  async function savePurchaseOrder() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedPurchaseOrder || !purchaseOrderForm) {
      return;
    }

    setSavingPurchaseOrder(true);
    setMessage("");

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("purchase_orders")
      .update({
        status: purchaseOrderForm.status,
        order_date: purchaseOrderForm.order_date || todayISO(),
        acknowledgement_number:
          purchaseOrderForm.acknowledgement_number.trim() || null,
        acknowledgement_date:
          purchaseOrderForm.acknowledgement_date || null,
        estimated_ship_date:
          purchaseOrderForm.estimated_ship_date || null,
        actual_ship_date:
          purchaseOrderForm.actual_ship_date || null,
        carrier: purchaseOrderForm.carrier.trim() || null,
        tracking_number:
          purchaseOrderForm.tracking_number.trim() || null,
        freight_amount: numberOrZero(
          purchaseOrderForm.freight_amount
        ),
        notes: purchaseOrderForm.notes.trim() || null,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq("id", selectedPurchaseOrder.id)
      .select(purchaseOrderColumns)
      .single();

    if (error || !data) {
      setMessage(
        `Could not save purchase order: ${
          error?.message || "Unknown error"
        }`
      );
      setSavingPurchaseOrder(false);
      return;
    }

    const updated = data as PurchaseOrder;
    setSelectedPurchaseOrder(updated);

    await loadPurchaseOrders();
    setSavingPurchaseOrder(false);
    setMessage(`PO #${updated.po_number} saved.`);
  }

  async function generatePurchaseOrdersFromSale() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedSale) {
      window.alert(
        "Open a sales order before generating purchase orders."
      );
      return;
    }

    setGeneratingPurchaseOrders(true);
    setMessage("");

    // Always pull the latest sale lines directly from Supabase.
    const { data: freshItemData, error: freshItemError } =
      await supabase
        .from("sales_order_items")
        .select(salesOrderItemColumns)
        .eq("sales_order_id", selectedSale.id)
        .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

    if (freshItemError) {
      setGeneratingPurchaseOrders(false);
      window.alert(
        `Could not load the sale items: ${freshItemError.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    const freshItems =
      (freshItemData || []) as SalesOrderItem[];

    setSaleItems(freshItems);

    const specialOrderItems = freshItems.filter(
      (item) => item.fulfillment_method === "Special Order"
    );

    if (specialOrderItems.length === 0) {
      setGeneratingPurchaseOrders(false);
      window.alert(
        "No PO was created because every item on this sales order is marked Inventory. Edit the sale and mark at least one item Special Order, save it, then try Generate POs again."
      );
      return;
    }

    const missingManufacturer = specialOrderItems.filter(
      (item) => !item.manufacturer_id
    );

    if (missingManufacturer.length > 0) {
      setGeneratingPurchaseOrders(false);
      window.alert(
        `${missingManufacturer.length} Special Order ${
          missingManufacturer.length === 1 ? "item is" : "items are"
        } missing a manufacturer. Edit the sales order, assign the manufacturer, save it, and try again.`
      );
      return;
    }

    const { data: freightData, error: freightError } =
      await supabase
        .from("sales_order_vendor_freight")
        .select(vendorFreightColumns)
        .eq("sales_order_id", selectedSale.id);

    if (freightError) {
      setGeneratingPurchaseOrders(false);
      window.alert(
        `Could not load vendor freight: ${freightError.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    const currentVendorFreight =
      (freightData || []) as VendorFreight[];

    setVendorFreight(currentVendorFreight);

    const groups = new Map<string, SalesOrderItem[]>();

    specialOrderItems.forEach((item) => {
      const manufacturerId = item.manufacturer_id as string;
      const group = groups.get(manufacturerId) || [];
      group.push(item);
      groups.set(manufacturerId, group);
    });

    const { data: existingData, error: existingError } =
      await supabase
        .from("purchase_orders")
        .select(purchaseOrderColumns)
        .eq("sales_order_id", selectedSale.id);

    if (existingError) {
      setGeneratingPurchaseOrders(false);
      window.alert(
        `Could not check existing purchase orders: ${existingError.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    const existingOrders =
      (existingData || []) as PurchaseOrder[];

    let createdCount = 0;
    let updatedCount = 0;
    const lockedVendors: string[] = [];

    for (const [manufacturerId, items] of groups.entries()) {
      const manufacturer = manufacturers.find(
        (entry) => entry.id === manufacturerId
      );

      const freightRow = currentVendorFreight.find(
        (row) => row.manufacturer_id === manufacturerId
      );

      let order = existingOrders.find(
        (entry) => entry.manufacturer_id === manufacturerId
      );

      if (!order) {
        const firstItem = items[0];

        const { data: orderData, error: orderError } =
          await supabase
            .from("purchase_orders")
            .insert({
              sales_order_id: selectedSale.id,
              manufacturer_id: manufacturerId,
              status: "Draft",
              order_date: todayISO(),
              freight_amount: numberOrZero(
                freightRow?.amount
              ),
              notes: freightRow?.notes || null,
              created_by: profile?.id || null,
              purchasing_factor_snapshot:
                firstItem.purchasing_factor_snapshot ??
                manufacturer?.purchasing_factor ??
                null,
              tariff_pct_snapshot:
                firstItem.tariff_pct_snapshot ??
                manufacturer?.tariff_pct ??
                0,
              surcharge_pct_snapshot:
                firstItem.surcharge_pct_snapshot ??
                manufacturer?.surcharge_pct ??
                0,
              updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            })
            .select(purchaseOrderColumns)
            .single();

        if (orderError || !orderData) {
          setGeneratingPurchaseOrders(false);
          window.alert(
            `Could not create a PO for ${
              manufacturer?.name || "the manufacturer"
            }: ${orderError?.message || "Unknown error"}`
          );
          return;
        }

        order = orderData as PurchaseOrder;
        existingOrders.push(order);
        createdCount += 1;
      } else if (order.status !== "Draft") {
        lockedVendors.push(
          manufacturer?.name || "Manufacturer"
        );
        continue;
      } else {
        const { error: updateError } = await supabase
          .from("purchase_orders")
          .update({
            freight_amount: numberOrZero(
              freightRow?.amount
            ),
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          })
          .eq("id", order.id);

        if (updateError) {
          setGeneratingPurchaseOrders(false);
          window.alert(
            `Could not update freight on PO #${order.po_number}: ${updateError.message}`
          );
          return;
        }
      }

      const { data: existingItemsData, error: existingItemsError } =
        await supabase
          .from("purchase_order_items")
          .select(purchaseOrderItemColumns)
          .eq("purchase_order_id", order.id);

      if (existingItemsError) {
        setGeneratingPurchaseOrders(false);
        window.alert(
          `Could not inspect PO #${order.po_number}: ${existingItemsError.message}`
        );
        return;
      }

      const existingItems =
        (existingItemsData || []) as PurchaseOrderItem[];

      const existingSalesItemIds = new Set(
        existingItems
          .map((item) => item.sales_order_item_id)
          .filter(Boolean)
      );

      const missingItems = items.filter(
        (item) => !existingSalesItemIds.has(item.id)
      );

      if (missingItems.length > 0) {
        const { error: itemInsertError } = await supabase
          .from("purchase_order_items")
          .insert(
            missingItems.map((item, index) => ({
              purchase_order_id: order!.id,
              sales_order_item_id: item.id,
              manufacturer_id: manufacturerId,
              sort_order: existingItems.length + index,
              quantity: Math.max(
                1,
                numberOrZero(item.quantity)
              ),
              sku: item.sku || null,
              description: item.description || null,
              finish: item.finish || null,
              fabric_name: item.fabric_name || null,
              grade: item.grade || null,
              unit_cost: numberOrZero(
                item.expected_unit_cost
              ),
              acknowledged_unit_cost:
                item.acknowledged_unit_cost,
              updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            }))
          );

        if (itemInsertError) {
          setGeneratingPurchaseOrders(false);
          window.alert(
            `PO #${order.po_number} was created, but its merchandise lines failed: ${itemInsertError.message}`
          );
          return;
        }

        if (createdCount === 0) {
          updatedCount += 1;
        }
      }
    }

    await loadPurchaseOrders();
    setGeneratingPurchaseOrders(false);

    let resultMessage = "";

    if (lockedVendors.length > 0) {
      resultMessage =
        `PO generation finished. ${lockedVendors.join(
          ", "
        )} already has a PO beyond Draft, so the existing vendor PO was left unchanged.`;
    } else if (createdCount > 0) {
      resultMessage =
        `${createdCount} purchase order${
          createdCount === 1 ? "" : "s"
        } generated from Sale #${selectedSale.sale_number}.`;
    } else if (updatedCount > 0) {
      resultMessage =
        `Existing Draft POs were updated from Sale #${selectedSale.sale_number}.`;
    } else {
      resultMessage =
        `Sale #${selectedSale.sale_number} already has Draft POs for all Special Order items.`;
    }

    setSaleModalOpen(false);
    setView("purchase_orders");
    setMessage(resultMessage);
  }

  async function saveInventoryItem() {
    if (!supabase) return;

    if (!inventoryForm.name.trim()) {
      window.alert("Inventory item name is required.");
      return;
    }

    setSavingInventoryItem(true);
    setMessage("");

    const payload = {
      sku: inventoryForm.sku.trim() || null,
      name: inventoryForm.name.trim(),
      manufacturer_id:
        inventoryForm.manufacturer_id || null,
      description:
        inventoryForm.description.trim() || null,
      location: inventoryForm.location.trim() || null,
      unit_cost: numberOrZero(inventoryForm.unit_cost),
      msrp: numberOrZero(inventoryForm.msrp),
      active: inventoryForm.active,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    if (inventoryMode === "new") {
      const startingQuantity = Math.trunc(
        numberOrZero(inventoryForm.quantity_on_hand)
      );

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("inventory_items")
        .insert({
          ...payload,
          quantity_on_hand: startingQuantity,
        })
        .select(inventoryItemColumns)
        .single();

      if (error || !data) {
        setSavingInventoryItem(false);
        window.alert(
          `Could not create inventory item: ${
            error?.message || "Unknown error"
          }`
        );
        return;
      }

      const created = data as InventoryItem;

      if (startingQuantity !== 0) {
        await supabase
          .from("inventory_movements")
          .insert({
            inventory_item_id: created.id,
            movement_type: "Initial Balance",
            quantity_change: startingQuantity,
            quantity_before: 0,
            quantity_after: startingQuantity,
            to_location: created.location,
            reason: "Initial inventory balance",
            created_by: profile?.id || null,
          });
      }

      setSelectedInventoryItem(created);
      setInventoryForm(inventoryItemToForm(created));
      setInventoryMode("view");
      await Promise.all([
        loadInventoryItems(),
        loadInventoryItemDetails(created.id),
      ]);
      setSavingInventoryItem(false);
      setMessage(`${created.name} added to inventory.`);
      return;
    }

    if (!selectedInventoryItem) {
      setSavingInventoryItem(false);
      return;
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("inventory_items")
      .update(payload)
      .eq("id", selectedInventoryItem.id)
      .select(inventoryItemColumns)
      .single();

    if (error || !data) {
      setSavingInventoryItem(false);
      window.alert(
        `Could not save inventory item: ${
          error?.message || "Unknown error"
        }`
      );
      return;
    }

    const updated = data as InventoryItem;
    setSelectedInventoryItem(updated);
    setInventoryForm(inventoryItemToForm(updated));
    setInventoryMode("view");

    await loadInventoryItems();
    setSavingInventoryItem(false);
    setMessage(`${updated.name} saved.`);
  }

  async function deleteInventoryItem() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedInventoryItem) return;

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Delete ${selectedInventoryItem.name} from inventory? This also removes its scan codes, tags and movement history.`
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from("inventory_items")
      .delete()
      .eq("id", selectedInventoryItem.id);

    if (error) {
      window.alert(
        `Could not delete inventory item: ${error.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    closeInventoryModal();
    await loadInventoryItems();
    setMessage("Inventory item deleted.");
  }

  async function addInventoryScanCode() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedInventoryItem) return;

    const scanCode = newScanCode.trim();
    if (!scanCode) return;

    const { data: duplicate, error: lookupError } =
      await supabase
        .from("inventory_scan_codes")
        .select("id,inventory_item_id")
        .eq("scan_code", scanCode)
        .limit(1);

    if (lookupError) {
      window.alert(
        `Could not check scan code: ${lookupError.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    if ((duplicate || []).length > 0) {
      window.alert(
        "That scan code is already assigned to an inventory item."
      );
      return;
    }

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from("inventory_scan_codes")
      .insert({
        inventory_item_id: selectedInventoryItem.id,
        scan_code: scanCode,
        code_type: newScanCodeType || "QR",
      });

    if (error) {
      window.alert(
        `Could not add scan code: ${error.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    setNewScanCode("");
    await loadInventoryItemDetails(selectedInventoryItem.id);
  }

  async function deleteInventoryScanCode(
    scanCode: InventoryScanCode
  ) {
    if (!supabase || !selectedInventoryItem) return;

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from("inventory_scan_codes")
      .delete()
      .eq("id", scanCode.id);

    if (error) {
      window.alert(
        `Could not remove scan code: ${error.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    await loadInventoryItemDetails(selectedInventoryItem.id);
  }

  async function toggleInventoryTag(tag: InventoryTag) {
    if (!supabase || !selectedInventoryItem) return;

    const attached = inventoryItemTags.some(
      (entry) => entry.id === tag.id
    );

    if (attached) {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("inventory_item_tags")
        .delete()
        .eq("inventory_item_id", selectedInventoryItem.id)
        .eq("tag_id", tag.id);

      if (error) {
        window.alert(
          `Could not remove tag: ${error.message}`
        );
        return;
      }
    } else {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("inventory_item_tags")
        .insert({
          inventory_item_id: selectedInventoryItem.id,
          tag_id: tag.id,
        });

      if (error) {
        window.alert(
          `Could not add tag: ${error.message}`
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    await loadInventoryItemDetails(selectedInventoryItem.id);
  }

  async function createAndAttachInventoryTag() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedInventoryItem) return;

    const name = newInventoryTagName.trim();
    if (!name) return;

    let tag = inventoryTags.find(
      (entry) =>
        entry.name.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase()
    );

    if (!tag) {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("inventory_tags")
        .insert({ name })
        .select(inventoryTagColumns)
        .single();

      if (error || !data) {
        window.alert(
          `Could not create tag: ${
            error?.message || "Unknown error"
          }`
        );
        return;
      }

      tag = data as InventoryTag;
      await loadInventoryTags();
    }

    const alreadyAttached = inventoryItemTags.some(
      (entry) => entry.id === tag!.id
    );

    if (!alreadyAttached) {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("inventory_item_tags")
        .insert({
          inventory_item_id: selectedInventoryItem.id,
          tag_id: tag.id,
        });

      if (error) {
        window.alert(
          `Could not attach tag: ${error.message}`
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    setNewInventoryTagName("");
    await loadInventoryTags();
    await loadInventoryItemDetails(selectedInventoryItem.id);
  }

  async function saveInventoryAdjustment() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedInventoryItem) return;

    const quantityChange = Math.trunc(
      numberOrZero(
        inventoryAdjustmentForm.quantity_change
      )
    );

    if (quantityChange === 0) {
      window.alert(
        "Enter a positive or negative quantity change."
      );
      return;
    }

    const before = Math.trunc(
      numberOrZero(
        selectedInventoryItem.quantity_on_hand
      )
    );
    const after = before + quantityChange;

    if (after < 0) {
      const confirmed = window.confirm(
        `This adjustment would leave ${after} units on hand. Continue anyway?`
      );
      if (!confirmed) return;
    }

    setSavingInventoryAdjustment(true);

    const nextLocation =
      inventoryAdjustmentForm.to_location.trim() ||
      selectedInventoryItem.location ||
      null;

    const { data, error: updateError } = await supabase
      .from("inventory_items")
      .update({
        quantity_on_hand: after,
        location: nextLocation,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq("id", selectedInventoryItem.id)
      .select(inventoryItemColumns)
      .single();

    if (updateError || !data) {
      setSavingInventoryAdjustment(false);
      window.alert(
        `Could not update inventory quantity: ${
          updateError?.message || "Unknown error"
        }`
      );
      return;
    }

    const { error: movementError } = await supabase
      .from("inventory_movements")
      .insert({
        inventory_item_id: selectedInventoryItem.id,
        movement_type:
          inventoryAdjustmentForm.movement_type ||
          "Adjustment",
        quantity_change: quantityChange,
        quantity_before: before,
        quantity_after: after,
        from_location:
          inventoryAdjustmentForm.from_location.trim() ||
          selectedInventoryItem.location ||
          null,
        to_location: nextLocation,
        reason:
          inventoryAdjustmentForm.reason.trim() || null,
        notes:
          inventoryAdjustmentForm.notes.trim() || null,
        created_by: profile?.id || null,
      });

    if (movementError) {
      await supabase
        .from("inventory_items")
        .update({
          quantity_on_hand: before,
          location: selectedInventoryItem.location,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq("id", selectedInventoryItem.id);

      setSavingInventoryAdjustment(false);
      window.alert(
        `The quantity change was rolled back because movement history could not be saved: ${movementError.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    const updated = data as InventoryItem;
    setSelectedInventoryItem(updated);
    setInventoryForm(inventoryItemToForm(updated));
    setInventoryAdjustmentOpen(false);
    setInventoryAdjustmentForm(
      blankInventoryAdjustmentForm
    );

    await Promise.all([
      loadInventoryItems(),
      loadInventoryItemDetails(updated.id),
    ]);

    setSavingInventoryAdjustment(false);
    setMessage(
      `${updated.name} inventory adjusted to ${after}.`
    );
  }

  function exportInventoryCsv() {
    const headers = [
      "sku",
      "name",
      "manufacturer",
      "description",
      "location",
      "quantity_on_hand",
      "unit_cost",
      "msrp",
      "active",
    ];

    const rows = inventoryItems.map((item) => [
      item.sku || "",
      item.name,
      inventoryManufacturerName(item.manufacturer_id),
      item.description || "",
      item.location || "",
      item.quantity_on_hand,
      item.unit_cost,
      item.msrp,
      item.active ? "true" : "false",
    ]);

    const csv = [
      headers.map(csvEscape).join(","),
      ...rows.map((row) =>
        row.map(csvEscape).join(",")
      ),
    ].join("\n");

    const blob = new Blob([csv], {
      type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8",
    });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = "designers-patio-inventory.csv";
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
  }

  async function importInventoryCsv(file: File) {
    if (!supabase) return;

    setImportingInventory(true);
    setMessage("");

    try {
      const source = await file.text();
      const lines = source
        .split(/\r?\n/)
        .filter((line) => line.trim().length > 0);

      if (lines.length < 2) {
        window.alert(
          "The CSV needs a header row and at least one inventory item."
        );
        setImportingInventory(false);
        return;
      }

      const headers = parseCsvLine(lines[0]).map(
        (header) => header.trim().toLowerCase()
      );

      if (!headers.includes("name")) {
        window.alert(
          'The CSV needs a "name" column. Export the current inventory CSV first if you want a template.'
        );
        setImportingInventory(false);
        return;
      }

      const payloads = lines
        .slice(1)
        .map(parseCsvLine)
        .map((row) => {
          const get = (column: string) => {
            const index = headers.indexOf(column);
            return index >= 0 ? row[index] || "" : "";
          };

          const manufacturerName =
            get("manufacturer").trim();

          const manufacturer = manufacturers.find(
            (entry) =>
              entry.name.toLowerCase() ===
              manufacturerName.toLowerCase()
          );

          return {
            sku: get("sku").trim() || null,
            name: get("name").trim(),
            manufacturer_id: manufacturer?.id || null,
            description:
              get("description").trim() || null,
            location: get("location").trim() || null,
            quantity_on_hand: Math.trunc(
              numberOrZero(get("quantity_on_hand"))
            ),
            unit_cost: numberOrZero(get("unit_cost")),
            msrp: numberOrZero(get("msrp")),
            active:
              !["false", "0", "no", "inactive"].includes(
                get("active").trim().toLowerCase()
              ),
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          };
        })
        .filter((row) => row.name);

      if (payloads.length === 0) {
        window.alert(
          "No inventory rows with a name were found."
        );
        setImportingInventory(false);
        return;
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("inventory_items")
        .insert(payloads)
        .select(inventoryItemColumns);

      if (error) {
        window.alert(
          `Could not import inventory: ${error.message}`
        );
        setImportingInventory(false);
        return;
      }

      const created = (data || []) as InventoryItem[];

      const movementPayloads = created
        .filter(
          (item) =>
            numberOrZero(item.quantity_on_hand) !== 0
        )
        .map((item) => ({
          inventory_item_id: item.id,
          movement_type: "CSV Import",
          quantity_change: numberOrZero(
            item.quantity_on_hand
          ),
          quantity_before: 0,
          quantity_after: numberOrZero(
            item.quantity_on_hand
          ),
          to_location: item.location,
          reason: "Initial quantity from CSV import",
          created_by: profile?.id || null,
        }));

      if (movementPayloads.length > 0) {
        await supabase
          .from("inventory_movements")
          .insert(movementPayloads);
      }

      await loadInventoryItems();
      setImportingInventory(false);
      setMessage(
        `${created.length} inventory item${
          created.length === 1 ? "" : "s"
        } imported.`
      );
    } catch (error) {
      setImportingInventory(false);
      window.alert(
        `Could not read CSV: ${
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Unknown error"
        }`
      );
    }
  }

  async function selectInvoicePurchaseOrder(
    purchaseOrderId: string
  ) {
    const po = purchaseOrders.find(
      (order) => order.id === purchaseOrderId
    );

    setVendorInvoiceForm((current) => ({
      ...current,
      purchase_order_id: purchaseOrderId,
      manufacturer_id:
        po?.manufacturer_id ||
        current.manufacturer_id,
    }));

    if (purchaseOrderId) {
      await loadAccountingPoItems(purchaseOrderId);
    } else {

  async function loadPoItemsIntoVendorInvoice() {
    const purchaseOrderId =
      vendorInvoiceForm.purchase_order_id;

    if (!purchaseOrderId) {
      window.alert(
        "Choose a purchase order first."
      );
      return;
    }

    const poItems =
      accountingPoItems.length > 0
        ? accountingPoItems
        : await loadAccountingPoItems(
            purchaseOrderId
          );

    if (poItems.length === 0) {
      window.alert(
        "That purchase order does not have any items."
      );
      return;
    }

    const mapped: VendorInvoiceItem[] =
      poItems.map((item, index) => {
        const unitCost = numberOrZero(
          item.acknowledged_unit_cost ??
            item.unit_cost
        );

        return {
          purchase_order_item_id: item.id,
          sales_order_item_id:
            item.sales_order_item_id || null,
          manufacturer_id:
            item.manufacturer_id ||
            vendorInvoiceForm.manufacturer_id ||
            null,
          sort_order: index,
          quantity: Math.max(
            1,
            Math.trunc(numberOrZero(item.quantity))
          ),
          sku: item.sku || null,
          description: item.description || null,
          invoiced_unit_cost: unitCost,
          extended_cost:
            Math.max(
              1,
              Math.trunc(
                numberOrZero(item.quantity)
              )
            ) * unitCost,
          notes: null,
        };
      });

    setVendorInvoiceItems(mapped);
  }

  function addVendorInvoiceLine() {
    setVendorInvoiceItems((current) => [
      ...current,
      {
        purchase_order_item_id: null,
        sales_order_item_id: null,
        manufacturer_id:
          vendorInvoiceForm.manufacturer_id || null,
        sort_order: current.length,
        quantity: 1,
        sku: null,
        description: null,
        invoiced_unit_cost: 0,
        extended_cost: 0,
        notes: null,
      },
    ]);
  }

  function updateVendorInvoiceLine(
    index: number,
    field: keyof VendorInvoiceItem,
    value: string | number | null
  ) {
    setVendorInvoiceItems((current) =>
      current.map((item, itemIndex) => {
        if (itemIndex !== index) return item;

        const updated = {
          ...item,
          [field]: value,
        } as VendorInvoiceItem;

        const quantity = Math.max(
          0,
          Math.trunc(
            numberOrZero(updated.quantity)
          )
        );
        const unitCost = numberOrZero(
          updated.invoiced_unit_cost
        );

        updated.quantity = quantity;
        updated.invoiced_unit_cost = unitCost;
        updated.extended_cost =
          quantity * unitCost;
        updated.sort_order = index;

        return updated;
      })
    );
  }

  function removeVendorInvoiceLine(index: number) {
    setVendorInvoiceItems((current) =>
      current
        .filter((_, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== index)
        .map((item, itemIndex) => ({
          ...item,
          sort_order: itemIndex,
        }))
    );
  }

  async function saveVendorInvoice() {
    if (!supabase) return;

    if (!vendorInvoiceForm.manufacturer_id) {
      window.alert(
        "Choose a manufacturer for this vendor invoice."
      );
      return;
    }

    setSavingVendorInvoice(true);

    const merchandiseAmount =
      vendorInvoiceItems.reduce(
        (sum, item) =>
          sum +
          numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
            numberOrZero(
              item.invoiced_unit_cost
            ),
        0
      );

    const freightAmount = numberOrZero(
      vendorInvoiceForm.freight_amount
    );
    const taxAmount = numberOrZero(
      vendorInvoiceForm.tax_amount
    );
    const otherAmount = numberOrZero(
      vendorInvoiceForm.other_amount
    );
    const totalAmount =
      merchandiseAmount +
      freightAmount +
      taxAmount +
      otherAmount;

    const payload = {
      vendor_invoice_number:
        vendorInvoiceForm.vendor_invoice_number.trim() ||
        null,
      manufacturer_id:
        vendorInvoiceForm.manufacturer_id,
      purchase_order_id:
        vendorInvoiceForm.purchase_order_id || null,
      invoice_date:
        vendorInvoiceForm.invoice_date ||
        todayISO(),
      due_date:
        vendorInvoiceForm.due_date || null,
      status: vendorInvoiceForm.status,
      merchandise_amount: merchandiseAmount,
      freight_amount: freightAmount,
      tax_amount: taxAmount,
      other_amount: otherAmount,
      total_amount: totalAmount,
      notes:
        vendorInvoiceForm.notes.trim() || null,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    let savedInvoice: VendorInvoice | null =
      selectedVendorInvoice;

    if (vendorInvoiceMode === "new") {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("vendor_invoices")
        .insert({
          ...payload,
          created_by: profile?.id || null,
        })
        .select(vendorInvoiceColumns)
        .single();

      if (error || !data) {
        setSavingVendorInvoice(false);
        window.alert(
          `Could not create vendor invoice: ${
            error?.message || "Unknown error"
          }`
        );
        return;
      }

      savedInvoice = data as VendorInvoice;
    } else if (selectedVendorInvoice) {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("vendor_invoices")
        .update(payload)
        .eq("id", selectedVendorInvoice.id)
        .select(vendorInvoiceColumns)
        .single();

      if (error || !data) {
        setSavingVendorInvoice(false);
        window.alert(
          `Could not save vendor invoice: ${
            error?.message || "Unknown error"
          }`
        );
        return;
      }

      savedInvoice = data as VendorInvoice;
    }

    if (!savedInvoice) {
      setSavingVendorInvoice(false);
      return;
    }

    const { error: deleteLineError } =
      await supabase
        .from("vendor_invoice_items")
        .delete()
        .eq(
          "vendor_invoice_id",
          savedInvoice.id
        );

    if (deleteLineError) {
      setSavingVendorInvoice(false);
      window.alert(
        `Invoice header saved, but existing invoice lines could not be replaced: ${deleteLineError.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    if (vendorInvoiceItems.length > 0) {
      const linePayloads =
        vendorInvoiceItems.map(
          (item, index) => ({
            vendor_invoice_id:
              savedInvoice!.id,
            purchase_order_item_id:
              item.purchase_order_item_id ||
              null,
            sales_order_item_id:
              item.sales_order_item_id || null,
            manufacturer_id:
              item.manufacturer_id ||
              vendorInvoiceForm.manufacturer_id ||
              null,
            sort_order: index,
            quantity: Math.max(
              0,
              Math.trunc(
                numberOrZero(item.quantity)
              )
            ),
            sku: item.sku || null,
            description:
              item.description || null,
            invoiced_unit_cost:
              numberOrZero(
                item.invoiced_unit_cost
              ),
            extended_cost:
              Math.max(
                0,
                Math.trunc(
                  numberOrZero(item.quantity)
                )
              ) *
              numberOrZero(
                item.invoiced_unit_cost
              ),
            notes: item.notes || null,
            updated_at:
              new Date().toISOString(),
          })
        );

      const { error: lineError } =
        await supabase
          .from("vendor_invoice_items")
          .insert(linePayloads);

      if (lineError) {
        setSavingVendorInvoice(false);
        window.alert(
          `Invoice header saved, but invoice lines could not be saved: ${lineError.message}`
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    setSelectedVendorInvoice(savedInvoice);
    setVendorInvoiceForm(
      vendorInvoiceToForm(savedInvoice)
    );
    setVendorInvoiceMode("view");

    await Promise.all([
      loadVendorInvoiceItems(savedInvoice.id),
      loadAccounting(),
    ]);

    setSavingVendorInvoice(false);
    setMessage(
      `Vendor invoice #${savedInvoice.invoice_number} saved.`
    );
  }

  async function deleteVendorInvoice() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedVendorInvoice)
      return;

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Delete vendor invoice #${selectedVendorInvoice.invoice_number}?`

    if (!confirmed) return;

    const { error } = await supabase

      window.alert(
        `Could not delete vendor invoice: ${error.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    closeVendorInvoiceModal();
    await loadAccounting();
    setMessage("Vendor invoice deleted.");
  }

  async function saveExpense() {
    if (!supabase) return;

    if (!expenseForm.payee.trim()) {
      window.alert("Expense payee is required.");
      return;
    }

    const amount = numberOrZero(
      expenseForm.amount
    );

    if (amount < 0) {
      window.alert(
        "Expense amount cannot be negative."
      );
      return;
    }

    setSavingExpense(true);

    const payload = {
      expense_date:
        expenseForm.expense_date || todayISO(),
      payee: expenseForm.payee.trim(),
      category:
        expenseForm.category.trim() || null,
      description:
        expenseForm.description.trim() || null,
      amount,
      payment_method:
        expenseForm.payment_method.trim() ||
        null,
      reference:
        expenseForm.reference.trim() || null,
      manufacturer_id:
        expenseForm.manufacturer_id || null,
      purchase_order_id:
        expenseForm.purchase_order_id || null,
      sales_order_id:
        expenseForm.sales_order_id || null,
      notes: expenseForm.notes.trim() || null,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    let saved: Expense | null = null;

    if (expenseMode === "new") {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("expenses")
        .insert({
          ...payload,
          created_by: profile?.id || null,
        })
        .select(expenseColumns)
        .single();

      if (error || !data) {
        setSavingExpense(false);
        window.alert(
          `Could not create expense: ${
            error?.message || "Unknown error"
          }`
        );
        return;
      }

      saved = data as Expense;
    } else if (selectedExpense) {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("expenses")
        .update(payload)
        .eq("id", selectedExpense.id)
        .select(expenseColumns)
        .single();

      if (error || !data) {
        setSavingExpense(false);
        window.alert(
          `Could not save expense: ${
            error?.message || "Unknown error"
          }`
        );
        return;
      }

      saved = data as Expense;
    }

    if (!saved) {
      setSavingExpense(false);
      return;
    }

    setSelectedExpense(saved);
    setExpenseForm(expenseToForm(saved));
    setExpenseMode("view");
    await loadAccounting();
    setSavingExpense(false);
    setMessage(
      `Expense #${saved.expense_number} saved.`
    );
  }

  async function deleteExpense() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedExpense) return;

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Delete expense #${selectedExpense.expense_number}?`
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from("expenses")
      .delete()
      .eq("id", selectedExpense.id);

    if (error) {
      window.alert(
        `Could not delete expense: ${error.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    closeExpenseModal();
    await loadAccounting();
    setMessage("Expense deleted.");
  }

  async function openDailyCashBatch(
    batch: DailyCashBatch
  ) {
    setSelectedDailyCashBatch(batch);
    setDailyCashDate(batch.business_date);
    setDailyCashNotes(batch.notes || "");
    setMessage("");
    await loadDailyCashBatchDetails(batch);
  }

  async function createOrOpenDailyCashBatch() {
    if (!supabase) return;

    const existing = dailyCashBatches.find(
      (batch) =>
        batch.business_date === dailyCashDate &&
        batch.status === "Open"
    );

    if (existing) {
      await openDailyCashBatch(existing);
      return;
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("daily_cash_batches")
      .insert({
        business_date: dailyCashDate,
        status: "Open",
        created_by: profile?.id || null,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .select(dailyCashBatchColumns)
      .single();

    if (error || !data) {
      window.alert(
        `Could not create Daily Cash batch: ${
          error?.message || "Unknown error"
        }`
      );
      return;
    }

    const created = data as DailyCashBatch;
    await loadDailyCashBatches();
    await openDailyCashBatch(created);
    setMessage(
      `Daily Cash batch #${created.batch_number} opened for ${created.business_date}.`
    );
  }

  async function syncDailyCashBatchPayments(
    batch: DailyCashBatch,
    showMessage = true
  ) {
    if (!supabase) return [] as Payment[];

    if (batch.status === "Posted") {
      if (showMessage) {
        window.alert(
          "Posted Daily Cash batches are locked. Payment corrections will appear in a later open batch."
        );
      }
      return dailyCashBatchPayments;
    }

    setDailyCashSyncing(true);

    const range = localDateRange(batch.business_date);

    const { data: candidateData, error: candidateError } =
      await supabase
        .from("payments")
        .select(paymentColumns)
        .eq("posted", true)
        .gte("posted_at", range.start)
        .lt("posted_at", range.end)
        .order("posted_at", { ascending: true });

    if (candidateError) {
      setDailyCashSyncing(false);
      window.alert(
        `Could not find posted payments: ${candidateError.message}`
      );
      return dailyCashBatchPayments;
    }

    const candidates = (candidateData || []) as Payment[];

    if (candidates.length > 0) {
      const candidateIds = candidates.map(
        (payment) => payment.id
      );

      const { data: linkedData, error: linkedError } =
        await supabase
          .from("daily_cash_batch_payments")
          .select(dailyCashBatchPaymentColumns)
          .in("payment_id", candidateIds);

      if (linkedError) {
        setDailyCashSyncing(false);
        window.alert(
          `Could not check batched payments: ${linkedError.message}`
        );
        return dailyCashBatchPayments;
      }

      const alreadyLinked = new Set(
        ((linkedData || []) as DailyCashBatchPayment[]).map(
          (link) => link.payment_id
        )
      );

      const unlinked = candidates.filter(
        (payment) => !alreadyLinked.has(payment.id)
      );

      if (unlinked.length > 0) {
        const { error: insertError } = await supabase
          .from("daily_cash_batch_payments")
          .insert(
            unlinked.map((payment) => ({
              daily_cash_batch_id: batch.id,
              payment_id: payment.id,
            }))
          );

        if (insertError) {
          setDailyCashSyncing(false);
          window.alert(
            `Could not add payments to Daily Cash: ${insertError.message}`
          );
          return dailyCashBatchPayments;
        }
      }
    }

    const { data: linkData, error: linkError } =
      await supabase
        .from("daily_cash_batch_payments")
        .select(dailyCashBatchPaymentColumns)
        .eq("daily_cash_batch_id", batch.id)
        .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

    if (linkError) {
      setDailyCashSyncing(false);
      window.alert(
        `Could not reload Daily Cash links: ${linkError.message}`
      );
      return dailyCashBatchPayments;
    }

    const links =
      (linkData || []) as DailyCashBatchPayment[];
    const paymentIds = links.map((link) => link.payment_id);

    let batchPayments: Payment[] = [];

    if (paymentIds.length > 0) {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("payments")
        .select(paymentColumns)
        .in("id", paymentIds)
        .order("posted_at", { ascending: true });

      if (error) {
        setDailyCashSyncing(false);
        window.alert(
          `Could not reload Daily Cash payments: ${error.message}`
        );
        return dailyCashBatchPayments;
      }

      batchPayments = (data || []) as Payment[];
    }

    const existingTenderRows =
      dailyCashTenderTotals.length > 0
        ? dailyCashTenderTotals
        : (
            (
              await supabase
                .from("daily_cash_tender_totals")
                .select(dailyCashTenderTotalColumns)
                .eq("daily_cash_batch_id", batch.id)
            ).data || []
          ) as DailyCashTenderTotal[];

    const tenderPayloads = paymentMethods.map(
      (method) => {
        const systemAmount = batchPayments
          .filter(
            (payment) =>
              payment.payment_method === method
          )
          .reduce(
            (sum, payment) =>
              sum + numberOrZero(payment.amount),
            0
          );

        const existing = existingTenderRows.find(
          (row) => row.payment_method === method
        );

        const currentDraft =
          dailyCashTenderDrafts[method];

        const actualAmount =
          currentDraft != null
            ? numberOrZero(currentDraft.actual_amount)
            : existing != null
            ? numberOrZero(existing.actual_amount)
            : systemAmount;

        const notes =
          currentDraft?.notes ??
          existing?.notes ??
          "";

        return {
          daily_cash_batch_id: batch.id,
          payment_method: method,
          system_amount: systemAmount,
          actual_amount: actualAmount,
          variance_amount:
            actualAmount - systemAmount,
          notes: notes.trim() || null,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
      }
    );

    const { error: tenderError } = await supabase
      .from("daily_cash_tender_totals")
      .upsert(tenderPayloads, {
        onConflict:
          "daily_cash_batch_id,payment_method",
      });

    if (tenderError) {
      setDailyCashSyncing(false);
      window.alert(
        `Could not refresh tender totals: ${tenderError.message}`
      );
      return batchPayments;
    }

    setDailyCashBatchPayments(batchPayments);

    await Promise.all([
      loadDailyCashBatchDetails(batch),
      loadDailyCashBatches(),
    ]);

    setDailyCashSyncing(false);

    if (showMessage) {
      setMessage(
        `Daily Cash #${batch.batch_number} refreshed with ${batchPayments.length} posted payment${
          batchPayments.length === 1 ? "" : "s"
        }.`
      );
    }

    return batchPayments;
  }

  function updateDailyCashTenderDraft(
    paymentMethod: string,
    field: keyof DailyCashTenderDraft,
    value: string
  ) {
    setDailyCashTenderDrafts((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [paymentMethod]: {
        actual_amount:
          current[paymentMethod]?.actual_amount || "0",
        notes: current[paymentMethod]?.notes || "",
        [field]: value,
      },
    }));
  }

  async function saveDailyCashReconciliation() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedDailyCashBatch) return;

    if (selectedDailyCashBatch.status === "Posted") {
      window.alert(
        "This Daily Cash batch is posted and locked."
      );
      return;
    }

    const tenderPayloads = paymentMethods.map(
      (method) => {
        const systemAmount = dailyCashBatchPayments
          .filter(
            (payment) =>
              payment.payment_method === method
          )
          .reduce(
            (sum, payment) =>
              sum + numberOrZero(payment.amount),
            0
          );

        const actualAmount = numberOrZero(
          dailyCashTenderDrafts[method]?.actual_amount
        );

        return {
          daily_cash_batch_id:
            selectedDailyCashBatch.id,
          payment_method: method,
          system_amount: systemAmount,
          actual_amount: actualAmount,
          variance_amount:
            actualAmount - systemAmount,
          notes:
            dailyCashTenderDrafts[
              method
            ]?.notes?.trim() || null,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
      }
    );

    const [tenderResult, batchResult] =
      await Promise.all([
        supabase
          .from("daily_cash_tender_totals")
          .upsert(tenderPayloads, {
            onConflict:
              "daily_cash_batch_id,payment_method",
          }),
        supabase
          .from("daily_cash_batches")
          .update({
            notes: dailyCashNotes.trim() || null,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          })
          .eq("id", selectedDailyCashBatch.id)
          .select(dailyCashBatchColumns)
          .single(),
      ]);

    if (tenderResult.error) {
      window.alert(
        `Could not save tender totals: ${tenderResult.error.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    if (batchResult.error || !batchResult.data) {
      window.alert(
        `Could not save Daily Cash notes: ${
          batchResult.error?.message || "Unknown error"
        }`
      );
      return;
    }

    const updated =
      batchResult.data as DailyCashBatch;
    setSelectedDailyCashBatch(updated);

    await Promise.all([
      loadDailyCashBatchDetails(updated),
      loadDailyCashBatches(),
    ]);

    setMessage(
      `Daily Cash #${updated.batch_number} reconciliation saved.`
    );
  }

  async function postDailyCashBatch() {
    if (!supabase || !selectedDailyCashBatch) return;

    if (selectedDailyCashBatch.status === "Posted") {
      window.alert(
        "This Daily Cash batch is already posted."
      );
      return;
    }

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Post Daily Cash #${selectedDailyCashBatch.batch_number}? After posting, this batch is locked. Future payment corrections will be recorded in a later batch.`
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    setPostingDailyCash(true);

    const syncedPayments =
      await syncDailyCashBatchPayments(
        selectedDailyCashBatch,
        false
      );

    const tenderPayloads = paymentMethods.map(
      (method) => {
        const systemAmount = syncedPayments
          .filter(
            (payment) =>
              payment.payment_method === method
          )
          .reduce(
            (sum, payment) =>
              sum + numberOrZero(payment.amount),
            0
          );

        const draftActual =
          dailyCashTenderDrafts[method]?.actual_amount;

        const actualAmount =
          draftActual == null || draftActual === ""
            ? systemAmount
            : numberOrZero(draftActual);

        return {
          daily_cash_batch_id:
            selectedDailyCashBatch.id,
          payment_method: method,
          system_amount: systemAmount,
          actual_amount: actualAmount,
          variance_amount:
            actualAmount - systemAmount,
          notes:
            dailyCashTenderDrafts[
              method
            ]?.notes?.trim() || null,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
      }
    );

    const { error: tenderError } = await supabase
      .from("daily_cash_tender_totals")
      .upsert(tenderPayloads, {
        onConflict:
          "daily_cash_batch_id,payment_method",
      });

    if (tenderError) {
      setPostingDailyCash(false);
      window.alert(
        `Could not save final tender totals: ${tenderError.message}`
      );
      return;
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("daily_cash_batches")
      .update({
        status: "Posted",
        notes: dailyCashNotes.trim() || null,
        posted_by: profile?.id || null,
        posted_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq("id", selectedDailyCashBatch.id)
      .select(dailyCashBatchColumns)
      .single();

    if (error || !data) {
      setPostingDailyCash(false);
      window.alert(
        `Could not post Daily Cash: ${
          error?.message || "Unknown error"
        }`
      );
      return;
    }

    const posted = data as DailyCashBatch;
    setSelectedDailyCashBatch(posted);

    await Promise.all([
      loadDailyCashBatchDetails(posted),
      loadDailyCashBatches(),
    ]);

    setPostingDailyCash(false);
    setMessage(
      `Daily Cash #${posted.batch_number} posted and locked.`
    );
  }

  function closeDailyCashBatch() {
    setSelectedDailyCashBatch(null);
    setDailyCashBatchPayments([]);
    setDailyCashTenderTotals([]);
    setDailyCashTenderDrafts({});
    setDailyCashNotes("");
  }

                />
                <MiniStat
                  label="PAID INVOICES"
                  value={money(accountingStats.paid)}
                />
                <MiniStat
                  label="EXPENSES"
                  value={money(accountingStats.expenseTotal)}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="accounting-tabs">
                <button
                  className={
                    accountingSection === "invoices"
                      ? "active"
                      : ""
                  }
                  onClick={() =>
                    setAccountingSection("invoices")
                  }
                >
                  Vendor Invoices
                  <span>{vendorInvoices.length}</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  className={
                    accountingSection === "expenses"
                      ? "active"
                      : ""
                  }
                  onClick={() =>
                    setAccountingSection("expenses")
                  }
                >
                  Expenses
                  <span>{expenses.length}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="search-card">
                <div className="search-icon">⌕</div>
                <input
                  type="search"
                  value={accountingSearch}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    setAccountingSearch(event.target.value)
                  }
                  placeholder={
                    accountingSection === "invoices"
                      ? "Search invoice number, vendor, PO or status..."
                      : "Search payee, category, description or reference..."
                  }
                />
                {accountingSearch && (
                  <button
                    className="clear-search"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setAccountingSearch("")
                    }
                  >
                    Clear
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              <section className="client-list-panel">
                {accountingLoading ? (
                  <div className="empty-state">
                    Loading accounting...
                  </div>
                ) : accountingSection === "invoices" ? (
                  filteredVendorInvoices.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="empty-state">
                      <div className="empty-icon">▥</div>
                      <strong>No vendor invoices yet</strong>
                      <span>
                        Add an invoice and link it to a purchase
                        order when available.
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="accounting-list">
                      <div className="accounting-list-header invoice">
                        <span>INVOICE</span>
                        <span>VENDOR</span>
                        <span>PO</span>
                        <span>DATE</span>
                        <span>STATUS</span>
                        <span>TOTAL</span>
                      </div>

                      {filteredVendorInvoices.map(
                        (invoice) => {
                          const po = purchaseOrders.find(
                            (order) =>
                              order.id ===
                              invoice.purchase_order_id
                          );

                          return (
                            <button
                              key={invoice.id}
                              className="accounting-row invoice"
                              onClick={() =>
                                openVendorInvoice(invoice)
                              }
                            >
                              <div className="accounting-row-primary">
                                <strong>
                                  {invoice.vendor_invoice_number ||
                                    `Internal #${invoice.invoice_number}`}
                                </strong>
                                <span>
                                  Hub #{invoice.invoice_number}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                              <div>
                                {manufacturerName(
                                  invoice.manufacturer_id
                                )}
                              </div>
                              <div>
                                {po
                                  ? `#${po.po_number}`
                                  : "—"}
                              </div>
                              <div>
                                {invoice.invoice_date || "—"}
                              </div>
                              <div>
                                <span
                                  className={`accounting-status ${invoice.status.toLowerCase()}`}
                                >
                                  {invoice.status}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                              <div className="accounting-amount">
                                {money(
                                  numberOrZero(
                                    invoice.total_amount
                                  )
                                )}
                              </div>
                            </button>
                          );
                        }
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )
                ) : filteredExpenses.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="empty-state">
                    <div className="empty-icon">◫</div>
                    <strong>No expenses yet</strong>
                    <span>
                      Add freight extras, office costs, service
                      expenses, or other operating charges here.
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="accounting-list">
                    <div className="accounting-list-header expense">
                      <span>EXPENSE</span>
                      <span>PAYEE</span>
                      <span>CATEGORY</span>
                      <span>DATE</span>
                      <span>REFERENCE</span>
                      <span>AMOUNT</span>
                    </div>

                    {filteredExpenses.map((expense) => (
                      <button
                        key={expense.id}
                        className="accounting-row expense"
                        onClick={() =>
                          openExpense(expense)
                        }
                      >
                        <div className="accounting-row-primary">
                          <strong>
                            #{expense.expense_number}
                          </strong>
                          <span>
                            {expense.description ||
                              "Expense"}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div>{expense.payee}</div>
                        <div>
                          {expense.category || "—"}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          {expense.expense_date}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          {expense.reference || "—"}
                        </div>
                        <div className="accounting-amount">
                          {money(
                            numberOrZero(expense.amount)
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </section>

              <div className="accounting-help">
                <strong>Cost trail:</strong>
                <span>
                  A linked vendor invoice can compare the PO's
                  expected cost, acknowledgement cost, and actual
                  invoiced merchandise cost without overwriting the
                  earlier snapshots.
                </span>
              </div>
            </section>
          )}

        </main>
      </>
    );
  }

  if (!session) {

              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}

            <button className="primary-button" onClick={signIn}>

            <div className="internal-note">

            </div>
          </section>
        </main>
      </>
    );

                          numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
                            numberOrZero(item.unit_price),
                        0
                      );
                      const total =
                        merchandise +

                      className="delete-button"
                      onClick={deleteQuote}
                      disabled={savingQuote}
                    >
                      Delete
                    </button>
                  </>
                )}
                <button
                  className="modal-close"
                  onClick={closeQuoteEditor}
                  aria-label="Close"
                >
                  ×
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="quote-editor-body">
              <section className="quote-card">
                <div className="quote-card-title">
                  Quote Details
                </div>

                <div className="quote-header-grid">
                  <FormField label="Client" wide>
                    <select
                      value={quoteForm.client_id}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "client_id",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="">Choose client...</option>
                      {clients.map((client) => (
                        <option key={client.id} value={client.id}>
                          {getClientName(client)}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Salesperson">
                    <select
                      value={quoteForm.salesperson_user_id}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "salesperson_user_id",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="">Unassigned</option>
                      {team.map((person) => (
                        <option key={person.id} value={person.id}>
                          {person.display_name}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Status">
                    <select
                      value={quoteForm.status}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "status",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      <option>Draft</option>
                      <option>Sent</option>
                      <option>Approved</option>
                      <option>Declined</option>
                      <option value="Archived" disabled>Archived</option>
                    </select>
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Quote date">
                    <input
                      type="date"
                      value={quoteForm.quote_date}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "quote_date",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Valid through">
                    <input
                      type="date"
                      value={quoteForm.expiration_date}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "expiration_date",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Customer PO" wide>
                    <input
                      value={quoteForm.customer_po}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "customer_po",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="Optional PO / project reference"
                    />
                  </FormField>
                </div>
              </section>

              <section className="quote-card">
                <div className="quote-lines-heading">
                  <div>
                    <div className="quote-card-title">
                      Ship To
                    </div>
                    <p>
                      This can be the designer, end user, receiver, or any other delivery destination.
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    className="line-add-button"
                    onClick={copyClientToShipTo}
                    type="button"
                  >
                    Copy Client Address
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="quote-header-grid">
                  <FormField label="Recipient / Company" wide>
                    <input
                      value={quoteForm.ship_to_name}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "ship_to_name",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="Recipient, company, receiver, or end user"
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Contact">
                    <input
                      value={quoteForm.ship_to_contact}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "ship_to_contact",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="Contact name"
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Phone">
                    <input
                      value={quoteForm.ship_to_phone}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "ship_to_phone",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="Phone"
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Street Address" wide>
                    <input
                      value={quoteForm.ship_to_address}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "ship_to_address",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="Street address"
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="City">
                    <input
                      value={quoteForm.ship_to_city}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "ship_to_city",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="City"
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="State">
                    <input
                      value={quoteForm.ship_to_state}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "ship_to_state",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="TX"
                      maxLength={2}
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="ZIP">
                    <input
                      value={quoteForm.ship_to_zip}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "ship_to_zip",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="ZIP"
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Delivery Notes" wide>
                    <textarea
                      rows={2}
                      value={quoteForm.delivery_notes}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "delivery_notes",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="Receiver instructions, call-ahead details, access notes, etc."
                    />
                  </FormField>
                </div>
              </section>

              <section className="quote-card">
                <div className="quote-lines-heading">
                  <div>
                    <div className="quote-card-title">

                    <p>

                    </p>

                  <button
                    className="line-add-button"
