                    + Add Item
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="quote-line-list">
                  {quoteItems.map((item, index) => {
                    const manufacturer = manufacturers.find(
                      (manufacturer) =>
                        manufacturer.id === item.manufacturer_id
                    );
                    const extended =
                      numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
                      numberOrZero(item.unit_price);
                    const expectedExtended =
                      numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
                      numberOrZero(item.expected_unit_cost);

                    return (
                      <article
                        className="quote-line-card"
                        key={item.local_id}
                      >
                        <div className="quote-line-top">
                          <div className="line-number">
                            Item {index + 1}
                          </div>
                          <button
                            className="line-remove-button"
                            onClick={() =>
                              removeQuoteItem(item.local_id)
                            }
                          >
                            Remove
                          </button>
                        </div>

                        <div className="quote-line-grid">
                          <FormField
                            label="Manufacturer"
                            wide
                          >
                            <select
                              value={item.manufacturer_id}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateQuoteItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "manufacturer_id",
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                            >
                              <option value="">
                                Choose manufacturer...
                              </option>
                              {manufacturers
                                .filter(
                                  (manufacturer) =>
                                    manufacturer.active !== false
                                )
                                .map((manufacturer) => (
                                  <option
                                    key={manufacturer.id}
                                    value={manufacturer.id}
                                  >
                                    {manufacturer.name}
                                  </option>
                                ))}
                            </select>
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Qty">
                            <input
                              type="number"
                              min="1"
                              value={item.quantity}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateQuoteItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "quantity",
                                  e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "")
                                )
                              }
                              onBlur={() =>
                                updateQuoteItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "quantity",
                                  String(
                                    Math.max(
                                      1,
                                      numberOrZero(item.quantity)
                                    )
                                  )
                                )
                              }
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="SKU">
                            <input
                              value={item.sku}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateQuoteItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "sku",
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                              placeholder="SKU"
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Description" wide>
                            <input
                              value={item.description}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateQuoteItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "description",
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                              placeholder="Product description"
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Finish">
                            <input
                              value={item.finish}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateQuoteItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "finish",
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                              placeholder="Finish"
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Fabric Name">
                            <input
                              value={item.fabric_name}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateQuoteItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "fabric_name",
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                              placeholder="Fabric"
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Grade">
                            <input
                              value={item.grade}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateQuoteItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "grade",
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                              placeholder="Grade"
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="MSRP @ Grade">
                            <input
                              inputMode="decimal"
                              value={
                                item.msrp_at_grade || ""
                              }
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateQuoteItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "msrp_at_grade",
                                  numberOrZero(e.target.value)
                                )
                              }
                              placeholder="0.00"
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Discount %">
                            <input
                              inputMode="decimal"
                              value={item.discount_pct}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateQuoteItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "discount_pct",
                                  numberOrZero(e.target.value)
                                )
                              }
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Item Price">
                            <input
                              value={money(item.unit_price)}
                              readOnly
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField
                            label="Additional Details"
                            wide
                          >
                            <textarea
                              rows={2}
                              value={item.additional_details}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateQuoteItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "additional_details",
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                              placeholder="Custom details, dimensions, COM notes, etc."
                            />
                          </FormField>
                        </div>

                        <div className="line-financials">
                          <div>
                            <span>Extended</span>
                            <strong>{money(extended)}</strong>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <span>Expected Cost</span>
                            <strong>
                              {item.expected_unit_cost == null
                                ? "Factor needed"
                                : money(expectedExtended)}
                            </strong>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <span>Factor</span>
                            <strong>
                              {item.purchasing_factor_snapshot ??
                                "—"}
                            </strong>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <span>Tariff</span>
                            <strong>
                              {numberOrZero(
                                item.tariff_pct_snapshot
                              )}
                              %
                            </strong>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <span>Surcharge</span>
                            <strong>
                              {numberOrZero(
                                item.surcharge_pct_snapshot
                              )}
                              %
                            </strong>
                          </div>
                          <label className="commission-toggle">
                            <input
                              type="checkbox"
                              checked={item.commissionable}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateQuoteItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "commissionable",
                                  e.target.checked
                                )
                              }
                            />
                            Commissionable
                          </label>
                        </div>

                        {manufacturer &&
                          manufacturer.purchasing_factor == null && (
                            <div className="line-warning">
                              {manufacturer.name} does not have a
                              purchasing factor yet. Customer pricing
                              will save, but expected cost and margin
                              cannot be calculated.
                            </div>
                          )}
                      </article>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </section>

              <div className="quote-bottom-grid">
                <section className="quote-card">
                  <div className="quote-card-title">
                    Quote Notes
                  </div>
                  <textarea
                    className="quote-notes"
                    rows={6}
                    value={quoteForm.notes}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      updateQuoteForm(
                        "notes",
                        e.target.value
                      )
                    }
                    placeholder="Internal or quote notes..."
                  />

                <section className="quote-card quote-summary-card">
                  <div className="quote-card-title">
                    Quote Summary
                  </div>

                  <div className="summary-row">
                    <span>Merchandise</span>
                    <strong>
                      {money(quoteEditorTotals.merchandise)}
                    </strong>
                  </div>

                  <div className="summary-input-row">
                    <label>Freight</label>
                    <input
                      inputMode="decimal"
                      value={quoteForm.freight_amount}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "freight_amount",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="summary-input-row">
                    <label>Adjustment</label>
                    <input
                      inputMode="decimal"
                      value={quoteForm.adjustment_amount}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateQuoteForm(
                          "adjustment_amount",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="summary-total">
                    <span>Quote Total</span>
                    <strong>
                      {money(quoteEditorTotals.total)}
                    </strong>
                  </div>

                  <div className="internal-cost-summary">
                    <div>
                      <span>Expected merchandise cost</span>
                      <strong>
                        {money(quoteEditorTotals.expectedCost)}
                      </strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span>Estimated merchandise margin</span>
                      <strong>
                        {money(quoteEditorTotals.marginDollar)} •{" "}
                        {quoteEditorTotals.marginPct.toFixed(1)}%
                      </strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </section>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="quote-editor-footer">
              <button
                className="modal-secondary"
                onClick={closeQuoteEditor}
                disabled={savingQuote}
              >
                Close
              </button>

              <button
                className="modal-primary quote-save-button"
                onClick={saveQuote}
                disabled={savingQuote}
              >
                {savingQuote
                  ? "Saving..."
                  : selectedQuote
                  ? "Save Quote"
                  : "Create Draft Quote"}
              </button>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      )}

      {saleModalOpen && selectedSale && (
        <div
          className="modal-backdrop"
          onMouseDown={(event) => {
            if (event.target === event.currentTarget) {
              closeSaleModal();
            }
          }}
        >
          <section className="sale-modal">
            <div className="modal-header">
              <div>
                <div className="detail-kicker">
                  SALE #{selectedSale.sale_number}
                </div>
                <h2>
                  {clientNameById(selectedSale.client_id)}
                </h2>
              </div>

              <div className="sale-header-actions">
                {!saleEditMode && (
                  <>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="generate-po-button"
                      onClick={generatePurchaseOrdersFromSale}

                      {generatingPurchaseOrders
                        ? "Generating..."
                        : "Generate POs"}
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className="download-sale-button"
                      onClick={downloadSalesOrderPdf}
                    >
                      Download PDF
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className="edit-sale-button"
                      onClick={beginSaleEdit}
                    >
                      Edit Sales Order
                    </button>
                  </>
                )}
                <button
                  className="modal-close"
                  onClick={closeSaleModal}
                  aria-label="Close"
                >
                  ×
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {saleEditMode && saleEditForm ? (
              <>
                <div className="sale-edit-banner">
                  <strong>Edit Sales Order</strong>
                  <span>
                    Change the client, merchandise, fabrics, pricing,
                    freight, tax, shipping details or add new items.
                    Existing payments stay attached to this sale.
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="form-grid sale-edit-header-grid">
                  <FormField label="Client" wide>
                    <select
                      value={saleEditForm.client_id}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm("client_id", e.target.value)
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="">Choose client...</option>
                      {clients
                        .slice()
                        .sort((a, b) =>
                          getClientName(a).localeCompare(getClientName(b))
                        )
                        .map((client) => (
                          <option key={client.id} value={client.id}>
                            {getClientName(client)}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                    </select>
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Salesperson">
                    <select
                      value={saleEditForm.salesperson_user_id}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm(
                          "salesperson_user_id",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="">Unassigned</option>
                      {team.map((person) => (
                        <option key={person.id} value={person.id}>
                          {person.display_name}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Status">
                    <select
                      value={saleEditForm.status}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm("status", e.target.value)
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="Open">Open</option>
                      <option value="On Hold">On Hold</option>
                      <option value="Ordered">Ordered</option>
                      <option value="Partially Received">
                        Partially Received
                      </option>
                      <option value="Complete">Complete</option>
                      <option value="Closed">Closed</option>
                    </select>
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Order Date">
                    <input
                      type="date"
                      value={saleEditForm.order_date}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm("order_date", e.target.value)
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Customer PO / Reference">
                    <input
                      value={saleEditForm.customer_po}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm("customer_po", e.target.value)
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Adjustment">
                    <input
                      inputMode="decimal"
                      value={saleEditForm.adjustment_amount}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm(
                          "adjustment_amount",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="0.00"
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Tax">
                    <input
                      inputMode="decimal"
                      value={saleEditForm.tax_amount}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm("tax_amount", e.target.value)
                      }
                      placeholder="0.00"
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Notes" wide>
                    <textarea
                      rows={3}
                      value={saleEditForm.notes}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm("notes", e.target.value)
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>
                </div>

                <div className="sale-edit-section-heading">
                  <div>
                    <div className="detail-kicker">SHIP TO</div>
                    <strong>Delivery Information</strong>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    className="text-button"
                    onClick={copySaleClientToShipTo}
                  >
                    Copy Client Address
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="form-grid">
                  <FormField label="Ship To Name">
                    <input
                      value={saleEditForm.ship_to_name}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm("ship_to_name", e.target.value)
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>
                  <FormField label="Contact">
                    <input
                      value={saleEditForm.ship_to_contact}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm(
                          "ship_to_contact",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>
                  <FormField label="Phone">
                    <input
                      value={saleEditForm.ship_to_phone}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm("ship_to_phone", e.target.value)
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>
                  <FormField label="Street Address" wide>
                    <input
                      value={saleEditForm.ship_to_address}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm(
                          "ship_to_address",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>
                  <FormField label="City">
                    <input
                      value={saleEditForm.ship_to_city}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm("ship_to_city", e.target.value)
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>
                  <FormField label="State">
                    <input
                      value={saleEditForm.ship_to_state}
                      maxLength={2}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm("ship_to_state", e.target.value)
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>
                  <FormField label="ZIP">
                    <input
                      value={saleEditForm.ship_to_zip}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm("ship_to_zip", e.target.value)
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>
                  <FormField label="Delivery Notes" wide>
                    <textarea
                      rows={2}
                      value={saleEditForm.delivery_notes}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        updateSaleEditForm(
                          "delivery_notes",
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>
                </div>

                <div className="vendor-freight-edit">
                  <div className="sale-edit-section-heading">
                    <div>
                      <div className="detail-kicker">FREIGHT</div>
                      <strong>Freight by Manufacturer</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div className="vendor-freight-total-inline">
                      Total {money(vendorFreightTotal(saleEditVendorFreight))}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {saleEditVendorFreight.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="empty-state compact">
                      Add a manufacturer to a merchandise line to enter vendor freight.
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="vendor-freight-grid">
                      {saleEditVendorFreight.map((row) => {
                        const maker = manufacturers.find((entry) => entry.id === row.manufacturer_id);
                        return (
                          <div className="vendor-freight-card" key={row.manufacturer_id}>
                            <strong>{maker?.name || "Manufacturer"}</strong>
                            <label>
                              <span>Freight</span>
                              <input
                                inputMode="decimal"
                                value={row.amount}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                  updateSaleVendorFreight(row.manufacturer_id, "amount", e.target.value)
                                }
                                placeholder="0.00"
                              />
                            </label>
                            <label>
                              <span>Notes</span>
                              <input
                                value={row.notes}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                  updateSaleVendorFreight(row.manufacturer_id, "notes", e.target.value)
                                }
                                placeholder="Optional freight note"
                              />
                            </label>
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="sale-edit-section-heading">
                  <div>
                    <div className="detail-kicker">MERCHANDISE</div>
                    <strong>Sales Order Items</strong>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    className="new-client-button"
                    onClick={addSaleEditItem}
                  >
                    + Add Item
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="sale-edit-items">
                  {saleEditItems.length === 0 && (
                    <div className="empty-state compact">
                      No merchandise lines. Add an item to continue.
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {saleEditItems.map((item, index) => {
                    const extended =
                      numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
                      numberOrZero(item.unit_price);
                    const expectedExtended =
                      numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
                      numberOrZero(item.expected_unit_cost);

                    return (
                      <article
                        className="sale-edit-item-card"
                        key={item.local_id}
                      >
                        <div className="sale-edit-item-top">
                          <strong>Item {index + 1}</strong>
                          <button
                            className="remove-line-button"
                            onClick={() =>
                              removeSaleEditItem(item.local_id)
                            }
                          >
                            Remove
                          </button>
                        </div>

                        <div className="form-grid">
                          <FormField label="Manufacturer" wide>
                            <select
                              value={item.manufacturer_id}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateSaleEditItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "manufacturer_id",
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                            >
                              <option value="">
                                Choose manufacturer...
                              </option>
                              {manufacturers
                                .filter(
                                  (manufacturer) =>
                                    manufacturer.active !== false
                                )
                                .map((manufacturer) => (
                                  <option
                                    key={manufacturer.id}
                                    value={manufacturer.id}
                                  >
                                    {manufacturer.name}
                                  </option>
                                ))}
                            </select>
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Qty">
                            <input
                              type="number"
                              min="1"
                              value={item.quantity}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateSaleEditItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "quantity",
                                  e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "")
                                )
                              }
                              onBlur={() =>
                                updateSaleEditItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "quantity",
                                  String(
                                    Math.max(
                                      1,
                                      numberOrZero(item.quantity)
                                    )
                                  )
                                )
                              }
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Fulfillment">
                            <select
                              value={item.fulfillment_method}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateSaleEditItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "fulfillment_method",
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                            >
                              <option value="Special Order">
                                Special Order
                              </option>
                              <option value="Inventory">Inventory</option>
                            </select>
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="SKU">
                            <input
                              value={item.sku}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateSaleEditItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "sku",
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Description" wide>
                            <input
                              value={item.description}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateSaleEditItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "description",
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Finish">
                            <input
                              value={item.finish}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateSaleEditItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "finish",
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Fabric Name">
                            <input
                              value={item.fabric_name}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateSaleEditItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "fabric_name",
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Grade">
                            <input
                              value={item.grade}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateSaleEditItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "grade",
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="MSRP @ Grade">
                            <input
                              inputMode="decimal"
                              value={item.msrp_at_grade || ""}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateSaleEditItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "msrp_at_grade",
                                  numberOrZero(e.target.value)
                                )
                              }
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Discount %">
                            <input
                              inputMode="decimal"
                              value={item.discount_pct}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateSaleEditItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "discount_pct",
                                  numberOrZero(e.target.value)
                                )
                              }
                            />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Item Price">
                            <input value={money(item.unit_price)} readOnly />
                          </FormField>

                          <FormField label="Additional Details" wide>
                            <textarea
                              rows={2}
                              value={item.additional_details}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateSaleEditItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "additional_details",
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                            />
                          </FormField>
                        </div>

                        <div className="sale-edit-financials">
                          <div>
                            <span>Extended</span>
                            <strong>{money(extended)}</strong>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <span>Expected Cost</span>
                            <strong>
                              {item.expected_unit_cost == null
                                ? "Factor needed"
                                : money(expectedExtended)}
                            </strong>
                          </div>
                          <label className="commission-toggle">
                            <input
                              type="checkbox"
                              checked={item.commissionable}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateSaleEditItem(
                                  item.local_id,
                                  "commissionable",
                                  e.target.checked
                                )
                              }
                            />
                            Commissionable
                          </label>
                        </div>
                      </article>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>

                <div className="modal-actions sale-edit-actions">
                  <button
                    className="modal-primary"
                    onClick={saveSaleEdits}
                    disabled={savingSale}
                  >
                    {savingSale ? "Saving..." : "Save Sales Order"}
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="modal-secondary"
                    onClick={cancelSaleEdit}
                    disabled={savingSale}
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </button>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
            <div className="sale-summary-grid">
              <DetailField
                label="Status"
                value={selectedSale.status}
              />
              <DetailField
                label="Salesperson"
                value={salespersonName(
                  selectedSale.salesperson_user_id
                )}
              />
              <DetailField
                label="Order Date"
                value={selectedSale.order_date}
              />
              <DetailField
                label="Customer PO"
                value={selectedSale.customer_po}
              />
              <DetailField
                label="Source Quote"
                value={
                  selectedSale.source_quote_id
                    ? `Converted quote`
                    : "Direct sale"
                }
              />
              <DetailField
                label="Ship To"
                value={
                  [
                    selectedSale.ship_to_name,
                    selectedSale.ship_to_city,
                    selectedSale.ship_to_state,
                  ]
                    .filter(Boolean)
                    .join(", ") || null
                }
              />
            </div>

            <div className="sale-line-items">
              <div className="quote-card-title">
                Merchandise
              </div>

              {saleItems.map((item) => {
                const ext =
                  numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
                  numberOrZero(item.unit_price);
                const cost =
                  numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
                  numberOrZero(
                    item.acknowledged_unit_cost ??
                      item.expected_unit_cost
                  );

                return (
                  <div className="sale-item-row" key={item.id}>
                    <div className="sale-item-copy">
                      <strong>
                        {item.sku || "No SKU"}
                        {item.description
                          ? ` • ${item.description}`
                          : ""}
                      </strong>
                      <span>
                        {item.manufacturer_id
                          ? manufacturers.find(
                              (m) =>
                                m.id === item.manufacturer_id
                            )?.name || "Manufacturer"
                          : "No manufacturer"}
                        {" • "}
                        Qty {item.quantity}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="sale-item-money">
                      <span>EXT.</span>
                      <strong>{money(ext)}</strong>
                    </div>

                    <div className="sale-item-money">
                      <span>COST</span>
                      <strong>{money(cost)}</strong>
                    </div>

                    <select
                      className="fulfillment-select"
                      value={item.fulfillment_method}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        changeFulfillmentMethod(
                          item,
                          e.target.value as
                            | "Special Order"
                            | "Inventory"
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="Special Order">
                        Special Order
                      </option>
                      <option value="Inventory">
                        Inventory
                      </option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <div className="vendor-freight-view">
              <div className="quote-card-title">Freight by Manufacturer</div>
              {vendorFreight.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="vendor-freight-view-row">
                  <span>General / Unallocated Freight</span>
                  <strong>{money(numberOrZero(selectedSale.freight_amount))}</strong>
                </div>
              ) : (
                vendorFreight.map((row) => {
                  const maker = manufacturers.find((entry) => entry.id === row.manufacturer_id);
                  return (
                    <div className="vendor-freight-view-row" key={row.id}>
                      <div>
                        <span>{maker?.name || "Manufacturer"}</span>
                        {row.notes && <small>{row.notes}</small>}
                      </div>
                      <strong>{money(numberOrZero(row.amount))}</strong>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </div>

            {(() => {
              const merchandise = saleItems.reduce(
                (sum, item) =>
                  sum +
                  numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
                    numberOrZero(item.unit_price),
                0
              );
              const totalCost = saleItems.reduce(
                (sum, item) =>
                  sum +
                  numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
                    numberOrZero(
                      item.acknowledged_unit_cost ??
                        item.expected_unit_cost
                    ),
                0
              );
              const total =
                merchandise +
                numberOrZero(selectedSale.freight_amount) +
                numberOrZero(selectedSale.adjustment_amount) +
                numberOrZero(selectedSale.tax_amount);
              const margin =
                merchandise > 0
                  ? ((merchandise - totalCost) / merchandise) * 100
                  : 0;

              return (
                <div className="sale-total-grid">
                  <div>
                    <span>Merchandise</span>
                    <strong>{money(merchandise)}</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span>Freight</span>
                    <strong>
                      {money(
                        numberOrZero(
                          selectedSale.freight_amount
                        )
                      )}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span>Tax</span>
                    <strong>
                      {money(
                        numberOrZero(selectedSale.tax_amount)
                      )}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span>Order Total</span>
                    <strong>{money(total)}</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span>Expected Cost</span>
                    <strong>{money(totalCost)}</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span>Merch. Margin</span>
                    <strong>{margin.toFixed(1)}%</strong>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })()}

            {(() => {
              const orderTotal = saleOrderTotal(
                selectedSale,
                saleItems
              );
              const received = paymentNetTotal(payments);
              const balance = Math.max(0, orderTotal - received);
              const depositTarget = orderTotal * 0.5;
              const depositRemaining = Math.max(
                0,
                depositTarget - received
              );

              const status =
                balance <= 0.005
                  ? "Paid in Full"
                  : depositRemaining <= 0.005
                  ? "Deposit Received"
                  : "Deposit Due";

              return (
                <section className="payments-card">
                  <div className="payments-header">
                    <div>
                      <div className="detail-kicker">
                        PAYMENTS
                      </div>
                      <h3>Payment & Balance</h3>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      className="payment-add-button"
                      onClick={openAddPayment}
                    >
                      + Add Payment
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <div className="payment-summary-grid">
                    <div>
                      <span>Order Total</span>
                      <strong>{money(orderTotal)}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span>50% Deposit</span>
                      <strong>{money(depositTarget)}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span>Payments Received</span>
                      <strong>{money(received)}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span>Balance Due</span>
                      <strong>{money(balance)}</strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div
                    className={`payment-status ${
                      status === "Paid in Full"
                        ? "paid"
                        : status === "Deposit Received"
                        ? "deposit"
                        : "due"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <strong>{status}</strong>
                    <span>
                      {status === "Deposit Due"
                        ? `${money(
                            depositRemaining
                          )} remaining to reach the 50% deposit`
                        : status === "Deposit Received"
                        ? `${money(
                            balance
                          )} remaining before shipment`
                        : "No balance remaining"}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {paymentFormOpen && (
                    <div className="payment-form-card">
                      <div className="payment-form-title">
                        <div>
                          <strong>
                            {paymentMode === "new"
                              ? "Add Payment"
                              : paymentMode === "edit"
                              ? "Edit Unposted Payment"
                              : "Correct Posted Payment"}
                          </strong>
                          {paymentMode === "correct" && (
                            <span>
                              The original entry will not be
                              overwritten. The Hub will create a
                              reversal and a corrected replacement.
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <button
                          onClick={closePaymentForm}
                          className="payment-form-close"
                        >
                          ×
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      <div className="payment-form-grid">
                        <FormField label="Payment date">
                          <input
                            type="date"
                            value={paymentForm.payment_date}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              updatePaymentForm(
                                "payment_date",
                                e.target.value
                              )
                            }
                          />
                        </FormField>

                        <FormField label="Amount">
                          <input
                            inputMode="decimal"
                            value={paymentForm.amount}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              updatePaymentForm(
                                "amount",
                                e.target.value
                              )
                            }
                            placeholder="0.00"
                          />
                        </FormField>

                        <FormField label="Payment method">
                          <select
                            value={paymentForm.payment_method}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              updatePaymentForm(
                                "payment_method",
                                e.target.value
                              )
                            }
                          >
                            {paymentMethods.map((method) => (
                              <option
                                key={method}
                                value={method}
                              >
                                {method}
                              </option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                        </FormField>

                        <FormField label="Reference">
                          <input
                            value={paymentForm.reference}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              updatePaymentForm(
                                "reference",
                                e.target.value
                              )
                            }
                            placeholder="Check #, wire ref, card note..."
                          />
                        </FormField>

                        <FormField label="Notes" wide>
                          <textarea
                            rows={2}
                            value={paymentForm.notes}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              updatePaymentForm(
                                "notes",
                                e.target.value
                              )
                            }
                            placeholder="Optional payment notes"
                          />
                        </FormField>

                        {paymentMode === "correct" && (
                          <FormField
                            label="Correction reason"
                            wide
                          >
                            <textarea
                              rows={2}
                              value={correctionReason}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                setCorrectionReason(
                                  e.target.value
                                )
                              }
                              placeholder="Why is this posted payment being corrected?"
                            />
                          </FormField>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <div className="payment-form-actions">
                        <button
                          className="modal-primary"
                          onClick={savePayment}
                          disabled={savingPayment}
                        >
                          {savingPayment
                            ? "Saving..."
                            : paymentMode === "correct"
                            ? "Record Correction"
                            : paymentMode === "edit"
                            ? "Save Payment"
                            : "Add Payment"}
                        </button>
                        <button
                          className="modal-secondary"
                          onClick={closePaymentForm}
                          disabled={savingPayment}
                        >
                          Cancel
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <div className="payment-history">
                    <div className="payment-history-heading">
                      Payment History
                    </div>

                    {payments.length === 0 ? (
                      <div className="payment-empty">
                        No payments recorded yet.
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      [...payments]
                        .reverse()
                        .map((payment) => {
                          const isReversal =
                            Boolean(
                              payment.reversal_of_payment_id
                            );
                          const isCorrection =
                            Boolean(
                              payment.correction_of_payment_id
                            );
                          const wasCorrected = payments.some(
                            (entry) =>
                              entry.reversal_of_payment_id ===
                              payment.id
                          );

                          return (
                            <div
                              className={`payment-row ${
                                isReversal
                                  ? "reversal"
                                  : isCorrection
                                  ? "correction"
                                  : ""
                              }`}
                              key={payment.id}
                            >
                              <div className="payment-row-main">
                                <strong>
                                  {payment.payment_method}
                                  {" • "}
                                  {payment.payment_date}
                                </strong>
                                <span>
                                  {isReversal
                                    ? "Correction reversal"
                                    : isCorrection
                                    ? "Corrected replacement"
                                    : wasCorrected
                                    ? "Original, corrected"
                                    : payment.posted
                                    ? "Posted"
                                    : "Unposted"}
                                  {payment.reference
                                    ? ` • ${payment.reference}`
                                    : ""}
                                </span>
                                {payment.correction_reason && (
                                  <small>
                                    {payment.correction_reason}
                                  </small>
                                )}
                              </div>

                              <div
                                className={`payment-amount ${
                                  numberOrZero(
                                    payment.amount
                                  ) < 0
                                    ? "negative"
                                    : ""
                                }`}
                              >
                                {money(
                                  numberOrZero(
                                    payment.amount
                                  )
                                )}
                              </div>

                              <div className="payment-actions">
                                {!payment.posted && (
                                  <>
                                    <button
                                      onClick={() =>
                                        editPayment(payment)
                                      }
                                    >
                                      Edit
                                    </button>
                                    <button
                                      onClick={() =>
                                        postPayment(payment)
                                      }
                                    >
                                      Post
                                    </button>
                                    <button
                                      className="danger"
                                      onClick={() =>
                                        deleteUnpostedPayment(
                                          payment
                                        )
                                      }
                                    >
                                      Delete
                                    </button>
                                  </>
                                )}

                                {payment.posted &&
                                  !isReversal &&
                                  !wasCorrected && (
                                    <button
                                      onClick={() =>
                                        correctPayment(payment)
                                      }
                                    >
                                      Correct
                                    </button>
                                  )}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })
                    )}
                  </div>
                </section>
              );
            })()}

            <div className="manufacturer-help">
              <strong>Fulfillment matters</strong>
              <span>
                Special Order merchandise creates manufacturer
                purchase orders. Inventory merchandise stays out of
                the vendor PO workflow and is fulfilled from stock.
              </span>
            </div>

              </>
            )}
          </section>
        </div>
      )}

      {purchaseOrderModalOpen &&
        selectedPurchaseOrder &&
        purchaseOrderForm && (
          <div
            className="modal-backdrop"
            onMouseDown={(event) => {
              if (event.target === event.currentTarget) {
                closePurchaseOrderModal();
              }
            }}
          >
            <section className="po-modal">
              <div className="modal-header">
                <div>
                  <div className="detail-kicker">
                    PURCHASE ORDER #{selectedPurchaseOrder.po_number}
                  </div>
                  <h2>
                    {manufacturerName(
                      selectedPurchaseOrder.manufacturer_id
                    )}
                  </h2>
                  <div className="po-subtitle">
                    Sale{" "}
                    {saleNumberForId(
                      selectedPurchaseOrder.sales_order_id
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  className="modal-close"
                  onClick={closePurchaseOrderModal}
                  aria-label="Close"
                >
                  ×
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="po-snapshot-strip">
                <div>
                  <span>FACTOR SNAPSHOT</span>
                  <strong>
                    {selectedPurchaseOrder.purchasing_factor_snapshot ==
                    null
                      ? "—"
                      : Number(
                          selectedPurchaseOrder.purchasing_factor_snapshot
                        ).toFixed(4)}
                  </strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>TARIFF</span>
                  <strong>
                    {numberOrZero(
                      selectedPurchaseOrder.tariff_pct_snapshot
                    ).toFixed(2)}
                    %
                  </strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>SURCHARGE</span>
                  <strong>
                    {numberOrZero(
                      selectedPurchaseOrder.surcharge_pct_snapshot
                    ).toFixed(2)}
                    %
                  </strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>VENDOR FREIGHT</span>
                  <strong>
                    {money(
                      numberOrZero(
                        selectedPurchaseOrder.freight_amount
                      )
                    )}
                  </strong>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="form-grid po-form-grid">
                <FormField label="Status">
                  <select
                    value={purchaseOrderForm.status}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      updatePurchaseOrderForm(
                        "status",
                        e.target.value
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    {poStatuses.map((status) => (
                      <option key={status} value={status}>
                        {status}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </FormField>

                <FormField label="Order Date">
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={purchaseOrderForm.order_date}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      updatePurchaseOrderForm(
                        "order_date",
                        e.target.value
                      )
                    }
                  />
                </FormField>

                <FormField label="Acknowledgement #">
                  <input
                    value={
                      purchaseOrderForm.acknowledgement_number
                    }
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      updatePurchaseOrderForm(
                        "acknowledgement_number",
                        e.target.value
                      )
                    }
                    placeholder="Vendor acknowledgement #"
                  />
                </FormField>

                <FormField label="Acknowledgement Date">
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={
                      purchaseOrderForm.acknowledgement_date
                    }
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      updatePurchaseOrderForm(
                        "acknowledgement_date",
                        e.target.value
                      )
                    }
                  />
                </FormField>

                <FormField label="Estimated Ship Date">
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={
                      purchaseOrderForm.estimated_ship_date
                    }
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      updatePurchaseOrderForm(
                        "estimated_ship_date",
                        e.target.value
                      )
                    }
                  />
                </FormField>

                <FormField label="Actual Ship Date">
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={purchaseOrderForm.actual_ship_date}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      updatePurchaseOrderForm(
                        "actual_ship_date",
                        e.target.value
                      )
                    }
                  />
                </FormField>

                <FormField label="Carrier">
                  <input
                    value={purchaseOrderForm.carrier}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      updatePurchaseOrderForm(
                        "carrier",
                        e.target.value
                      )
                    }
                    placeholder="Carrier / freight company"
                  />
                </FormField>

                <FormField label="Tracking / PRO #">
                  <input
                    value={purchaseOrderForm.tracking_number}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      updatePurchaseOrderForm(
                        "tracking_number",
                        e.target.value
                      )
                    }
                    placeholder="Tracking or PRO number"
                  />
                </FormField>

                <FormField label="Vendor Freight">
                  <input
                    inputMode="decimal"
                    value={purchaseOrderForm.freight_amount}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      updatePurchaseOrderForm(
                        "freight_amount",
                        e.target.value
                      )
                    }
                    placeholder="0.00"
                  />
                </FormField>

                <FormField label="PO Notes" wide>
                  <textarea
                    rows={3}
                    value={purchaseOrderForm.notes}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      updatePurchaseOrderForm(
                        "notes",
                        e.target.value
                      )
                    }
                    placeholder="Vendor notes, production notes, shipping instructions..."
                  />
                </FormField>
              </div>

              <div className="po-items-panel">
                <div className="quote-card-title">
                  Vendor Merchandise
                </div>

                {purchaseOrderItems.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="empty-state">
                    No PO merchandise lines.
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  purchaseOrderItems.map((item) => {
                    const activeUnitCost = numberOrZero(
                      item.acknowledged_unit_cost ??
                        item.unit_cost
                    );
                    const extended =
                      numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
                      activeUnitCost;

                    return (
                      <div
                        className="po-item-row"
                        key={item.id}
                      >
                        <div className="po-item-main">
                          <strong>
                            {item.sku || "No SKU"}
                          </strong>
                          <span>
                            {item.description ||
                              "No description"}
                          </span>
                          <small>
                            {[
                              item.finish
                                ? `Finish: ${item.finish}`
                                : "",
                              item.fabric_name
                                ? `Fabric: ${item.fabric_name}`
                                : "",
                              item.grade
                                ? `Grade: ${item.grade}`
                                : "",
                            ]
                              .filter(Boolean)
                              .join(" • ")}
                          </small>
                        </div>

                        <div className="po-item-number">
                          <span>QTY</span>
                          <strong>{item.quantity}</strong>
                        </div>

                        <div className="po-item-number">
                          <span>
                            {item.acknowledged_unit_cost != null
                              ? "ACK COST"
                              : "EXPECTED COST"}
                          </span>
                          <strong>
                            {money(activeUnitCost)}
                          </strong>
                        </div>

                        <div className="po-item-number">
                          <span>EXT.</span>
                          <strong>{money(extended)}</strong>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </div>

              {(() => {
                const merchandise = purchaseOrderItems.reduce(
                  (sum, item) =>
                    sum +
                    numberOrZero(item.quantity) *
                      numberOrZero(
                        item.acknowledged_unit_cost ??
                          item.unit_cost
                      ),
                  0
                );

                const freight = numberOrZero(
                  purchaseOrderForm.freight_amount
                );

                return (
                  <div className="po-total-box">
                    <div>
                      <span>Merchandise Cost</span>
                      <strong>{money(merchandise)}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span>Vendor Freight</span>
                      <strong>{money(freight)}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span>Expected PO Total</span>
                      <strong>
                        {money(merchandise + freight)}
                      </strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })()}

              <div className="po-ack-panel">
                <div className="po-ack-heading">
                  <div>
                    <strong>Vendor Acknowledgements</strong>
                    <span>
                      PDFs are stored privately with this purchase
                      order.
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <label
                    className={`po-ack-upload ${
                      uploadingAcknowledgement
                        ? "disabled"
                        : ""
                    }`}
                  >
                    <input
                      type="file"
                      accept="application/pdf,.pdf"
                      disabled={uploadingAcknowledgement}
                      onChange={async (event) => {
                        const file =
                          event.target.files?.[0];
                        event.currentTarget.value = "";
                        if (file) {
                          await uploadPurchaseOrderAcknowledgement(
                            file
                          );
                        }
                      }}
                    />
                    {uploadingAcknowledgement
                      ? "Uploading..."
                      : "Upload PDF"}
                  </label>
                </div>

                {purchaseOrderAcknowledgements.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="po-ack-empty">
                    No vendor acknowledgement uploaded yet.
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="po-ack-list">
                    {purchaseOrderAcknowledgements.map(
                      (acknowledgement) => (
                        <div
                          className="po-ack-row"
                          key={acknowledgement.id}
                        >
                          <div className="po-ack-file">
                            <div className="po-ack-icon">
                              PDF
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <strong>
                                {acknowledgement.file_name ||
                                  "Vendor acknowledgement"}
                              </strong>
                              <span>
                                {new Date(
                                  acknowledgement.created_at
                                ).toLocaleString()}
                                {" • "}
                                Comparison:{" "}
                                {acknowledgement.comparison_status ||
                                  "Pending"}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          <div className="po-ack-actions">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() =>
                                viewPurchaseOrderAcknowledgement(
                                  acknowledgement
                                )
                              }
                            >
                              View
                            </button>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              className="danger"
                              disabled={
                                deletingAcknowledgementId ===
                                acknowledgement.id
                              }
                              onClick={() =>
                                deletePurchaseOrderAcknowledgement(
                                  acknowledgement
                                )
                              }
                            >
                              {deletingAcknowledgementId ===
                              acknowledgement.id
                                ? "Deleting..."
                                : "Delete"}
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="po-ack-next">
                  <strong>Comparison is the next layer.</strong>
                  <span>
                    Uploaded acknowledgements are marked Pending until
                    we wire the PO discrepancy checker for SKU,
                    quantity, cost, freight and vendor details.
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="modal-actions">
                <button
                  className="modal-secondary"
                  onClick={closePurchaseOrderModal}
                  disabled={savingPurchaseOrder}
                >
                  Close
                </button>
                <button
                  className="modal-primary"
                  onClick={savePurchaseOrder}
                  disabled={savingPurchaseOrder}
                >
                  {savingPurchaseOrder
                    ? "Saving..."
                    : "Save Purchase Order"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </section>
          </div>
        )}


      {inventoryModalOpen && (
        <div
          className="modal-backdrop"
          onMouseDown={(event) => {
            if (event.target === event.currentTarget) {
