          }}
        >
          <section className="inventory-modal">
            <div className="modal-header">
              <div>
                <div className="detail-kicker">
                  {inventoryMode === "new"
                    ? "NEW INVENTORY ITEM"
                    : inventoryMode === "edit"
                    ? "EDIT INVENTORY ITEM"
                    : "INVENTORY RECORD"}
                </div>
                <h2>
                  {inventoryMode === "new"
                    ? "Add Inventory Item"
                    : selectedInventoryItem?.name ||
                      "Inventory Item"}
                </h2>
              </div>

              <button
                className="modal-close"
                onClick={closeInventoryModal}
                aria-label="Close"
              >
                ×
              </button>
            </div>

            {inventoryMode !== "view" ? (
              <>
                <div className="form-grid inventory-form-grid">
                  <FormField label="Item Name" wide>
                    <input
                      value={inventoryForm.name}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateInventoryForm(
                          "name",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="Product / inventory name"
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="SKU">
                    <input
                      value={inventoryForm.sku}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateInventoryForm(
                          "sku",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Manufacturer">
                    <select
                      value={inventoryForm.manufacturer_id}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateInventoryForm(
                          "manufacturer_id",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="">No manufacturer</option>
                      {manufacturers.map((manufacturer) => (
                        <option
                          value={manufacturer.id}
                          key={manufacturer.id}
                        >
                          {manufacturer.name}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Location">
                    <input
                      value={inventoryForm.location}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateInventoryForm(
                          "location",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="Showroom, warehouse, rack..."

                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Unit Cost">
                    <input
                      inputMode="decimal"
                      value={inventoryForm.unit_cost}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateInventoryForm(
                          "unit_cost",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="MSRP">
                    <input
                      inputMode="decimal"
                      value={inventoryForm.msrp}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateInventoryForm(
                          "msrp",
                          event.target.value
                        )

                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField
                    label={
                      inventoryMode === "new"
                        ? "Starting Quantity"
                        : "On Hand"
                    }
                  >
                    <input
                      inputMode="numeric"
                      value={inventoryForm.quantity_on_hand}
                      disabled={inventoryMode === "edit"}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateInventoryForm(
                          "quantity_on_hand",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Status">
                    <select
                      value={
                        inventoryForm.active
                          ? "active"

                      }
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateInventoryForm(
                          "active",

                      }
                    >
                      <option value="active">Active</option>
                      <option value="inactive">
                        Inactive
                      </option>
                    </select>
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Description" wide>
                    <textarea
                      rows={4}
                      value={inventoryForm.description}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateInventoryForm(
                          "description",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>
                </div>

                {inventoryMode === "edit" && (
                  <div className="inventory-edit-note">

                <div className="modal-actions">

                        setInventoryMode("view");

                  <button

                      : "Save Item"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : selectedInventoryItem ? (

                    label="Manufacturer"
                    value={inventoryManufacturerName(
                      selectedInventoryItem.manufacturer_id
                    )}
                  />
                  <DetailField
                    label="Location"
                    value={selectedInventoryItem.location}
                  />
                  <DetailField
                    label="On Hand"
                    value={String(
                      numberOrZero(
                        selectedInventoryItem.quantity_on_hand
                      )
                    )}
                  />
                  <DetailField
                    label="Unit Cost"
                    value={money(
                      numberOrZero(
                        selectedInventoryItem.unit_cost
                      )
                    )}
                  />
                  <DetailField
                    label="MSRP"
                    value={money(
                      numberOrZero(selectedInventoryItem.msrp)
                    )}
                  />
                  <DetailField
                    label="Status"
                    value={
                      selectedInventoryItem.active

                        : "Inactive"
                    }
                  />
                  <DetailField
                    label="Inventory Value"
                    value={money(
                      numberOrZero(
                        selectedInventoryItem.quantity_on_hand

                        numberOrZero(
                          selectedInventoryItem.unit_cost
                        )
                    )}
                  />
                </div>

                {selectedInventoryItem.description && (
                  <div className="inventory-description">
                    <span>DESCRIPTION</span>
                    <p>{selectedInventoryItem.description}</p>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="inventory-control-grid">
                  <section className="inventory-subpanel">
                    <div className="inventory-subpanel-heading">
                      <div>

                        <span>
                          QR, barcode or manufacturer labels.
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="inventory-inline-add">
                      <select
                        value={newScanCodeType}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                          setNewScanCodeType(
                            event.target.value
                          )
                        }
                      >
                        <option value="QR">QR</option>
                        <option value="Barcode">
                          Barcode
                        </option>
                        <option value="Manufacturer">
                          Manufacturer
                        </option>
                        <option value="Other">Other</option>
                      </select>
                      <input
                        value={newScanCode}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                          setNewScanCode(
                            event.target.value
                          )
                        }
                        placeholder="Scan or enter code"
                      />
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={addInventoryScanCode}
                      >
                        Add
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {inventoryScanCodes.length === 0 ? (
                      <div className="inventory-empty-mini">

                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="inventory-chip-list">
                        {inventoryScanCodes.map((scanCode) => (
                          <div
                            className="inventory-chip"
                            key={scanCode.id}
                          >
                            <span>
                              {scanCode.code_type || "Code"}
                            </span>
                            <strong>
                              {scanCode.scan_code}
                            </strong>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() =>
                                deleteInventoryScanCode(
                                  scanCode
                                )
                              }
                            >
                              ×
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </section>

                  <section className="inventory-subpanel">
                    <div className="inventory-subpanel-heading">
                      <div>
                        <strong>Tags</strong>
                        <span>

                        </span>
                      </div>

                    <div className="inventory-inline-add">
                      <input

                        onChange={(event) =>
                          setNewInventoryTagName(

                          )
                        }
                        placeholder="New tag"

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={createAndAttachInventoryTag}
                      >
                        Add
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {inventoryTags.length === 0 ? (
                      <div className="inventory-empty-mini">

                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="inventory-tag-picker">
                        {inventoryTags.map((tag) => {
                          const attached =
                            inventoryItemTags.some(
                              (entry) => entry.id === tag.id
                            );

                          return (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              key={tag.id}
                              className={
                                attached ? "selected" : ""
                              }
                              onClick={() =>
                                toggleInventoryTag(tag)
                              }
                            >
                              {attached ? "✓ " : ""}
                              {tag.name}
                            </button>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </section>
                </div>

                <section className="inventory-movement-panel">
                  <div className="inventory-subpanel-heading movement">

                    <button

                        setInventoryAdjustmentForm({
                          ...blankInventoryAdjustmentForm,
                          from_location:
                            selectedInventoryItem.location ||
                            "",
                          to_location:
                            selectedInventoryItem.location ||
                            "",
                        });
                        setInventoryAdjustmentOpen(true);
                      }}
                    >
                      Adjust Stock
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {inventoryAdjustmentOpen && (
                    <div className="inventory-adjustment-card">
                      <div className="form-grid">
                        <FormField label="Movement Type">
                          <select
                            value={

                            }
                            onChange={(event) =>
                              setInventoryAdjustmentForm(
                                (current) => ({
                                  ...current,
                                  movement_type:
                                    event.target.value,
                                })
                              )
                            }
                          >
                            <option value="Received">

                            </option>

                            <option value="Return">
                              Return
                            </option>
                            <option value="Transfer">
                              Transfer
                            </option>
                            <option value="Damage">
                              Damage / Write-off
                            </option>
                            <option value="Count Correction">
                              Count Correction
                            </option>
                            <option value="Adjustment">
                              Adjustment
                            </option>
                          </select>
                        </FormField>

                        <FormField label="Quantity Change">
                          <input
                            inputMode="numeric"
                            value={
                              inventoryAdjustmentForm.quantity_change
                            }
                            onChange={(event) =>
                              setInventoryAdjustmentForm(
                                (current) => ({
                                  ...current,
                                  quantity_change:
                                    event.target.value,
                                })
                              )
                            }
                            placeholder="+5 or -1"
                          />
                        </FormField>

                        <FormField label="From Location">
                          <input
                            value={
                              inventoryAdjustmentForm.from_location
                            }
                            onChange={(event) =>
                              setInventoryAdjustmentForm(
                                (current) => ({
                                  ...current,
                                  from_location:
                                    event.target.value,
                                })
                              )
                            }
                          />

                        <FormField label="To Location">
                          <input
                            value={
                              inventoryAdjustmentForm.to_location
                            }
                            onChange={(event) =>
                              setInventoryAdjustmentForm(
                                (current) => ({
                                  ...current,
                                  to_location:
                                    event.target.value,
                                })
                              )
                            }
                          />
                        </FormField>

                        <FormField label="Reason" wide>
                          <input
                            value={
                              inventoryAdjustmentForm.reason
                            }
                            onChange={(event) =>
                              setInventoryAdjustmentForm(
                                (current) => ({
                                  ...current,
                                  reason:
                                    event.target.value,
                                })
                              )
                            }
                            placeholder="Why is stock changing?"
                          />
                        </FormField>

                        <FormField label="Notes" wide>
                          <textarea
                            rows={2}
                            value={
                              inventoryAdjustmentForm.notes
                            }

                                (current) => ({
                                  ...current,
                                  notes:
                                    event.target.value,
                                })
                              )

                          />

                      </div>

                      <div className="inventory-adjustment-actions">

                          className="modal-secondary"

                          }

                        </button>
                        <button
                          className="modal-primary"
                          type="button"
                          disabled={savingInventoryAdjustment}
                          onClick={saveInventoryAdjustment}

                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {inventoryMovements.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="inventory-empty-mini movement-empty">

                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="inventory-movement-list">

                          className="inventory-movement-row"

                              {new Date(

                              {movement.quantity_before != null &&
                              movement.quantity_after != null
                                ? ` • ${movement.quantity_before} → ${movement.quantity_after}`
                                : ""}
                            </small>
                          </div>

                          <div className="inventory-movement-location">
                            {[
                              movement.from_location,
                              movement.to_location,
                            ]

                              .join(" → ") || "—"}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </section>

                <div className="modal-actions inventory-view-actions">
                  <button
                    className="danger-button"
                    onClick={deleteInventoryItem}
                  >
                    Delete
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="modal-secondary"
                    onClick={closeInventoryModal}
                  >
                    Close
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="modal-primary"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setInventoryMode("edit")
                    }
                  >
                    Edit Item
                  </button>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : null}
          </section>
        </div>
      )}

      {selectedDailyCashBatch && (
        <div
          className="modal-backdrop"
          onMouseDown={(event) => {
            if (event.target === event.currentTarget) {
              closeDailyCashBatch();
            }
          }}
        >
          <section className="daily-cash-modal">
            <div className="modal-header">
              <div>
                <div className="detail-kicker">
                  DAILY CASH #{selectedDailyCashBatch.batch_number}
                </div>
                <h2>
                  {selectedDailyCashBatch.business_date}
                </h2>
              </div>

              <button
                className="modal-close"
                onClick={closeDailyCashBatch}
                aria-label="Close"
              >
                ×
              </button>
            </div>

            {dailyCashDetailLoading ? (
              <div className="empty-state">
                Loading reconciliation...
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="daily-cash-summary-strip">
                  <div>
                    <span>STATUS</span>
                    <strong>
                      {selectedDailyCashBatch.status}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span>PAYMENTS</span>
                    <strong>
                      {dailyCashBatchPayments.length}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span>SYSTEM TOTAL</span>
                    <strong>
                      {money(
                        selectedDailyCashSystemTotal
                      )}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span>RECONCILED TOTAL</span>
                    <strong>
                      {money(
                        selectedDailyCashActualTotal
                      )}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span>VARIANCE</span>
                    <strong
                      className={
                        Math.abs(
                          selectedDailyCashActualTotal -
                            selectedDailyCashSystemTotal
                        ) > 0.004
                          ? "variance-bad"
                          : "variance-good"
                      }
                    >
                      {money(
                        selectedDailyCashActualTotal -
                          selectedDailyCashSystemTotal
                      )}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="daily-cash-modal-actions-top">
                  {selectedDailyCashBatch.status ===
                    "Open" && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="daily-cash-refresh-button"
                      disabled={dailyCashSyncing}
                      onClick={() =>
                        syncDailyCashBatchPayments(
                          selectedDailyCashBatch
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      {dailyCashSyncing
                        ? "Refreshing..."
                        : "Refresh Posted Payments"}
                    </button>
                  )}

                  {selectedDailyCashBatch.status ===
                    "Posted" && (
                    <div className="daily-cash-lock">
                      🔒 Posted and locked
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <section className="daily-cash-tender-panel">
                  <div className="daily-cash-section-heading">
                    <div>
                      <strong>Tender Reconciliation</strong>
                      <span>
                        Compare the Hub total to what was
                        actually counted or settled.
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="daily-cash-tender-header">
                    <span>METHOD</span>
                    <span>SYSTEM</span>
                    <span>ACTUAL</span>
                    <span>VARIANCE</span>
                    <span>NOTES</span>
                  </div>

                  {paymentMethods.map((method) => {
                    const systemAmount =
                      dailyCashBatchPayments
                        .filter(
                          (payment) =>
                            payment.payment_method ===
                            method
                        )
                        .reduce(
                          (sum, payment) =>
                            sum +
                            numberOrZero(
                              payment.amount
                            ),
                          0
                        );

                    const actualAmount =
                      numberOrZero(
                        dailyCashTenderDrafts[
                          method
                        ]?.actual_amount
                      );

                    const variance =
                      actualAmount - systemAmount;

                    return (
                      <div
                        className="daily-cash-tender-row"
                        key={method}
                      >
                        <strong>{method}</strong>

                        <div className="daily-cash-money">
                          {money(systemAmount)}
                        </div>

                        {selectedDailyCashBatch.status ===
                        "Posted" ? (
                          <div className="daily-cash-money">
                            {money(actualAmount)}
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <input
                            inputMode="decimal"
                            value={
                              dailyCashTenderDrafts[
                                method
                              ]?.actual_amount ??
                              String(systemAmount)
                            }
                            onChange={(event) =>
                              updateDailyCashTenderDraft(
                                method,
                                "actual_amount",
                                event.target.value
                              )
                            }
                          />
                        )}

                        <div
                          className={`daily-cash-variance ${
                            Math.abs(variance) > 0.004
                              ? "bad"
                              : "good"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {money(variance)}
                        </div>

                        {selectedDailyCashBatch.status ===
                        "Posted" ? (
                          <div className="daily-cash-note-read">
                            {dailyCashTenderDrafts[
                              method
                            ]?.notes || "—"}
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <input
                            value={
                              dailyCashTenderDrafts[
                                method
                              ]?.notes || ""
                            }
                            onChange={(event) =>
                              updateDailyCashTenderDraft(
                                method,
                                "notes",
                                event.target.value
                              )
                            }
                            placeholder="Optional"
                          />
                        )}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </section>

                <section className="daily-cash-payments-panel">
                  <div className="daily-cash-section-heading">
                    <div>
                      <strong>Posted Payments</strong>
                      <span>
                        These payment entries are locked into
                        this batch once posted.
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {dailyCashBatchPayments.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="inventory-empty-mini movement-empty">

                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="daily-cash-payment-list">
                      {dailyCashBatchPayments.map(

                              <div>
                                <strong>
                                  {payment.payment_method}

                                </strong>
                              </div>

                              <div className="daily-cash-payment-amount">
                                {money(
                                  numberOrZero(
                                    payment.amount
                                  )
                                )}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        }
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </section>

                <div className="daily-cash-notes">

                </div>

                <div className="modal-actions">

                          : "Post & Lock"}
                      </button>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </section>
        </div>

      {vendorInvoiceModalOpen && (

                className="modal-close"
                onClick={closeExpenseModal}
                aria-label="Close"
              >
                ×
              </button>
            </div>

            {expenseMode !== "view" ? (
              <>
                <div className="form-grid accounting-form-grid">
                  <FormField label="Expense Date">
                    <input
                      type="date"
                      value={expenseForm.expense_date}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateExpenseForm(
                          "expense_date",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Payee">
                    <input
                      value={expenseForm.payee}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateExpenseForm(
                          "payee",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="Who was paid?"
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Category">
                    <input
                      value={expenseForm.category}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateExpenseForm(
                          "category",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="Office, delivery, repair..."
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Amount">
                    <input
                      inputMode="decimal"
                      value={expenseForm.amount}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateExpenseForm(
                          "amount",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Payment Method">
                    <input
                      value={expenseForm.payment_method}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateExpenseForm(
                          "payment_method",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="Card, check, ACH..."
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Reference">
                    <input
                      value={expenseForm.reference}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateExpenseForm(
                          "reference",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="Receipt, check, transaction..."
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Manufacturer">
                    <select
                      value={expenseForm.manufacturer_id}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateExpenseForm(
                          "manufacturer_id",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="">None</option>
                      {manufacturers.map((manufacturer) => (
                        <option
                          key={manufacturer.id}
                          value={manufacturer.id}
                        >
                          {manufacturer.name}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Purchase Order">
                    <select
                      value={expenseForm.purchase_order_id}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateExpenseForm(
                          "purchase_order_id",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="">None</option>
                      {purchaseOrders
                        .filter(
                          (order) =>
                            !expenseForm.manufacturer_id ||
                            order.manufacturer_id ===
                              expenseForm.manufacturer_id
                        )
                        .map((order) => (
                          <option
                            key={order.id}
                            value={order.id}
                          >
                            PO #{order.po_number}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                    </select>
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Sales Order">
                    <select
                      value={expenseForm.sales_order_id}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateExpenseForm(
                          "sales_order_id",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="">None</option>
                      {salesOrders.map((order) => (
                        <option
                          key={order.id}
                          value={order.id}
                        >
                          Sale #{order.sale_number} ·{" "}
                          {clientNameById(order.client_id)}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Description" wide>
                    <input
                      value={expenseForm.description}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateExpenseForm(
                          "description",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="What was this expense for?"
                    />
                  </FormField>

                  <FormField label="Notes" wide>
                    <textarea
                      rows={4}
                      value={expenseForm.notes}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        updateExpenseForm(
                          "notes",
                          event.target.value
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </FormField>
                </div>

                <div className="modal-actions">
                  <button
                    className="modal-secondary"
                    disabled={savingExpense}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (
                        expenseMode === "edit" &&
                        selectedExpense
                      ) {
                        setExpenseForm(
                          expenseToForm(selectedExpense)
                        );
                        setExpenseMode("view");
                      } else {
                        closeExpenseModal();
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="modal-primary"
                    disabled={savingExpense}
                    onClick={saveExpense}
                  >
                    {savingExpense
                      ? "Saving..."
                      : "Save Expense"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : selectedExpense ? (
              <>
                <div className="accounting-detail-grid expense">
                  <DetailField
                    label="Date"
                    value={selectedExpense.expense_date}
                  />
                  <DetailField
                    label="Payee"
                    value={selectedExpense.payee}
                  />
                  <DetailField
                    label="Category"
                    value={selectedExpense.category}
                  />
                  <DetailField
                    label="Amount"
                    value={money(
                      numberOrZero(selectedExpense.amount)
                    )}
                  />
                  <DetailField
                    label="Payment Method"
                    value={selectedExpense.payment_method}
                  />
                  <DetailField
                    label="Reference"
                    value={selectedExpense.reference}
                  />
                  <DetailField
                    label="Manufacturer"
                    value={
                      selectedExpense.manufacturer_id
                        ? manufacturerName(
                            selectedExpense.manufacturer_id
                          )
                        : "—"
                    }
                  />
                  <DetailField
                    label="Purchase Order"
                    value={
                      selectedExpense.purchase_order_id
                        ? `#${
                            purchaseOrders.find(
                              (order) =>
                                order.id ===
                                selectedExpense.purchase_order_id
                            )?.po_number || "—"
                          }`
                        : "—"
                    }
                  />
                  <DetailField
                    label="Sales Order"
                    value={
                      selectedExpense.sales_order_id
                        ? saleNumberForId(
                            selectedExpense.sales_order_id
                          ) || "—"
                        : "—"
                    }
                  />
                </div>

                {selectedExpense.description && (
                  <div className="accounting-notes-read">
                    <span>DESCRIPTION</span>
                    <p>{selectedExpense.description}</p>
                  </div>
                )}

                {selectedExpense.notes && (
                  <div className="accounting-notes-read">
                    <span>NOTES</span>
                    <p>{selectedExpense.notes}</p>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="modal-actions accounting-view-actions">
                  <button
                    className="danger-button"
                    onClick={deleteExpense}
                  >
                    Delete
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="modal-secondary"
                    onClick={closeExpenseModal}
                  >
                    Close
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="modal-primary"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setExpenseMode("edit")
                    }
                  >
                    Edit Expense
                  </button>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : null}
          </section>
        </div>
      )}

    </>
  );
}

function StatCard({
  label,
  value,
  detail,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  detail: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="stat-card">
      <div className="stat-label">{label}</div>
      <div className="stat-value">{value}</div>
      <div className="stat-detail">{detail}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function StatusRow({
  label,
  value,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="status-row">
      <div>
        <span className="status-dot">●</span>
        {label}
      </div>
      <strong>{value}</strong>
    </div>
  );
}


function MiniStat({
  label,
  value,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="mini-stat">
      <span>{label}</span>
      <strong>{value}</strong>
    </div>
  );
}

function ManufacturerMetric({
  label,
  value,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="manufacturer-metric">
      <span>{label}</span>
      <strong>{value}</strong>
    </div>
  );
}

function CostPreview({
  manufacturer,
}: {
  manufacturer: Manufacturer;
}) {
  const msrp = 1000;
  const factor = Number(manufacturer.purchasing_factor || 0);
  const tariff = Number(manufacturer.tariff_pct || 0) / 100;
  const surcharge =
    Number(manufacturer.surcharge_pct || 0) / 100;
  const discount =
    Number(manufacturer.default_discount_pct || 0) / 100;

  const baseCost = msrp * factor;
  const expectedCost =
    baseCost * (1 + tariff + surcharge);
  const customerPrice = msrp * (1 - discount);

  return (
    <div className="cost-preview">
      <div>
        <span>EXAMPLE ON $1,000 MSRP</span>
        <strong>Pricing preview</strong>
      </div>
      <div className="cost-preview-grid">
        <div>
          <span>Customer price</span>
          <strong>{money(customerPrice)}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span>Base vendor cost</span>
          <strong>{money(baseCost)}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span>Expected cost w/ tariff + surcharge</span>
          <strong>{money(expectedCost)}</strong>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function DetailField({
  label,
  value,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string | null | undefined;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="detail-field">
      <span>{label}</span>
      <strong>{value || "Not entered"}</strong>
    </div>
  );
}

function FormField({
  label,
  wide = false,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  wide?: boolean;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <label className={`form-field ${wide ? "wide" : ""}`}>
      <span>{label}</span>
      {children}
    </label>
  );
}

    gap: 5px;
    padding: 25px;
    color: #81909a;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .empty-icon { font-size: 25px; color: #5684a2; }

  .modal-backdrop {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 1000;
    inset: 0;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    padding: 18px;
    background: rgba(12,30,44,.56);
    backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
  }

  .client-modal {
    width: min(680px,100%);
    max-height: 90vh;
    overflow: auto;
    background: white;
    border-radius: 22px;
    box-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(6,25,40,.3);
    padding: 22px;
  }

  .modal-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 15px;
    padding-bottom: 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e8eef2;
  }

  .modal-header h2 {
    margin: 4px 0 0;
    color: #173a59;
    font-size: 23px;
  }

  .modal-close {
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    border: 1px solid #d9e3e8;
    border-radius: 11px;
    background: white;
    color: #617580;
    font-size: 22px;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .client-hero {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 13px;
    padding: 20px 0 16px;
  }

  .detail-avatar {
    width: 52px;
    height: 52px;
    border-radius: 15px;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }

  .client-hero strong {
    display: block;
    color: #173a59;
    font-size: 17px;
  }

  .client-hero span {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 3px;
    color: #81909a;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .detail-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
    gap: 1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid #e2e9ed;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: #e2e9ed;
  }

  .detail-field {
    min-width: 0;
    background: #f9fbfc;
    padding: 13px;
  }

  .detail-field span {
    display: block;
    color: #8b989f;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 900;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: .06em;
  }

  .detail-field strong {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 4px;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    color: #36586d;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .notes-box {
    margin-top: 15px;
    background: #f5f8fa;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 13px;
  }

  .notes-box span {
    color: #89979f;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
  }

  .notes-box p {
    margin: 5px 0 0;
    color: #536d7d;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .form-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
    gap: 13px;
    padding-top: 18px;
  }

  .form-field {
    display: block;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .form-field.wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; }

  .form-field > span {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    color: #647984;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 850;
  }

  .form-field input:not([type="checkbox"]),
  .form-field select,
  .form-field textarea {
    width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid #cfdce3;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: white;
    color: #294c62;
    padding: 10px 11px;
    outline: none;
  }

  .form-field textarea { resize: vertical; }

  .form-field input:focus,
  .form-field select:focus,
  .form-field textarea:focus {
    border-color: #3980ad;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(57,128,173,.1);
  }

  .checkbox-row {
    min-height: 42px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    color: #4c6878;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .modal-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 9px;
    margin-top: 18px;
    padding-top: 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid #e8eef2;
  }

  .modal-primary, .modal-secondary, .delete-button {
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 10px 13px;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 850;
  }

  .modal-primary {
    flex: 1;
    border: 0;
    background: #173a59;
    color: white;
  }

  .modal-secondary {
    border: 1px solid #cedbe2;
    background: white;
    color: #3f6073;
  }

  .delete-button {
    border: 1px solid #eccbcb;
    background: #fff7f7;
    color: #a44848;
  }

  .modal-primary:disabled, .modal-secondary:disabled,
  .delete-button:disabled {
    cursor: not-allowed;
    opacity: .55;
  }


  .manufacturer-stats {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .mini-stat {
    background: white;
    border: 1px solid #dfe7ec;
    border-radius: 13px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
  }

  .mini-stat span,
  .manufacturer-metric span {
    display: block;
    color: #8a979f;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: .07em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .mini-stat strong {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 4px;
    color: #173a59;
    font-size: 19px;
  }

  .manufacturer-row {
    width: 100%;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns:
      auto minmax(190px,1fr)
      repeat(4,minmax(80px,.45fr)) auto;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    border: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #edf1f4;
    padding: 12px 13px;
    background: white;
    text-align: left;
  }

  .manufacturer-row:hover { background: #f3f8fb; }

  .manufacturer-mark {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    border-radius: 11px;
    background: linear-gradient(145deg,#e5f0f6,#d3e7f2);
    color: #285a7b;
    font-weight: 950;
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  .manufacturer-mark.large {
    width: 52px;
    height: 52px;
    border-radius: 15px;
    font-size: 17px;
  }

  .manufacturer-main { min-width: 0; }

  .manufacturer-main strong {
    display: block;
    overflow: hidden;
    color: #274b63;
    font-size: 11px;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .manufacturer-main span {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 3px;
    color: #89969e;
    font-size: 9px;
  }

  .manufacturer-metric {
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .manufacturer-metric strong {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 3px;
    color: #3d5f72;
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .manufacturer-detail-hero {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 13px;
    padding: 20px 0 16px;
  }

  .manufacturer-detail-hero strong {
    display: block;
    color: #173a59;
    font-size: 18px;
  }

  .manufacturer-detail-hero span {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 3px;
    color: #81909a;
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .cost-preview {
    margin-top: 15px;
    border-radius: 13px;
    padding: 14px;
    background:
      linear-gradient(135deg,#173a59,#2b6f9c);
    color: white;
  }

  .cost-preview > div:first-child span {
    display: block;
    opacity: .6;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
  }

  .cost-preview > div:first-child strong {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 3px;
    font-size: 14px;
  }

  .cost-preview-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 12px;
  }

  .cost-preview-grid div {
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 10px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  }

  .cost-preview-grid span {
    display: block;
    min-height: 24px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,.68);
    font-size: 8px;
    line-height: 1.35;
  }

  .cost-preview-grid strong {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 4px;
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  .manufacturer-help {
    margin-top: 15px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 12px 13px;
    background: #eef6fa;
    color: #45677a;
  }

  .manufacturer-help strong {
    display: block;
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .manufacturer-help span {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 4px;
    font-size: 9px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }


  .quote-stat-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }


  .quote-archive-tabs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .quote-archive-tabs button {
    border: 1px solid #d4e0e6;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: white;
    color: #587080;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 850;
  }

  .quote-archive-tabs button.active {
    border-color: #285d7d;
    background: #173a59;
    color: white;
  }

  .archive-button {
    border: 1px solid #d2dee5;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 9px 11px;
    background: #f4f7f9;
    color: #3f6073;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 850;
  }

  .quote-row {
    width: 100%;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns:
      90px minmax(190px,1fr) 90px 70px 110px auto;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    border: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #edf1f4;
    padding: 12px 13px;
    background: white;
    text-align: left;
  }

  .quote-row:hover {
    background: #f3f8fb;
  }

  .quote-number span,
  .quote-items-count span,
  .quote-total span {
    display: block;
    color: #96a2a9;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: .06em;
  }

  .quote-number strong {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 2px;
    color: #285a7b;
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  .quote-main {
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .quote-main strong {
    display: block;
    overflow: hidden;
    color: #274b63;
    font-size: 11px;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .quote-main span {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 3px;
    color: #89969e;
    font-size: 9px;
  }

  .quote-status {
    justify-self: start;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 5px 8px;
    background: #eaf3f8;
    color: #326585;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 850;
  }

  .quote-items-count strong,
  .quote-total strong {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 2px;
    color: #3d5f72;
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .quote-total strong {
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .quote-editor-backdrop {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 1200;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgba(10,27,40,.62);
    backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
    padding: 18px;
    overflow: auto;
  }

  .quote-editor {
    width: min(1180px,100%);
    min-height: calc(100vh - 36px);
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: 22px;
    background: #f3f6f8;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 90px rgba(7,24,37,.35);
  }

  .quote-editor-header,
  .quote-editor-footer {
    background: white;
    padding: 17px 20px;
  }

  .quote-editor-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 15px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #dfe7ec;
  }

  .quote-editor-header h2 {
    margin: 4px 0 0;
    color: #173a59;
    font-size: 22px;
  }

  .quote-header-actions {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .quote-editor-body {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 16px;
    overflow: auto;
  }

  .quote-card {
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    border: 1px solid #dfe7ec;
    border-radius: 15px;
    background: white;
    padding: 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(22,48,70,.035);
  }

  .quote-card-title {
    color: #173a59;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .quote-header-grid,
  .quote-line-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
    gap: 11px;
    margin-top: 13px;
  }

  .quote-header-grid .wide,
  .quote-line-grid .wide {
    grid-column: span 2;
  }

  .quote-lines-heading {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 15px;
  }

  .quote-lines-heading p {
    margin: 4px 0 0;
    color: #7f8d95;
    font-size: 9px;
  }

  .line-add-button {
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 9px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    background: #173a59;
    color: white;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 850;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .quote-line-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-top: 14px;
  }

  .quote-line-card {
    border: 1px solid #dce6eb;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: #fbfcfd;
    padding: 13px;
  }

  .quote-line-top {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .line-number {
    color: #5f7480;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 900;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: .05em;
  }

  .line-remove-button {
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: #a55252;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  .line-financials {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns:
      repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr)) minmax(120px,1fr);
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 12px;
  }

  .line-financials > div,
  .commission-toggle {
    min-height: 54px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 8px 9px;
    background: white;
    border: 1px solid #e2e9ed;
  }

  .line-financials span {
    color: #8a979f;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 850;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .line-financials strong {
    margin-top: 3px;
    color: #3b5d70;
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .commission-toggle {
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    color: #536d7c;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  .line-warning {
    margin-top: 10px;
    border-radius: 9px;
    padding: 9px 10px;
    background: #fff7e8;
    color: #8c671d;
    font-size: 9px;
    line-height: 1.45;
  }

  .quote-bottom-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(320px,.7fr);
    gap: 14px;
  }

  .quote-notes {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 11px;
    border: 1px solid #cfdce3;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 11px;
    resize: vertical;
    color: #294c62;
  }

  .summary-row,
  .summary-input-row,
  .summary-total {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 14px;
    padding: 10px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e9eef1;
    color: #5f737f;
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .summary-input-row input {
    width: 115px;
    border: 1px solid #cedbe2;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 7px 8px;
    color: #294c62;
    text-align: right;
  }

  .summary-total {
    border-bottom: 0;
    padding-top: 14px;
    color: #173a59;
  }

  .summary-total strong {
    font-size: 22px;
  }

  .internal-cost-summary {
    margin-top: 8px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 10px;
    background: #eef4f7;
  }

  .internal-cost-summary div + div {
    margin-top: 8px;
  }

  .internal-cost-summary span {
    display: block;
    color: #7d8b94;
    font-size: 8px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 850;
  }

  .internal-cost-summary strong {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 2px;
    color: #385b6e;
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .quote-editor-footer {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 9px;
    border-top: 1px solid #dfe7ec;
  }

  .quote-save-button {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    min-width: 160px;
  }


  .convert-sale-button {
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 10px 13px;
    background: #2f6f5b;
    color: white;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 850;
  }

  .convert-sale-button:disabled {
    cursor: not-allowed;
    opacity: .55;
  }

  .sale-number {
    background: #edf7f2;
    border-color: #d5e9df;
  }

  .sale-number span,
  .sale-number strong {
    color: #2f6f5b;
  }

  .sale-modal {
    width: min(900px, 100%);
    max-height: 92vh;
    overflow: auto;
    background: white;
    border-radius: 22px;
    box-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(6,25,40,.3);
    padding: 22px;
  }

  .sale-summary-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
    gap: 1px;
    margin-top: 18px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid #e2e9ed;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: #e2e9ed;
  }

  .sale-line-items {
    margin-top: 18px;
    border: 1px solid #dfe7ec;
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .sale-line-items > .quote-card-title {
    padding: 12px 14px;
    background: #f4f7f9;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #dfe7ec;

  .sale-item-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 100px 100px 140px;
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 14px;

  .sale-item-row:last-child {

  .sale-item-copy {

  .sale-item-copy strong {

    color: #294c62;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .sale-item-copy span {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 3px;
    color: #85939c;
    font-size: 9px;
  }

  .sale-item-money span {
    display: block;
    color: #8b989f;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .sale-item-money strong {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 3px;
    color: #36586d;
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .fulfillment-select {
    width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid #cfdce3;
    border-radius: 9px;
    padding: 8px;
    background: white;
    color: #294c62;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 750;
  }

  .sale-total-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 14px;
  }

  .sale-total-grid div {
    background: #f4f7f9;
    border-radius: 11px;
    padding: 11px;
  }

  .sale-total-grid span {
    display: block;
    color: #84929b;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 850;
  }

  .sale-total-grid strong {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 4px;
    color: #173a59;
    font-size: 12px;
  }


  .payments-card {
    margin-top: 18px;
    border: 1px solid #dfe7ec;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 15px;
    background: white;
  }

  .payments-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .payments-header h3 {
    margin: 3px 0 0;
    color: #173a59;
    font-size: 16px;
  }

  .payment-add-button {
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 9px 12px;
    background: #173a59;
    color: white;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 850;
  }

  .payment-summary-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 14px;
  }

  .payment-summary-grid > div {
    border-radius: 11px;
    padding: 11px;
    background: #f4f7f9;
  }

  .payment-summary-grid span {
    display: block;
    color: #85939c;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 850;
  }

  .payment-summary-grid strong {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 4px;
    color: #173a59;
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .payment-status {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-top: 9px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
  }

  .payment-status strong {
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .payment-status span {
    font-size: 9px;
  }

  .payment-status.due {
    background: #fff6e8;
    color: #865d19;
  }

  .payment-status.deposit {
    background: #eef5fb;
    color: #285f83;
  }

  .payment-status.paid {

  .payment-form-card {

  .payment-row {

  .payment-row.correction {

  .payment-row-main strong {

  .payment-row-main span,

  .payment-row-main small {

  .payment-amount {

    color: #2f6f5b;
    font-size: 11px;

  }

  .payment-amount.negative {

  }

  .payment-actions {

    gap: 5px;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    flex-wrap: wrap;

  .payment-actions button {

    background: white;
    color: #3d6175;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 850;
  }

  .payment-actions button.danger {

    color: #a24b4b;
    background: #fff8f8;
  }

  .sale-header-actions {

  .download-sale-button {

  .vendor-freight-view-row span { color: #4e6878; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 750; }
  .vendor-freight-view-row small { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: #8a979f; font-size: 8px; }
  .vendor-freight-view-row strong { color: #173a59; font-size: 10px; }

  .edit-sale-button {
    border: 1px solid #cfdce3;

  .sale-edit-banner {

  .sale-edit-banner span {

  .sale-edit-header-grid { margin-top: 16px; }

  .sale-edit-section-heading {

  .generate-po-button {
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 9px;

    opacity: .55;
  }

  .po-number {
    background: #f2f0f8;
    border-color: #ddd7eb;
  }

  .po-number span,
  .po-number strong {
    color: #554579;
  }

  .po-status {
    justify-self: start;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 6px 9px;
    background: #eef3f6;
    color: #547084;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 850;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .po-modal {
    width: min(980px, 100%);
    max-height: 94vh;
    overflow: auto;
    background: white;
    border-radius: 22px;
    box-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(6,25,40,.3);
    padding: 22px;
  }

    margin-top: 4px;
    color: #81909a;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .po-snapshot-strip {
    display: grid;

    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 16px;
  }

    border-radius: 11px;

  .po-snapshot-strip strong {

  .po-form-grid {

    display: block;

  .po-item-main small {

  .po-item-number strong {

    margin-top: 3px;

  .po-total-box {

  }

  .po-ack-empty {

  }

  .po-ack-list {
    padding: 0 14px;
  }

  .po-ack-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;

    border-bottom: 1px solid #edf1f4;

  .po-ack-row:last-child {

  }

    gap: 9px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

  .po-ack-file strong {

  .po-ack-file span {

  }

  .po-ack-actions {

  .po-ack-actions button {

    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    background: white;

  .po-ack-actions button:disabled {

  .po-ack-next {

  .po-next-step {

  }

  .po-next-step span {

  .inventory-page-heading {

  .inventory-page-actions {

    padding: 10px 14px;

  .daily-cash-heading {

  .daily-cash-open-controls {

    background: white;

  .daily-cash-stat-grid {

  .daily-cash-list {

      88px

  }

  .daily-cash-status.posted {
    background: #eaf5ee;

  .accounting-notes-read p {
    margin: 6px 0 0;
    color: #5f7684;
    font-size: 8.5px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .accounting-view-actions {
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }

  .accounting-view-actions .danger-button {
    margin-right: auto;
  }

  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    .hub-shell { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

    .sidebar {
      min-height: auto;
      padding: 14px;
    }

    .brand-area { padding-bottom: 10px; }
    .sidebar-user { margin-bottom: 10px; }

    .nav-sections {
      display: flex;
      gap: 7px;
      overflow-x: auto;
    }

    .nav-group { display: contents; }

    .nav-heading, .nav-button.future { display: none; }

    .nav-button {
      width: auto;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      padding: 8px 11px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.06);
    }

    .main-area { padding: 17px 14px 30px; }

    .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }

    .dashboard-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

    .client-list { max-height: none; }

    .client-row {
      grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;
    }

    .client-row-contact, .client-row-sales { display: none; }

    .manufacturer-row {
      grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;
    }

    .manufacturer-metric { display: none; }

  
  .quote-archive-tabs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .quote-archive-tabs button {
    border: 1px solid #d4e0e6;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: white;
    color: #587080;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 850;
  }

  .quote-archive-tabs button.active {
    border-color: #285d7d;
    background: #173a59;
    color: white;
  }

  .archive-button {
    border: 1px solid #d2dee5;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 9px 11px;
    background: #f4f7f9;
    color: #3f6073;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 850;
  }

  .quote-row {
      grid-template-columns: 70px minmax(0,1fr) auto;
    }

    .quote-status,
    .quote-items-count,
    .quote-total {
      display: none;
    }

    .quote-header-grid,
    .quote-line-grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
    }

    .line-financials {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
    }

    .quote-bottom-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 650px) {
    .po-snapshot-strip,
    .po-total-box {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
    }

    .po-item-row {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 70px;
    }

    .po-item-number {
      text-align: left;
    }

    .welcome-card {
      min-height: 0;
      display: block;
      padding: 23px;
    }

    .welcome-card h1 { font-size: 25px; }
    .welcome-action { margin-top: 18px; }

    .page-heading { align-items: flex-start; }
    .page-heading h1 { font-size: 25px; }

    .client-modal {
      max-height: 94vh;
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 18px;
    }

    .detail-grid, .form-grid,
    .cost-preview-grid,
    .sale-summary-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

    .sale-item-row {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 100px;
    }

    .sale-item-money:nth-of-type(2) {
      display: none;
    }

    .fulfillment-select {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
    }

    .sale-total-grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
    }

    .payment-summary-grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
    }

    .payment-status {
      display: block;
    }

    .payment-status span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 3px;
    }

    .payment-form-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .payment-row {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto;
    }

    .payment-actions {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      justify-content: flex-start;
    }

    .manufacturer-stats {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
    }

    .quote-stat-grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
    }

    .quote-editor-backdrop {
      padding: 0;
    }

    .quote-editor {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 100vh;
      border-radius: 0;
    }

    .quote-editor-body {
      padding: 10px;
    }

    .quote-header-grid,
    .quote-line-grid,
    .line-financials {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .quote-header-grid .wide,
    .quote-line-grid .wide {
      grid-column: auto;
    }

    .quote-lines-heading {
      align-items: center;
    }

    .quote-editor-footer {
      position: sticky;
      bottom: 0;
      padding: 12px;
    }

    .quote-save-button {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .form-field.wide { grid-column: auto; }

    .modal-actions { flex-wrap: wrap; }

    .modal-primary { flex-basis: 100%; }

    .modal-secondary, .delete-button { flex: 1; }
  }
`;
